title: Solar lighting device on lawn
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy lawn lamp, which comprises a lamp shade 3, a lamp post 5 and a solar energy photovoltaic electroluminescence device composed of a solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1, an electroluminescence sheet 2 and a solar energy charging and discharging processor 4, wherein the solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1 is connected with the solar energy charging and discharging processor 4. The solar energy charging and discharging processor 4 is connected with the electroluminescence sheet 2. The solar energy photovoltaic electroluminescence device which is composed of the solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1, the electroluminescence sheet 2 and the solar energy charging and discharging processor 4 is fixed to the lamp shade 3 fixed to the lamp post 5. The utility model has the advantages of environmental protection, saving for energy resource, and high brightness.

title: Low-temperature solar energy-saving system for assisting coal-fired power generation
abstract: The invention discloses a low-temperature solar energy-saving system for assisting coal-fired power generation. A coal-fired unit and a water circulation assembly are included, the water circulation assembly includes a solar energy fan heater, a solar energy gas-gas heater and a low-temperature solar thermal collector, a water outlet of the low-temperature solar thermal collector is connected withwater inlets of the solar energy fan heater and the solar energy gas-gas heater, and a water inlet of the low-temperature solar thermal collector is connected with water outlets of the solar energy fan heater and the solar energy gas-gas heater. According to the low-temperature solar energy-saving system for assisting coal-fired power generation, clean and efficient utilization of low-temperaturesolar energy is realized, and the gap in the technical field of coupling of the low-temperature solar energy and a coal-fired power generation system is made up.

title: Salor energy-accumulating energy supply device
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy-accumulating energy supplying device, which comprises a solar energy heat collector array capable of absorbing solar energy and also comprises an energy-accumulating energy supplying device capable of accumulating the solar energy, wherein, the energy-accumulating energy supplying device is communicated with the solar energy heat collector array through a pipeline. Water is filled in an energy-accumulating tank of the energy-accumulating energy supplying device, water in the solar energy heat collector array absorbs the heat of the sun and then is changed into hot water which is conveyed to the energy-accumulating tank to be accumulated, and then the utility model supplies the hot water to a heating system in the evening or rainy weather having no the sun. The utility model has the advantages of reliable operation, reasonable economy, convenient use, high efficiency, energy saving, cleanness, no pollution, etc. The utility model can be used for the fields of solar energy greenhouses, solar energy buildings, solar energy heating and cooling systems, etc.

title: Solar energy scroll battery
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy scroll battery. The solar energy scroll battery consists of a solar energy surface, a USB interface, a battery shell and battery electrodes; the solar energy scroll battery is characterized in that the battery is formed by the scroll solar energy surface in a combination way; and the solar energy scroll battery can be used as a dry battery and a power supply.

title: Mounting structure of wall-mounted solar energy device without water tank
abstract: The invention discloses a mounting structure of a wall-mounted solar energy device without a water tank. The mounting structure comprises a support bottom plate, a solar energy fixing seat, a first support plate, a connecting disc, an angle adjusting device, an angle adjusting box, a mounting base and a counterbore hole, wherein the solar energy fixing seat and the first support plate are mountedon the support bottom plate; the solar energy fixing seat is perpendicularly mounted on the first support plate in a bolt connection manner; and the connecting disc is mounted at the upper end of thefirst support plate. The mounting structure is provided with the solar energy fixing seat, the solar energy device is in sliding fit with a T-shaped sliding rail in a snap ring to fix the solar energydevice in a clamping seat, and the angle adjusting box is controlled to adjust the pitching angle of the solar energy fixing seat, so that the orientation of the solar energy device to the sun can beadjusted, and solar energy is fully utilized. The mounting structure is easy to operate, the solar energy device is in sliding fit with the solar energy fixing seat, and when the solar energy deviceneeds to be repaired, the solar energy device is directly taken down and is convenient to repair.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: SOLAR POWER SYSTEM AND SOLAR ENERGY TRACKING METHOD
abstract: A solar power system and a solar energy chasing method. Errors may be corrected in the installation area of a solar energy collecting plate with solar cells, particularly, in the installation direction thereof. Therefore, a control angle may be operated and determined, so that the solar cells or the solar energy collecting plate may be rotated precisely in the desired direction. In the case of disposing a plurality of solar energy collecting plates, the solar energy collecting plates may be controlled according to a predetermined rotation angle, thereby increasing solar energy absorbing efficiency.

title: Solar energy and electric energy heating device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar electric heating device which comprises a device support, a solar tube is arranged on the inner wall of the device support, a cleaning mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the solar tube, a water tank is arranged on the outer surface of one end of the solar tube, and an electric heating mechanism is arranged on the outer surface of the rear end of the water tank. Connecting panels are arranged on the outer surfaces of the two ends of the water tank, an angle adjusting mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the water tank, and the cleaning mechanism comprises a lower movable frame, a cleaning cotton cushion, a push-pull handle and an upper movable frame. According to the solar electric heating device, through the cleaning mechanism and the angle adjusting mechanism, dust on the outer wall of the solar pipe can be cleaned, it is avoided that dust is attached to the solar pipe to affect solar energy utilization, then people can conveniently adjust the sunny angle of the solar pipe, and the solar energy recycling efficiency is improved.

title: Solar storage battery grass cutter
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy battery lawn cropper. A solar energy battery panel and a controlling device of the solar energy battery panel are added to traditional electric lawn cropper. The solar energy battery panel and the controlling device of the solar energy battery are fixed on a walking frame of the cropper. The current output terminal of the solar energy battery panel is connected with the input terminal of the controlling device of the solar energy battery. The output terminal of the controlling device of the solar energy battery is connected with the charging terminal of a storage battery. To obtain optimal output effect from the solar energy battery and convenient dissembling when the cropper is not used, a stand which supports the solar energy battery panel is made into an adjustable one. The utility model realizes that the solar energy battery continuously charges the storage battery when the pruning is in operation without increase to the weight capacity ratio of the storage battery of the cropper.

title: Efficient heat collection solar energy converter
abstract: In order to overcome problems which are difficult to overcome in practical application, the invention researches an efficient heat collection solar energy converter according to the development situation of solar energy converters. The technical scheme adopted by the efficient heat collection solar energy converter for solving technical problems is a novel invention that solar energy is directly converted into thermal air energy, and a third application mode of sunlight energy is exploited. The invention aims to make up the disadvantages of the existing solar energy converters, a potential market of the solar energy technology is developed, and the level of the solar energy technology advances to a more advance direction, so that the solar energy does not depend on a photovoltaic panel technology, traditional high technology is replaced and the commercial profits of solar energy are promoted to be maximized.

title: Quartz and array solar-thermal converter and method
abstract: The invention discloses a quartz and array solar-thermal converter suitable for different temperatures and a method for solar-thermal conversion by utilizing a quartz device. The solar energy is collected by fully utilizing the physicochemical properties of the quartz device, and a new technical means and method is provided for the utilization of the solar energy. The quartz device is adopted as a solar energy collecting device so as to collect solar energy at different temperatures. The quartz and array solar-thermal converter comprises a quartz device; and at least partial shell of the quartz device is provided with a solar coating to convert the solar energy into thermal energy. The invention aims to provide a solar-thermal converter suitable for different temperatures, in particular a solar-thermal converter suitable for medium and high temperature solar energy and tower and butterfly solar-thermal converters.

title: Air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary hot-water heating device
abstract: The utility model discloses an air energy heat pump solar energy complementary hot-water installation which comprises an air energy heat pump, a heat storage exchanger, a heat pump heat exchanger, a hot-water output heat exchanger, a solar energy hot-water heat exchanger, a solar energy hot-water circulating pipe, a solar energy heat collector and an expansion water tank. A heater of the air energy heat pump is connected with the heat storage exchanger. The solar energy hot-water heat exchanger and the hot-water output heat exchanger are arranged on the heat storage exchanger, and the solar energy hot-water heat exchanger is connected with the solar energy heat collector through the solar energy hot-water circulating pipe. A solar energy lower circulating pipeline is connected with the expansion water tank. The air energy heat pump solar energy complementary hot-water installation utilizes the air energy heat pump and the solar energy hot-water system to form a double energy source hot-water system. The air heat pump solar energy complementary hot-water installation not only makes full use of air heat energy, changes a direct utilization of solar energy hot-water into an indirect utilization of solar energy hot-water, improves a use ratio of the air heat energy, and meanwhile exchanges indoor air timely to keep the air fresh, but also guarantees quality of solar energy hot-water, can be heated when needing using, avoids breeding of bacteria and keeps a hot water health standard.

title: Solar Energy Substrate Aerodynamic Flaps
abstract: Methods and systems for solar energy capture. One of the systems includes a solar energy substrate mounted on a support member and one or more flap assemblies coupled to the solar energy substrate. The solar energy substrate is configured to receive solar rays from the Sun and is further configured to move in at least one direction such that an orientation of the solar energy substrate can be adjusted in accordance with a direction of the solar rays. The support member is configured to support the solar energy substrate. The one or more flap assemblies each include a flap and an actuator that is configured to move the flap relative to the solar energy substrate. Movement of the flap is controllable to counter a wind-induced moment acting on the solar energy substrate.

title: Photoelectric and photo-thermal integrated assembly
abstract: At present, in the field of solar energy application, two modes are mainly adopted, one mode is to absorb solar energy to generate electricity, and the other mode is to absorb solar heat to heat water, but the two modes cannot be combined, and precious clean energy of solar energy is wasted to a great extent. The utility model relates to the field of solar energy application, in particular to a device for converting solar energy absorbed by a solar power generation panel and a heat absorber into electric energy and heat energy, and can be widely applied to various occasions with sufficient illumination. The device is mainly composed of a solar power generation panel 1, adhesive strips 2, heat absorbers 3, heat absorption pipes 4 and a back plate 5, the adhesive strips 2 are distributed on the periphery and the middle of the back face of the solar power generation panel 1 in a strip shape, the back plate 5 is bonded to the back face of the solar power generation panel 1 to form a whole, and the heat absorbers 3 are arranged in gaps of the adhesive strips 2 and sealed between the solar power generation panel 1 and the back plate 5; when the sun exists, the solar power generation panel 1 absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy into electric energy, and the heat absorber 3 absorbs solar heat energy and stores the solar heat energy.

title: Automatic track solar energy generation device
abstract: The utility model relates to an automatic track solar energy generation device, which comprises a solar energy cell and a solar energy cell support, wherein the solar energy cell is arranged on the solar energy cell support, the east-west direction on the upper portion of the solar energy cell is provided with a photoreceptor, the photoreceptor outputs signals through the shading of a baffle plate, and output signals are used to control a step motor which horizontally rotates. The step motor drives the solar energy cell support through a gear and a semicircle rack to rotatablely adjust an east-west angle of the solar energy cell and the sun. The angle of an elevation angle of the solar energy cell support and the sun leads the pressure to increase and reduce through energy storage media phase transition to lead an expansion device to expand and change the angle of the elevation angle of a solar energy plate, thereby achieving the omnidirectional tracking of solar energy generation, and increasing 30-50 percent sunlight use ratio compared with a fixing type solar energy generation device.

title: Solar energy light-emitting diode (LED) light advertising board
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy light-emitting diode (LED) light advertising board. The solar energy LED light advertising board comprises a solar energy power supply device, an LED light, a circuit board, a resistor and an electronic circuit. The solar energy LED light advertising board is characterized in that the solar energy power supply device comprises four parts, namely, a solar energy battery pack, a controller, a storage battery and an inverter, the LED light is connected with the circuit board through the electronic circuit, the resistor is installed on the circuit board and solar panels are arranged in the solar energy battery pack. When the solar energy LED light advertising board is used, the solar energy is converted into electric energy through the solar energy power supply device to supply electric energy needed by the LED light advertising board, and the controller is arranged in the solar energy power supply device to enable the LED light advertising board to have special effects. The solar energy LED light advertising board is simple in structure, convenient to use and install, easy to operate, saving in labor, free in rising and falling, reliable and safe.

title: SOLAR ENERGY GENERATING SYSTEM FOR HIGH TEMPERATURE ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: A solar energy generation system for high temperature environment includes a solar cell and a first filter. The solar cell is disposed for photovoltaic generation. The first filter is disposed on an incident surface of the solar cell, transmits a first solar energy of an incident solar energy having a first spectrum range suitable for photovoltaic generation to the solar cell, and reflects a second solar energy having a second spectrum range except for the first spectrum range of the incident solar energy.

title: Solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy building energy-saving system and aims to provide a solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system. The solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system comprises a solar photovoltaic system and an intelligent control system which is connected with the solar photovoltaic system. The solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system further comprises a hot-cold source composite system, wherein the solar photovoltaic system and the intelligent control system are respectively connected with the hot-cold source composite system, the hot-cold source composite system comprises a solar heat collection subsystem, a heat pump heating subsystem and a heat storage or change subsystem, wherein the heat pump heating subsystem and the heat storage or change subsystem are respectively connected with the solar heat collection subsystem. The solar energy heat pump-photoelectric combined building energy-saving system realizes the combination of the solar energy heat pump and the photoelectricity in the solar energy building energy-saving system, and is a novel solar energy building energy-saving system which is efficient and energy-saving, safe and environmental-friendly, stable in operation, and convenient to implement and popularize.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: Foldable solar energy charger
abstract: The invention provides a foldable solar energy charger which comprises a base, a solar energy main panel, two solar energy auxiliary panels, two telescopic rods and an upper cover. The base is provided with a circuit board therein. The solar energy main panel is arranged above the base, and its middle part at the bottom is mounted in the middle part of the base in an elastic manner through a spring. The two solar energy auxiliary panels are symmetrically hinged at two sides of the solar energy main panel and can be folded under the solar energy main panel. The two telescopic rods are hinged on the base and at two sides of the solar energy main panel. The ends far from the base correspond to one side of edges far from the solar energy main panel for two solar energy auxiliary panels are hinged. The upper cover is mounted at the top of the base in a rotation manner and has the ability to cover the solar energy main panel, the two solar energy auxiliary panels, and the two telescopic rods. The solar energy main panel is connected to the circuit board through wires. The solar energy charger of the invention is simple in structure and convenient to use. With a changeable charging area, the charger is flexible in use and has strong practicality.

title: Solar Power System and Solar Energy Chasing Method Thereof
abstract: A solar power system and a solar energy chasing method. Errors may be corrected in the installation area of a solar energy collecting plate with solar cells, particularly, in the installation direction thereof. Therefore, a control angle may be operated and determined, so that the solar cells or the solar energy collecting plate may be rotated precisely in the desired direction. In the case of disposing a plurality of solar energy collecting plates, the solar energy collecting plates may be controlled according to a predetermined rotation angle, thereby increasing solar energy absorbing efficiency.

title: HEATING INSTALLATION OF SOLAR HEATER ASSISTED BY STOVE
abstract: The utility model discloses a heating device of solar heater assisted by stove, relating to a solar energy water heater and a stove and being composed of a heat collector, a stove, a water tank and a pipeline. The utility model combines the solar energy water heater and the stove to combine the solar energy utilization and the conventional energy or waste heat utilization to stabilize the solar energy utilization, prolonging the time of solar energy utilization and improve the solar energy utilization rate.

title: Tent structure with solar energy panels
abstract: An tent structure includes a tent, at least one solar energy panel placed on the tent structure for absorbing sunlight or other light, and a switching device, for switching solar energy to electric energy, connected to the at least one solar energy panel for transforming solar energy supplied by the solar energy panels into electric energy.

title: Solar energy-saving lamp box
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy-saving lamp box and mainly aims to provide the solar energy-saving lamp box which is powered based on solar energy. The solar energy-saving lamp box comprises a lamp box body and a solar power supply system electrically connected with the lamp box body, wherein the lamp box body is internally provided with a strip lamp, the solar power supply system is composed of a solar panel, a storage battery and a control circuit, the solar panel is used for covering the solar energy into electric energy, the storage battery is electrically connected with the solar panel and used for storing the electric energy, the storage battery is electrically connected with the strip lamp arranged in the lamp box body, the control circuit is electrically connected with the solar panel and the storage battery and used for regulating the quantity of electricity converted by the solar panel according to the electric quantity in the storage battery. The solar energy-saving lamp box disclosed by the utility model is simple and compact in structure, and power is saved as the solar energy is used as power-supply energy.

title: Solar energy component and solar energy terminal
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy component and solar energy terminal to richen the color of solar energy component product, improve the matching in color nature of solar energy component andbuilding. Solar energy component includes: relative transparent front bezel and the backplate that sets up and connect the vacuole formation structure through the frame to and set up the solar cell chip who is close to cavity structure one side in transparent front bezel or backplate, wherein: have the interval between solar cell chip and the frame, solar cell chip includes along keeping away from the colored encapsulated layer of substrate, cell layer and printing opacity that the backplate direction set gradually.

title: Solar cooling and drying equipment for premounting transformer substation
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar-energy cooling moisture-removing device of a prepackage type transformer substation, which comprises a humiture control system, a solar energy power supply comprises a solar energy battery plate, a solar energy controller, an accumulator and an inverter, wherein the solar energy battery plate is connected with the solar energy controller, the solar energy controller is connected with the inverter and the accumulator, and the inverter is connected with the humiture control system. The solar-energy cooling moisture-removing device adopts solar energy which is a green energy source, and the solar energy is inexhaustible, which can be regenerated, reduces the emission of contaminant, and is beneficial for environmental protection and sustainable development. When an electrified wire netting is in service interruption or a prepackage type transformer substation running, electrical equipment in a station can be normally cooled down and dehumidified, the solar-energy cooling moisture-removing device prevents dewing, improves the reliability of prepackage type transformer substation equipment, and guarantees the safe operation of an electrified wire netting.

title: Method and device for applying solar energy to moxibustion therapy
abstract: The invention discloses a device for applying solar energy to moxibustion therapy, which comprises a focusing device, the focusing device gathers the solar energy to the input end of a solar energy conveying pipeline, the solar energy conveying pipeline extends into a treatment room and is connected with the treatment room, and the output end of the solar energy conveying pipeline is connected with a mounting cavity. And an adjusting assembly is mounted at the front end of the mounting cavity. The focusing device is adopted for focusing, and the solar energy is conveyed through the solar energy conveying pipeline and is finally used for moxibustion therapy, so that solar energy is used for moxibustion therapy.

title: Novel solar energy heat collection module
abstract: A novel solar energy heat collection module comprises a solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module and a water replenishment sub-module; the solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module has the functions of absorbing solar energy sunlight-heat resources, gathering heat and storing hot water, and the water replenishment sub-module has the functions of replenishing water and storing the hot water for the solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module. By utilizing the novel solar energy heat collection module, a solar energy water heater single machine or a solar energy heat collection engineering system can be assembled, and by utilizing the solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module, the solar energy water heater single machine and the solar energy heat collection engineering system can be assembled as well. The novel solar energy heat collection module has the advantages of being rigorous and simple in structure, small in size, and beneficial to overall insulation treatment.

title: Solar strong effect extension concentration apparatus
abstract: The invention discloses a powerful solar energy extending photospot device; a shell is internally provided with a group of solar energy collecting devices and an extension condenser lens. The upper part of the solar energy integrator is provided with an extension condenser lens which is fixedly arranged on an adjustable frame; the adjustable frame can adjust the extension condenser lens towards the solar source; the extension condenser lens can integrate solar energy into the solar energy collecting devices and can effectively shorten the distance between the condenser and the solar energy collecting devices to lead a solar energy generator or a collector to emit times of electric energy and heat energy.

title: Photovoltaic module's snow removing awakening device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the solar facilities and specifically relates to a photovoltaic module's snow removing awakening device, including preventing snow solar energy electroplax, main solar energy electroplax and electric fan heater, prevent the special angle of snow solar energy electroplax, it all installs in the support frame to prevent snow solar energy electroplax and main solar energy electroplax, the electric fan heater with prevent that snow solar energy electroplax passes through the wire and links to each other, just the main solar energy electroplax of air outlet orientation of electric fan heater. This device, it is with low costs, and can clear away the snow on the main solar energy electroplax effectively, in time, and guarantee the normal work of main solar energy electroplax, improve life.

title: Solar energy advertising board
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy advertising board, and relates to the technical field of outdoor advertising boards. The solar energy advertising board comprises a supporting pillar, a lower transverse rod is transversely installed at the top end of the supporting pillar, a tabulate supporting frame is installed on the lower transverse rod in the vertical direction, an upper transverse rod is transversely installed on the supporting frame, and a solar energy cell panel is installed at the top end of the upper transverse rod in the horizontal direction. A lamp holder is installed on the bottom of the solar energy cell panel, an energy-saving lamp is installed on the lamp holder, and the solar energy cell panel is connected with the energy-saving lamp through a conducting wire and a switch. The solar energy advertising board is provided with the solar energy cell panel, electricity can be generated through solar energy to provide a power supply for the illuminating lamp on the solar energy advertising board, and therefore, energy conservation and environment protection are achieved. Besides, the solar energy cell panel is installed horizontally, part of the solar energy advertising board, located below the solar energy cell panel, is prevented from being exposed to the sun and rain, and the service life of advertising paper on the solar energy advertising board is prolonged.

title: Solar energy electric fan
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy electric fan. The solar energy electric fan comprises a fan body and a base, wherein the fan body is connected with the base through a vertical column. The solar energy electric fan further comprises a solar panel which is arranged on a surface of the base, an inverter which is connected with the solar panel and a storage battery, and the storage battery is connected with the solar panel, the inverter, a motor in the fan body and a switch device into a circuit loop. By means of the solar energy electric fan, the solar energy is used as a power supply, the energy is fully used, the energy consumption is reduced, and the environment is protected. The solar energy electric fan is applicable to various occasions.

title: Solar street lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar street lamp, including lamp pole (1), lamp pole (1) side is connected with lamp (2), lamp pole (1) top is connected with solar cell panel assembly device (3), solar energy assembly device (3) including solar energy electroplax (31) and with company's board (32) that solar energy electroplax (31) are connected, be provided with a cleaning device on connecting plate (32), cleaning device is used for getting rid of dust on the solar energy electroplax. This device is provided with cleaning device, can clear away the dust on the solar energy electroplax, improves solar energy conversion efficiency, this device is provided with automatic tracking apparatus, can make the solar energy electroplax always just to the sun, and the sunshine intensity that the solar energy electroplax was received has improved solar energy conversion efficiency for the strongest.

title: Dual -purpose tealeaves drying -machine of solar energy and electric energy
abstract: The utility model discloses a dual -purpose tealeaves drying -machine of solar energy and electric energy, including flourishing flitch of box, six and electrothermal tube, be provided with solar cell on the box and be used for placing solar cell's recess, solar cell takes out in can following the recess, the last solar energy that is equipped with of solar cell absorbs the board, be equipped with solar energy switch and electric energy switch on the box. The utility model discloses a modularization solar cell's design utilizes solar energy as the energy, has not only reduced the operating cost, has avoided production industrial pollution moreover to possess two kinds of modes of solar energy and electric energy simultaneously, guaranteed the continuity of tealeaves drying -machine function.

title: Household solar energy power source based on transparent thin-film solar cell
abstract: The invention provides a household solar energy power source based on a transparent thin-film solar cell. The household solar energy power source utilizes the transparent thin-film solar cell to generate power so as to supply electric energy to buildings; and the household solar energy power source is driven to work by solar energy and does not need an external power source, so that the energy consumption of the buildings is reduced, and the household solar energy power source has the advantages of low carbon, energy saving and environmental friendliness.

title: TARPAULIN SOLAR ENERGY GENERATION SYSTEM AND SOLAR TENT
abstract: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide a tarpaulin solar energy generation system and a solar tent. In the tarpaulin solar energy generation system, one or more solar components are fixed on the tarpaulin and adapted to receive light energy, and a controller is connected to each of the solar components and an energy storage battery and adapted to convert electrical energy generated by the solar components and to store the converted electrical energy in the energy storage battery.

title: New energy container with solar energy
abstract: The utility model discloses a new energy container with solar energy, and particularly relates to the technical field of containers, which comprises a solar container body, a first fixing block is fixedly connected to the top end of the solar container body, a damping rotating shaft block is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the first fixing block, and a first gear disc is fixedly connected to one side of the damping rotating shaft block. A second gear disc is arranged on the side edge of the first gear disc, a water collecting plate is arranged on the inner wall of the fixing plate, and a solar photovoltaic panel is arranged on the inner wall of the water collecting plate. Through mutual cooperation of a first fixing block, a water collecting tank block, a water collecting pipe and a second fixing block, an operator can adjust the inclination angle of a solar photovoltaic panel by rotating a rotating handle, then the solar photovoltaic panel can better receive sunlight irradiation, the working efficiency of the solar photovoltaic panel is improved, and the practicability of the solar photovoltaic panel is improved. And therefore, the operating personnel can save the original working time for adjusting the solar photovoltaic panel, and the working efficiency of the device is greatly improved.

title: Solar energy collecting device and electric vehicle with same
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy collecting device and an electric vehicle with the same. The solar energy collecting device comprises a frame body, a cover plate, a first solar panel, a second solar panel and a storage battery. Wherein the frame body is hollow, the cover plate is connected with the frame body, the first solar panel is connected with the cover plate, and the second solarpanel is connected with the first solar panel. And when the solar energy collecting device is completely unfolded, the solar panel can convert solar energy into electric energy to the greatest extentand store the electric energy in the storage battery. When the solar energy collecting device is stored, the solar panels are overlapped together and are stored in the containing space, and the coverplate covers the containing space. The electric vehicle comprises a solar energy collecting device, a driving device and a guiding device, and the driving device is electrically connected with the storage battery. According to the solar energy collecting device and the electric vehicle and the electric vehicle with the solar energy collecting device, pure solar energy driving can be achieved, thesolar panel can be completely stored when not used, and normal driving of the electric vehicle cannot be affected.

title: Fixed frame of putting of solar energy electroplax with protect function
abstract: The utility model discloses a fixed frame of putting of solar energy electroplax with protect function, put fixing device including solar energy, solar energy is put fixing device and is included thatsolar energy puts the frame, solar energy is put the inside of frame and has been seted up the inner chamber, the inside of inner chamber is equipped with the fixed inner tower of solar energy, the fixed inner tower of solar energy is including the sclerosis bottom plate. The utility model discloses solar panel to inside carries out effectual protection, and the clear glass safety cover is transparency clarity, it carries out the solar energy power generation operation not influence solar panel on daytime, control solar panel faces the below, make the sclerosis bottom plate be located the top, thereby the solar panel to inside protects through the sclerosis bottom plate, prevent solar panel's damage, protect function's advantage has been reached, thereby the effectual fixed device of putting of current solar energy electroplax of having solved does not possess protect function and causes the problem that the solar energy electroplax damages influence the use of solar energy electroplax easily.

title: Umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard catamaran
abstract: The invention relates to an umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard catamaran which belongs to the technical field of ship architecture and ocean engineering equipment. The umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard catamaran comprises a single hull, a hull connecting frame, a universal joint, a main upright rod, an umbrella-shaped framework, a pull rod, a sleeve, a pulling cable, an umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard, solar energy photovoltaic arrays, a windlass, a hydraulic oil cylinder, a solar energy sail, a support bracket, a sunlight sensor and a direction controller. The umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard and the solar energy sail are installed on the catamaran, and the solar energy photovoltaic arrays are respectively installed on the umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard and the solar energy sail. The wind energy and the solar energy are cooperatively utilized for the ship propelling, and the catamaran is driven completely by green energy resources without conventional energy resource consumption and is a green ship without discharging pollution. The invention has great scientific research value, great industrial application prospect and great economic and social benefits.

title: Concentration type solar energy cogeneration device
abstract: The utility model relates to a concentration type solar energy cogeneration device, which belongs to the technical field of solar energy photovoltaic power generation and solar energy heat collection. The concentration type solar energy cogeneration device comprises a multifunctional solar energy conversion plate and a group of plain mirrors, wherein the solar energy conversion plate comprises a piece of protection glass, a solar energy battery, an electrode lead wire, a binder layer, a tube type heat absorption plate, a heat insulation layer and a housing. In the utility model, radiation quantity irradiated on unit area of a solar energy battery board is increased by more than three times through the four plain mirrors at first, so that the actual photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar energy battery can reach the maximum value; and then the heat of the solar energy battery board is rapidly absorbed through the tube type heat absorption plate at the back of the solar energy battery board, not only is the working temperature of the solar energy battery reduced, but also domestic water can be heated. Therefore, the recycling of waste heat generated during operation of the solar energy battery board can be realized, and the comprehensive utilization efficiency of solar energy can be substantially improved.

title: Solar energy traffic warning board
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy traffic warning board, belonging to the technical field of traffic signal. The solar energy traffic warning board comprises a solar cell module, a solar energy intelligent controller, a energy storage accumulator and a light emitting diode group, wherein, the solar cell module is arranged on the top of the traffic warning board and faces to the best directionwhich can receive the sun light, the solar cell module is connected with the solar energy intelligent controller through wires and the solar energy intelligent controller is connected with the energystorage accumulator and the light emitting diode group through wires. The solar cell module charges the energy storage accumulator through the solar energy intelligent controller and the electrical energy of the energy storage accumulator is output to the light emitting diode group through the solar energy intelligent controller and is used to control the light emitting diode group to generate warning and illuminating effects. The invention does not need commercial power, can run only by the electrical energy generated from solar energy and has the advantages of long service life, energy-saving, environmental friend, low cost and the like.

title: Asphalt processing method using solar energy for heating
abstract: The invention discloses an asphalt processing method using solar energy for heating. A solar cell panel, a solar heat absorption coating and a heat collector are included, and the solar cell panel isused for absorbing solar energy; the heat collector is coated with a solar heat absorption coating, and solar energy is converted into heat energy through the heat collector. The asphalt processing method comprises the steps that 1 the solar cell panel absorbs solar energy, the heat collector is coated with the solar heat absorption coating, and the solar energy is converted into heat energy through the heat collector; 2 the asphalt stored in a large tank is heated; and 3 heat energy in the tank body is focused, so that the asphalt flows, and the flowing asphalt flows into a small tank body. The asphalt processing method has the advantages that air pollution caused by combustion of coal and natural gas is reduced, the solar heat absorption coating with the model of RLHY-2337 is used, the heat collector is helped to absorb solar heat, the efficiency of converting solar energy into heat energy is improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title: Solar energy sound box
abstract: An embodiment of the present utility model discloses a solar energy sound box which comprises a solar energy cell panel and a sound box main body, and the solar energy cell panel is fixedly connected with the sound box main body. The solar energy sound box is power-supplied by the solar energy cell panel, the solar energy cell panel is fixedly connected with the sound box main body, thus solar energy sound box is beautiful as a whole.

title: Method of heat collection of landscape solar energy
abstract: The invention provides a method of heat collection of landscape solar energy. A rattan-type plant is planted below the solar energy heat collector in spring. The rattan-type plant continues to grow by climbing on the solar energy heat collector through a gap of the solar energy heat collector after the plant grows in summer. Part of the sunlight can be blocked by leaves of the plant. The sunlight irradiating on the solar energy heat collector is reduced. Heat production of the solar energy heat collector is proper. According to the method of the heat collection of the landscape solar energy, the solar energy can be fully used for collecting heat. Redundant sunlight in summer can further be used for planting the plant at the same time. In summer, the solar energy heat collector can be used for collecting the heat. The redundant sunlight can be used for planting the plant and absorbing the carbon dioxide, thus the fault rate of the solar energy heat collector is reduced. Service life is prolonged. The complete solar energy heat collector area is exposed. The solar energy plays the largest role.

title: Device for utilization of solar energy
abstract: In the present invention, there is disclosed a device for utilization of solar energy. particularly for conversion thereof to thermal energy or electric power, said device comprising a solar energy absorber (A) and an optical means (OM) arranged upstream said solar energy absorber (A) and intended for concentration of solar energy. Said solar energy concentrating optical means (OM), comprising a system of side-by-side arranged optical converging lenses (1), is arranged reversibly adjustable between the position in front of the solar energy absorber (A) and outside of said solar energy absorber (A).

title: Heating method for solar floor
abstract: The invention discloses a heating method for a solar floor. The heating method can comprise the steps that solar energy is absorbed through an energy absorbing unit; the absorbed solar energy is transmitted to an energy receiving unit through an energy transmitting unit; the solar energy received by the energy receiving unit is stored through an energy storage unit; and the energy storage unit releases heat to heat a solar base plate. The heating method has the advantages that the solar energy is convenient to collect and free of pollution; solar energy resources are abundant and can be used for a long time; and air pollution is reduced, and air quality is improved.

title: Solar alternating-current battery capable of improving six-time absorption, storage and release of solar energy
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of utilization of space solar energy, particularly relates to a solar alternating current battery capable of improving 6 times of absorption, storage and release of solar energy, and aims to solve the problems that the solar energy absorbed, stored and released by the existing solar energy cannot be effectively converted and the utilization rate of the solar energy is reduced. The solar power generation panel is of a hexagonal pyramid-shaped structure, and the bottom of the solar power generation panel is connected with a solar cell main body; a solar (alternating current) cell panel which is in a hexagonal pyramid shape and can absorb solar energy by 6 times is butted to the surface of a hexagonal solar cell body, so that the solar energy can be absorbed, stored and released by 6 times. The six-prismatic-shaped solar cell is adopted to improve the solar cell characteristics of absorbing, storing and releasing solar energy by 6 times, creativity, permanency, cleanness, environment friendliness, safety, flexibility and long service life are achieved, electric energy can be generated as long as solar radiation and lamplight exist, and charging is not needed.

title: A SOLAR POWERED LIGHTING SYSTEM
abstract: Abstract 5 A solar powered lighting system includes a solar module adapted to receive solar energy and transform received solar energy into electrical energy and a lighting module. The lighting module is electrically coupled to the solar module and is configurable to emit light using electrical energy generated by the solar module only while the solar module receives solar energy. The solar module and the lighting 10 module are electrically couplable such that light emitted from the lighting module mimics a characteristic of sunlight from which the solar energy is received. 921801 Prov 162 162' 114'

title: Luminous energy tree of charging of solar energy
abstract: The utility model discloses a luminous energy tree of charging of solar energy, including the metal tree body and set up the solar photovoltaic system on the metal tree body, LED lighting system, music broadcast system and setting up in the stake of charging of the cell-phone of metal tree body side, said solar photovoltaic system includes the two glass subassemblies of solar energy, battery and solar control ware, and the two glass subassemblies of solar energy set up on the top of the metal tree body, and battery and solar control ware set up in the metal tree internally, the PV input of solar control ware is connected to the output of the two glass subassemblies of solar energy, holds the BAT input that the solar control ware is connected to the battery output end, the solar control ware respectively with LED lighting system, the charge power end connection of stake of music broadcast system and cell-phone the utility model discloses not only can realize the illumination and the transform of light, can also realize that the cell-phone charges and music instant music, give people the life and offer convenience

title: Solar energy window using plastic solar batteries
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar energy generation and electric energy transformation application, in particular to a solar energy window which uses plastic solar batteries, and comprises a window frame, a plastic solar battery board, louver boards, a transformation circuit, solar accumulators and an integrated circuit, wherein the window frame and the louver boards are arranged on the plastic solar batteries, the transformation circuit and the solar accumulators are arranged in the window frame, and the louvre boards and the window frame are all arranged on the integrated circuit. Absorbed solar energy is transported to electrical energy through the integrated circuit and is stored in the solar accumulators. The solar energy window has simple structure and high utilization rate of solar energy, saves energy, protects environment, and has strong practicality.

title: Environment-friendly and energy-saving air energy and solar energy device
abstract: The utility model relates to an environment-friendly and energy-saving air energy solar device which comprises a solar cold water tank and a solar water heater arranged on one side of the solar cold water tank, the solar cold water tank and a solar hot water pipe are connected with a temperature adjusting box through liquid guide pipes, an adjusting frame is installed in the temperature adjusting box and is of a sealed structure, and the solar water heater is connected with the adjusting frame. A liquid inlet hole and a liquid outlet hole are formed in the adjusting frame, the solar water heater is connected with the liquid inlet hole through a liquid guide pipe, a first temperature sensor is installed at the liquid inlet hole, a flow velocity sensor is installed at the liquid outlet hole, the solar cold water tank is communicated with the interior of the adjusting frame, and a heating pipe is installed in the adjusting frame and is an annular pipe. The first temperature sensor, the heating pipe and the flow velocity sensor are all connected with the PLC. The utility model relates to the technical field of solar equipment. Cold water in the hot water pipe is heated, and when hot water in the hot water pipe flows out, the heating pipe is automatically powered off, so that waste of water resources is reduced.

title: Solar guardrail
abstract: The invention discloses a solar guardrail which is characterized by comprising a guardrail body and a solar collection mechanism (4). Two ends of the guardrail body are embedded into a wall of a balcony, the solar collection mechanism (4) is positioned in the guardrail body, the solar collection mechanism (4) can collect solar energy, and liquid in the solar collection mechanism (4) is heated through the solar energy. The solar guardrail is mounted on the balcony and can function in protection, and the solar energy can be converted into heat energy or electric energy by the solar guardrail.

title: PORTABLE MODULAR SUN-TRACKING SOLAR ENERGY RECEIVER SYSTEM
abstract: A portable solar energy generation system has a solar energy receiver having a plurality of solar cells for converting solar energy into a DC voltage. A solar tracking mechanism enables the solar energy receiver to track a position of the sun with respect to the solar cells and to position the solar cells responsive thereto. Power circuitry generates at least one output voltage to power an electronic device responsive to the DC voltage. A housing contains each of the solar energy receiver, the solar tracking mechanism and the power circuitry in a portable configuration.

title: Solar energy receiving tube fixation unit and device for solar energy receiving tube
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy receiving tube fixation unit and a device for a solar energy receiving tube. The solar energy receiving tube fixation unit for fixing at least one solar energy receiving tube, and the solar energy receiving tube comprises an outer receiving tube surface. The solar energy receiving tube fixation unit comprises a fixation surface, and the fixation surface is at least partially formed into be opposite to the surface of the outer solar energy receiving tube surface of the solar energy receiving tube. The fixation surface comprises an elastomer fixation material.

title: Solar energy flashlight
abstract: The invention relates to flashlights, particularly to a solar energy flashlight. According to the solar energy flashlight, a flashlight body is in a cuboid shaped, two outer surfaces of the flashlight body are provided with solar panels, which can absorb solar energy and convert the solar energy into electric energy for powering the flashlight body. The solar energy flashlight achieves power supply in a battery and solar energy mixed mode, and accordingly, can be powered by dry batteries when solar batteries cannot supply enough power due to continuous rainy days and further prolong the continuous working time. The solar energy flashlight is simple, practical, safe, environmentally friendly and applicable to field environments.

title: Solar energy collector
abstract: A solar energy collector comprises a glass membrane, a solar energy collecting device and a window frame, and is characterized in that the glass membrane is connected with the solar energy collecting device, solar energy collecting wires are implanted in the inner layer of the glass membrane for collecting solar energy, the solar energy is transmitted to a conversion device, the conversion device converts the solar energy into electric energy, the electric energy is stored in an electricity storage device connected with the conversion device, the electricity storage device is provided with a switch, and the electric energy is transmitted to electricity-utilization equipment by switching on the switch. Compared with the prior art, the solar energy collector has significant advantages and beneficial effects that the solar energy collected by the solar energy collecting wires are converted into electric energy in the conversion device, the electric energy is transmitted to the electricity storage device, the electricity storage device is provided with the switch, the electric energy transmitted by the conversion device is stored in the electricity storage device when the switch is switched off, and the stored electric energy is transmitted the electricity-utilization equipment when the switch is switched on.

title: Solar air conditioner
abstract: The invention provides a solar air conditioner. The solar air conditioner comprises an indoor unit, an outdoor unit, a compressor and an evaporator; the solar air conditioner further comprises a solarpipeline, a photovoltaic module arranged on the top of the solar pipeline, a heat collection pipe assembly arranged at the bottom of the solar pipeline and a heat collection sheet arranged on the heat collection pipe assembly; the solar pipeline is used for enabling a refrigerant to circulate; the photovoltaic module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; and the heat collection pipe assembly and the heat collection sheet are used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into heat energy. By adopting the solar air conditioner, a large amount of solar energy can be converted into electric energy, not only can enough energy be supplied to the air conditioner for use, but also a large amount of redundant electric energy can be generated and output to theoutside, and the economic benefit of the solar air conditioner is improved.

title: Solar electric source device of super capacitor
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy power device for a super capacitor, which relates to a solar power generation. The method is that the maximum power of the solar power system is traced in dynamic balance way. An intelligence type charging and discharging mechanism is added according to the method to form an intelligence type coordination style solar energy device. The utility model at least comprises a solar energy board, an ultra-capacitor, a direct-current/step-up step-down converter, a pulse width modulation driver, an accumulator cell, a logic controller, and a load. The electric energy produced by the solar energy board is converted into the capacitor form electric energy to calculate the maximum power, and the calculation procedure can be simplified greatly. The real-time and the reliability degree of the tracing calculation are promoted, and the solar energy system efficiency is gained. The utility model can be widely applied to a solar energy LED lamp and a solar energy lamp, in particular to a solar energy street lamp, a street lamp, a solar energy traffic signal lamp, and a solar energy project light, etc.

title: Solar energy sunlight shining device capable of promoting solar radiation energy
abstract: A solar energy sunlight shining device capable of promoting solar radiation energy is composed of a solar energy support. A solar energy facility is installed within the range of the solar energy support. A sunlight receiving screen and a sunlight shining device are installed on the periphery of the solar energy support. Angles of the sunlight shining device are capable of being adjusted. The sunlight shining device is composed of a connecting support and a sunlight shining screen. Angles of the connecting support and the sunlight shining screen are capable of being adjusted. The sunlight receiving screen and the sunlight shining screen are made of metal mirror materials. The solar energy sunlight shining device is characterized in that the solar energy facility is directly shined by sunlight and can be shined by radiation light reflected by the sunlight shining screen at the same time, and therefore the solar energy facility can be radiated by dual lights of the sunlight and the sunlight shining. When in extreme weather in winter, the solar energy sunlight shining device is capable of receiving a strong heat value effect like in summer. The solar energy sunlight shining device is widely applied for devices such as solar energy battery electricity generation and solar water heater.

title: Solar energy lighting lamp
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy lighting lamp. The solar energy lighting lamp mainly comprises a solar panel, a processor and an led lamp. The solar energy lighting lamp is characterized in that the processor is arranged in the lighting lamp, the solar panel is arranged on the surface of the lighting lamp, the led lamp is arranged in the middle of the lighting lamp, during using, the solarpanel absorbs solar energy, the processor converts the solar energy into electrical energy and supplies the electrical energy for the led light, and convenience is brought to people.

title: SOLAR ENERGY PHOTOVOLTAIC CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: A solar energy photovoltaic (PV) control system includes a solar energy absorption board configured to receive solar energy from solar rays and transfer solar energy to voltage/current signals, a motor, a voltage/current collecting circuit connected to the solar energy absorption board to receive the voltage/current signals therefrom, a micro control unit (MCU) connected to the voltage/current collecting circuit to receive the voltage/current signals therefrom, and a motor driver connected between the MCU and the motor. The solar energy absorption board is fixed on the motor and the motor drives the solar energy absorption board to pivot. The MCU controls the motor driver to drive the motor to adjust the angle between incoming solar rays and the solar energy absorption board to place the solar energy absorption board to directly face the sun according to the collected voltage/current signals.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Automatic beam condensing unit, solar device and solar energy system of solar energy trail
abstract: The utility model provides an automatic beam condensing unit, solar device and solar energy system of solar energy trail, belongs to solar energy technical field. The beam condensing unit of automatic tracking solar energy includes light concentrating sheet, the metal light concentrating sheet that light concentrating sheet changes along with the change of temperature for bending angle. The utility model provides an automatic beam condensing unit, solar device and solar energy system of solar energy trail does not additionally need, and consumption of electric energy trails the sun.

title: IMPROVED SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTORS AND METHODS FOR SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEMS
abstract: The present invention offers improved absorber plates for solar energy collectors, improved cover glazings for solar energy collectors, improved concentrating solar energy collectors, and solar energy collection methods that use one or more of the improved solar energy collectors for useful residential, commercial, and industrial applications. The improved absorber plate solar energy collectors utilize a 3-dimensional porous metal to improve solar radiant absorption collection and utilization, the improved concentrating solar energy collectors are Fresnel lens faced ducts of various geometries that enable efficient axial length solar energy collection, and the improved cover glazings utilize transparent front and back faces with other insulating property improvements to enable increased solar radiant energy harvest per unit front face cover area of solar collector.

title: Solar camera
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring equipment, and particularly relates to a solar camera. The camera comprises a camera body and a solar cell panel. The solar cell panel is arranged on the upper end face of the camera body, and the solar cell panel is electrically connected with a battery assembly in the camera body; the solar cell panel can convert solar energy into electric energy and store the converted electric energy in the cell module. The solar panel in the solar camera can absorb solar energy, convert the solar energy into electric energy and charge the converted electric energy into the battery assembly of the camera body, so that the camera body is provided with the electric energy required by the camera body during working, and the solar camera can operate normally without pulling a lead; therefore, the installation of the solar camera is simpler and more convenient.

title: Solar energy corn thresher
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy corn thresher. The corn thresher is characterized by including a solar energy battery plate, an inverter, a storage battery, a controller and a spiral thresher,and the solar energy corn thresher can convert the solar energy into electric energy to be stored in the storage battery so as to supply electric energy for the thresher; when the solar energy corn thresher is not used, the solar energy assemblies can supply electric energy for domestic lighting and other devices and input the electric energy into a power network. The thresher has the advantagesthat all energy consumption is from the solar energy, which is clean and safe, when the solar energy corn thresher is not used, the thresher can supply electric energy to other equipment or input theelectric energy into power network, and the problem of energy shortage can be efficiently solved.

title: Solar energy charging battery
abstract: The solar energy charging battery comprises a casing, at least one solar energy plate, a circuit plate, a battery core, the solar enery plate is arranged on the casing for absorbing the solar energy and converting to the electric energy, the circuit plate is provided with a boosted circuit and a charging circuit, the boosted circuit is electrically connected with the solar energy plate and the charging circuit, the battery core is electrically connected with the charging circuit for storing the electric energy. The solar energy charging battery absorbs the solar energy and converts to the electric energy, then stores the electric energy in the battery core through the charging circuit, with simple structure, and is convenient for compensating the electric energy.

title: Solar air conditioning and water heating system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar-energy air conditioner hot water system, which is formed by a solar-energy collector and an air conditioner hot water device. Wherein, said solar-energy collector can be solar-energy collector or the solar-energy photo-voltaic cell; the solar-energy collector is matched with the air conditioner hot water device, to be managed by the microcomputer controller. The invention realizes the intelligent integration and compensation between solar-energy technique and central air conditioning technique.

title: Adjustable solar streetlight
abstract: The utility model relates to an adjustable solar energy road lamp, which belongs to a municipal illuminating device. The utility model comprises a road lamp and a road lamp post thereof which is provided with a solar energy board, a solar energy charging battery and a photosensitizing controllable switch, wherein the solar energy board is arranged on the top part of the road lamp post and the surface of the upper part, the solar energy charging battery is arranged on the upper part of the road lamp post, the photosensitizing controllable switch is arranged under the solar energy board, the solar energy board is connected with the solar energy charging battery by conducting wires, and the solar energy charging battery, the photosensitizing controllable switch and the road lamp are connected in series on a control circuit of the road lamp by conducting wires. The utility model uses the reproducible green energy resource which is solar energy as a power source. The utility model absorbs the solar energy at daytime with sufficient light irradiation and converts the solar energy into electric energy for storage. The utility model releases the electric energy after dusk for the illumination of the road lamp. The utility model has the characteristics of energy saving and environment protection.

title: MOUNTING STRUCTURE FOR SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTING PIPE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a mounting structure for a solar energy collecting pipe allowing the mounting of the solar energy collecting pipe on the reverse of a solar energy collecting plate in a well workable manner without causing the separation of the solar energy collecting plate even when warped by heat.

SOLUTION: The mounting structure for the solar energy collecting pipe comprises the solar energy collecting pipe 3 arranged on the reverse of the solar energy collecting plate 1, a fin 2 placed covering the solar energy collecting pipe 3, and a box 4 covering the solar energy collecting plate 1 at its reverse. The expandable foam solar energy insulating material is filled in a closed space formed by the heat collecting plate 1 and the box 4 and foamed, and the pressure of volume expansion due to the foaming is used for press bonding the solar energy collecting pipe 3 to the reverse of the solar energy collecting plate 1 via the fin 2.

title: Solar bicycle
abstract: The invention provides a solar bicycle, which comprises a bicycle body, a DC motor and a storage battery, wherein the DC motor and the storage battery are arranged on the bicycle body; the solar bicycle further comprises an automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system, wherein the automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system is arranged on the bicycle body, and the automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system is connected with the storage battery by means of a control circuit. Compared with the prior art, electric energy is provided to a power system of the solarbicycle finally by means of the automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system, efficient conversion of solar energy is realized, the utilization efficiency of solar energy is improved, the energy recourse is saved, the structure is simple, energy consumption can be reduced, and the cost is saved. The automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system can automatically complete the collection of solar energy; a solar tube can be adjusted according to time and sunlight illumination angles, and the utilization and conversion efficiency of the solar energy can be effectively improved;and the solar bicycle has the advantages of simple structure, low manufacturing cost, high popularization performance, and wide application range.

title: Solar energy monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy monitoring system which comprises a solar panel, monitoring equipment, a solar energy controller and a power transformation controller. The solar panel is located at the front end of the solar energy monitoring system and is used for supplying power to the solar energy monitoring system. The monitoring equipment is electrically connected with the terminal ofthe solar energy monitoring system. The solar energy controller comprises an input end and an output end. The power transformation controller comprises an input module and an output module. One end ofthe input module is electrically connected with the solar panel, and the other end of the input module is electrically connected with the input end of the solar controller. One end of the output module is electrically connected with the output end of the solar energy controller, and the other end of the output module is electrically connected with the monitoring equipment. The solar energy monitoring system has the characteristics of simple structure, less energy consumption and higher efficiency.

title: High-efficiency solar energy collecting plate
abstract: The utility model provides a high-efficiency solar energy collecting plate, comprising an energy collecting plate which is vertical to solar rays, and the solar energy collecting plate is characterized in that: vertical light reflecting plates are arranged at the left side, the right side and the back side of the energy collecting plate. By adopting the vertical light reflecting plates which are arranged at the left side, the right side and the back side of the energy collecting plate, the solar rays in different seasons and times are reflected to the energy collecting plate, thereby efficiently increasing the energy collecting efficiency of the energy collecting plate, meanwhile, the high-efficiency solar energy collecting plate has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, reliable performance and the like, therefore, the high-efficiency solar energy collecting plate is an effective way to increase the efficiency of the solar energy collecting plate with low cost and can provide enough solar thermal energy for a solar energy generator and a solar energy water heater.

title: Solar energy collecting board
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy collecting board, belonging to the field of solar energy utilization. The solar energy collecting board comprises a bracket and a solar collecting board arranged on the bracket, wherein the outside surface of the solar collecting board is conical. The solar energy collecting board is designed to an array configuration. By adopting the invention, the collecting area of the solar energy and the output power of the solar power generation device are increased on the limited floor space; and most of the scattered light and reflected light of the sunlight are absorbed by the neighboring surface of the solar collecting board, thus increasing the utilization rate of the solar energy.

title: Solar panel charging display device and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a solar panel charging display device and a use method thereof. The solar panel charging display device comprises a solar panel, an energy storage module, a measuring module and a display module, wherein the solar panel can convert solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage module is connected with the solar panel so as to store the electric energy generated by the solar panel; the measuring module is connected with the solar panel and the energy storage module; the measuring module is used for measuring an electric signal value of the electric energy transmitted to the energy storage module by the solar panel; the display module is connected with the measuring module and dynamically displays the electric signal value measured by the measuring module, and therefore, a user can easily know the relation between the placing position or the angle of the solar panel and the electric energy quantity generated by the solar panel.

title: Solar energy and geothermal energy complementary energy storage equipment
abstract: The invention provides solar energy and geothermal energy complementary energy storage equipment. The equipment comprises a solar device, a heat exchange pipe, a geothermal well and a circulating pump; the two ends of the heat exchange pipe are respectively connected with an outlet end and an inlet end of the solar device; the bottom of the heat exchange pipe goes deep into the geothermal well; and the circulating pump is mounted on a loop of the heat exchange pipe. According to the equipment, the circulating pump pushes water to circulate; cold water enters the solar device from the outlet ofthe heat exchange pipe so as to absorb heat; after the water temperature is raised, the water is circulated into the geothermal well from the inlet of the heat exchange pipe and undergoes heat exchange with the geothermal water through the pipe wall; and after the geothermal water is heated, the water returns to the solar device. The equipment is capable of realizing the combination of medium andlow-temperature geothermal energy and solar energy, heating the geothermal water by utilizing the solar energy, and storing the energy by utilizing the geothermal well, so as to solve the heat energyutilization problems of regions lack of heat, sufficiently utilize the geothermal energy and the solar energy, and decrease the pollution caused by conventional energy.

title: Solar hollow brick
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar hollow brick which comprises a cavity and solar cells, and at least part of the solar cells are located in the cavity. The utility model provides a solar hollow brick. The solar cells are arranged in the solar hollow brick; at least part of the solar cell pieces are located in the cavity, solar energy is radiated to the solar cell pieces through the solar hollowbrick, and the solar cell pieces convert the solar energy into electric energy for use, so that the solar hollow brick has the function of converting the solar energy into the electric energy, and the functions of the solar hollow brick are enriched. Meanwhile, the cavity of the solar hollow brick can protect the solar cells in the cavity, such as water resistance, dust resistance and the like.
