title: Solar energy comprehensive utilization device and control method
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy comprehensive utilization device and a control method, and relates to the technical field of new energy. According to the invention, the fixing frame is arranged around the solar photovoltaic panel, so that the solar photovoltaic panel can rotate around the central axis of the fixing frame, and therefore, when power grid absorption is difficult, the solar photovoltaic panel can be rotated, direct radiation of the solar photovoltaic panel can be reduced, output power of the solar photovoltaic panel can be reduced, and adjustment capability of new energy can be improved; when the power grid supply is insufficient, the solar photovoltaic panel can be rotated to increase the direct radiation of the solar photovoltaic panel, increase the output power of the solar photovoltaic panel, and improve the adjustment capability of the new energy. A water tank is further arranged on the back face of the solar photovoltaic panel, when the solar photovoltaic panel inclines or turns over, the water tank absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy into heat energy and chemical energy, the solar energy is fully utilized, and the utilization rate of the solar energy is increased.

title: Solar energy panel
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy panel. The solar energy panel is characterized in that solar silicon plates are arranged in the middle of solar panels, a first support, a second support, a third support and a fourth support are clockwise arranged in sequence around the solar panels, the fourth support of a first solar panel and a third solar panel is in fit connection with the second support of a second solar panel and a fourth solar panel, and the third support of the first solar panel and the second solar panel is in fit connection with the first support of the third solar panel and the fourth solar panel through a fifth support. If one solar panel is damaged, only the corresponding solar panel needs to be dismantled so that the solar energy panel is convenient to dismantle, firm in fixation, time saving and labor saving, and moreover the clamping mode adopted by the solar energy panel can prevent water leakage.

title: ROOF STRUCTURE WITH SOLAR BATTERY AND ROOF PANEL WITH SOLAR BATTERY
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To effectively use solar energy by providing a solar energy collector in a place of the roof surface where a solar battery module is not installed. SOLUTION: Solar battery modules 3 are sequentially fitted to the surface of a panel main body 2 through connecting frames stretched to longitudinal bars 11, 13 from the solar battery module 3 in the downstream of the flow direction. On the other hand, a solar energy collector 4 is stretched between the longitudinal bars 12, 13 by utilizing the fitting structure of the solar battery modules 3 to be fitted to the panel main body 2. When solar energy is given, the solar energy collector 4 can elevate the water temperature, whereby it is installed in a place where there is no solar battery module 3 to be effectively used for using solar energy. The solar energy collector 4 does not always need light quantity unlike the solar battery module 3, so that even if it is disposed in a place where the quantity of light is insufficient, the solar energy can be effectively used by function of the solar energy collector 4.

title: Solar energy photovoltaic panel having timing clean function
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy photovoltaic panel having a timing clean function. The solar energy photovoltaic panel aims at solving problems that sand and dust are easily gathered on the solar energy photovoltaic panel as the solar energy photovoltaic panel is long exposed to field environment when working, and the output power of the solar energy photovoltaic panel is reduced after the sand and the dust are gathered on the solar energy photovoltaic panel, so that the solar energy photovoltaic panel needs to be cleaned at regular intervals. The solar energy photovoltaic panel having the timing clean function comprises a solar energy photovoltaic panel body. The solar energy photovoltaic panel body is connected with a storage battery, and the storage battery is connected with an inverter. The solar energy photovoltaic panel is characterized in that the inverter is connected with a driving motor, the driving motor is connected with a leading screw, a nut is arranged on the leading screw, the nut is connected with a long brush, the driving motor is connected with a timing controller, and dust gathering grooves are arranged on the two sides of the solar energy photovoltaic panel body. By employing the solar energy photovoltaic panel having the timing clean function, extra energy is not needed, and manual cleaning is also not needed, so that labor force is saved. The solar energy photovoltaic panel having the timing clean function is of simple structure and low cost, and is applicable to being popularized and used in a large scope.

title: Solar energy storage and conversion system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy storage and conversion system. The solar energy storage and conversion system includes a control device, a solar energy heat collector, a drilling energy storage device, a layered circulation device and an absorbent refrigeration device, the solar energy heat collector, the drilling energy storage device and the layered circulation device are connected, thelayered circulation device is connected with the absorbent refrigeration unit, and the control device are electrically connected with the solar energy heat collector, the drilling energy storage device, the layered circulation device and the absorbent refrigeration device. The solar energy is collected through the solar energy heat collector and converted into the heat energy, the heat energy is transmitted to the layered circulation device to supply the heat to users, the layered circulation device can also transmit the heat energy to the absorption refrigeration device, the absorbent refrigeration device absorbs the heat energy for cooling, the excess heat energy is stored through the drilling energy storage device, the drilling energy storage device can store the heat energy for a longtime, in the absence of the sufficient solar energy, the heat energy of the drilling energy storage device flows back to the solar energy heat collector, and the utilization rate of the solar energy is increased.

title: ENERGY MANAGEMENT APPARATUS, ENERGY MANAGEMENT METHOD, AND ENERGY MANAGEMENT PROGRAM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain an energy management apparatus, an energy management method, and an energy management program which can prevent an interruption of power supply to electric apparatuses due to an insufficient power generation amount by a solar cell, and which can prevent an increase of power supply from a commercial power system.SOLUTION: An energy management apparatus 24 estimates a power generation amount by a solar cell 12 after a prescribed time, which is based on an estimated amount of solar radiation and an estimated temperature after the prescribed time at the place where the solar cell 12 is installed, and which is based on specifications of a solar power generation system 10. Before the estimation of the power generation amount, the energy management apparatus 24 plans the power generation amount by the solar cell 12, which is based on the amount of solar radiation and temperature in the past at the place where the solar cell 12 is installed, and which is based on the specifications of the solar power generation system 10. And the energy management apparatus 24 calculates the difference between the estimated power generation amount and the planned power generation amount to adjust a target electric power in accordance with the difference.

title: Systems and method for producing mechanical energy
abstract: A system is provided for producing mechanical energy. The system may include a solar collector configured to receive solar energy and an external heater configured to provide secondary thermal energy. Furthermore, the system may include an engine disposed in communication with the solar collector and the external heater. To this end, the engine may be operable to receive the solar energy from the solar collector, receive the secondary thermal energy from the external heater, and convert the solar energy and the secondary thermal energy to mechanical energy. Additionally, the system may include a controller in communication with the solar collector, the engine, and the external heater. The controller may be configured to control an amount of solar energy and an amount of secondary thermal energy received by the engine.

title: Portable modular sun-tracking solar energy receiver system
abstract: A portable solar energy generation system has a solar energy receiver having a plurality of solar cells for converting solar energy into a DC voltage. A solar tracking mechanism enables the solar energy receiver to track a position of the sun with respect to the solar cells and to position the solar cells responsive thereto. Power circuitry generates at least one output voltage to power an electronic device responsive to the DC voltage. A housing contains each of the solar energy receiver, the solar tracking mechanism and the power circuitry in a portable configuration.

The hybrid power automobile is characterized by comprising an automobile body, and a solar energy device, a wind energy device and a battery pack which are arranged on the automobile body, wherein the solar energy device and the wind energy device are connected with the battery pack respectively. According to the hybrid power automobile taking electric energy as main energy and taking solar energy and wind energy as auxiliary energy, the solar energy device and the wind energy device are arranged, so that solar energy and wind energy can be utilized effectively, and energy conservation and environment protection effects are realized. The hybrid power automobile is simple in structure, and is convenient and practical.

title: reflector to assist in effecting a collection of solar energy
abstract: PURPOSE: A reflecting plate for collecting solar energy is provided to recollect solar energy discharged caused by reflection and to efficiently collect the solar energy. CONSTITUTION: A reflecting plate for collecting solar energy comprises a collector(1) collecting the solar energy; a collecting plate(2) mounted on the collector; a heat insulating plate(3) minimizing heat loss of the collector by being mounted on a rear portion of the collecting plate; upper and lower reflecting plates(5,6) installed on both end portions of the collector; and a hinge(7) combing the lower reflecting plate to the collector. The upper and lower reflecting plates inducing the solar energy to heat the collecting plate. Thereby, the reflecting plate for collecting the solar energy recollects the solar energy discharged caused by reflection. Moreover, the reflecting plate for collecting the solar energy efficiently collects the solar energy.

title: Flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy
abstract: The invention provides a flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy. The flexible transparent display screen comprises a flexible transparent display screen body, a solar substrate, a solar energy storage device and a dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch. Wherein the solar energy storage device is respectively connected with the flexible transparent display screen and the solar substrate through conductive circuits; the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is connected with the solar energy storage device and the flexible transparent display screen through wires. The solar substrate is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy, and the solar energy storage device stores the electric energy converted by the solar substrate and supplies power to the flexible transparent display screen; and the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is used for switching to mains supply to supply power to the flexible transparent display screen when the power supplied by the solar energy storage device is insufficient.

title: Application method for solar collector array

title: Solar energy, air energy and geothermal device switching energy-saving compensation system
abstract: The invention relates to an energy-saving device, in particular to a solar energy, air energy and geothermal device switching energy-saving compensation system. The energy-saving compensation system mainly comprises a photovoltaic solar-thermal plate, an air source heat pump, a ground source heat pump, a water tank, a solar energy vacuum pipe, a steam storing tank and an electromagnetic heater. According to the solar energy, air energy and geothermal device switching energy-saving compensation system, the problem that the comprehensive usage rate is low in the prior art is solved, usage technologies of solar energy, air energy and geothermal devices are organically combined together, and a solar energy comprehensive usage system capable of effectively transforming the solar energy to electric energy and steam energy and sufficiently using solar thermal energy is provided.

title: Energy storage battery box
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy storage, and discloses an energy storage battery box which comprises a device main body, the device main body comprises an energy storage battery box body, a box body handle is further fixedly installed on the energy storage battery box body, anti-skid lines are installed on the outer surface of the box body handle in a sleeved mode, and the device main body further comprises a solar energy supplementing mechanism. The solar energy supplementing mechanism comprises a first solar panel, a second solar panel and a third solar panel, and the first solar panel is fixedly mounted at the top end of the energy storage battery box body. Through the arrangement of the solar energy complementing mechanism, in actual use, solar energy is converted into electric energy through the first solar panel, the second solar panel and the third solar panel, and the electric energy is stored in the energy storage battery box body for unexpected needs; the problem that most of traditional energy storage battery boxes cannot utilize solar energy to complement energy and can only be charged by an external power supply, so that the practicability is poor is effectively solved.

title: Solar power generation equipment capable of tracking sun movement
abstract: The utility mode discloses a solar energy generating device tracking the solar movement, comprising a supporting bracket, a multi-layer solar energy cell plate installed on the supporting bracket, cable used for transmitting the power connected to the solar energy cell plate; the solar energy cell plate is rotatablely connected to the supporting bracket; thee solar energy cell plate is connected to the driving mechanism; the driving mechanism controls the solar energy cell plate to rotate via the controller. The utility model tracks the solar energy generating device of the solar movement to enhance the using rate of the solar energy, which has a simple structure, convenient installation, full automatic operation, security, waterproofing and leakage proofing.

title: Solar energy powered lift
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of lifts, in particular to a solar energy powered lift. The solar energy powered lift comprises a mains supply, a lift control device and a solar energy power supply device, wherein the lift control device comprises a power-transfer module, the power-transfer module is provided with two power input terminals, one of the terminals is connected with the mains supply, and the other terminal is connected with a storage battery. The storage battery is connected with the solar energy power supply device. The solar energy power supply device comprises a solar collector plate and a solar controller, wherein the solar collector plate is connected with the solar controller, and the solar controller is connected with the storage battery. By means of the solar energy powered lift, the solar energy can be fully transferred into electric energy to supply power to the lift, energy-saving and environment protecting performance are good, and the normal operation of the lift is guaranteed.

title: Wind energy/solar energy complementary stepless street lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of conversion of wind energy and solar energy to electric energy, particularly to a wind energy/solar energy complementary stepless street lamp, which comprises a solar energy battery panel, a wind energy generator and a control circuit for controlling conversion of wind energy/solar energy to electric energy. The control circuit comprises a power inverter, a power storage unit, and a charging current controller. The wind energy/solar energy complementary stepless street lamp integrates wind energy power generation and solar energy power generation, and takes full use of natural resources to obtain energy.

title: Moving point array solar focusing building energy supply system
abstract: The invention relates to solar energy utilization, in particular to solar energy collection by using a point focusing solar mirror and application of the point focusing solar mirror to a moving point array solar focusing building energy supply system. The moving point array solar focusing building energy supply system at least comprises one or one group of point focusing solar mirrors, at least one solar photothremal conversion device and a tracking control device for control, wherein the solar mirrors are arranged on a solar mirror support; solar photothermal conversion devices are arranged on a solar photothermal conversion device support, and are arranged in a punctiform area focused by the solar mirrors; and the tracking control device controls the solar mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one solar photothermal conversion device when the sunlight changes, the solar photothermal conversion devices move in the process that the solar mirrors track solar energy, and each or each group of solar mirrors select the solar photothermal conversion device capable of reaching the highest solar energy utilization efficiency for focusing, so that the solar energy is tracked, focused and utilized.

title: Light energy heat gathering device of solar energy water heater and method for eliminating fogs thereon
abstract: The invention discloses a method for eliminating mist on a light energy heat gathering device of a solar energy water heater, including a solar energy photoheating layer in the light energy heat gathering device for adsorbing the solar energy and generating heat. The solar energy photoheating layer transmits the heat on a glass body which has mist on an inner surface and heats the glass body. The glass body absorbs the heat generated by the solar energy pohotoheating layer. The mist one the inner surface of the glass is evaporated. Because the technical scheme that the solar energy photoheating layer is arranged on the glass body out of a solar energy collector tube is adopted, even if a thermal insulation layer is a gas insulating layer under a non-vacuum state, at the same time that the solar energy collector tube absorbs the solar energy and exchanges heat with liquid in the tube, the solar energy photoheating layer on the glass body can also absorb the solar energy and heat the glass body to lead the temperature to rise. The rising of the temperature also evaporates the mist condensed on the inner surface of the glass body.

The wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system is characterized in that the wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system is provided with an operation condition control box (3), and the wind power generator controller, the solar power generation controller, the storage battery and the inverter are fixed into the operation condition control box (3). Through the wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system, the energy storage element and the controllers of the wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system can be in suitable working conditions, and system work is more stable and reliable.

title: System and Method for Creating a Networked Vehicle Infrastructure Distribution Platform of Solar Energy Gathering Devices
abstract: A vehicle for gathering solar energy into a roadway system electricity grid. In one embodiment of the invention, the vehicle comprises an energy storage system; and at least one solar energy generating device coupled to the vehicle. The at least one solar energy generating device is configured to generate electricity from sunlight. The at least one solar energy generating device is configured to electrically connect to a roadway system electricity grid. In another embodiment of the present invention is a method for a vehicle gathering solar energy and providing the same to the roadway system electricity grid. The method comprises the step of harnessing solar energy from a vehicle-based solar energy gathering device; converting solar energy into electrical energy; storing the electrical energy; and discharging the stored electrical energy to a roadway system electricity grid.

title: Solar energy absorption coating
abstract: A solar energy absorption coating is characterized by being prepared from the following raw materials: resin, an absorbent, an extender pigment, an auxiliary agent and a solvent. The solar energy utilization degree of the existing solar energy absorption coating is low, the solar energy can be converted into heat energy efficiently, the weather resistance of the coating is good, and the light-retaining and color-retaining property is excellent. The solar energy absorption coating is mainly used for converting solar energy into heat energy, and is particularly suitable for a solar water heater,a thermos room and the like.

title: Solar gas turbine power generation system based on photo-thermal principle
abstract: The utility model provides a solar gas turbine power generation system based on a photo-thermal principle. The solar gas turbine power generation system comprises a gas turbine, a solar energy collecting device, a solar energy reflecting mirror, a mounting table and an adjusting device, wherein the solar energy collecting device is arranged on the gas turbine and used for heating a circulating medium on a working medium channel of the gas turbine, and the gas turbine is fixed above the solar energy reflecting mirror and enables the solar energy collecting device to be located at a sunlight reflection gathering point; and the solar reflector is mounted on the mounting table through an adjusting device for adjusting the angle of the solar reflector. Solar energy, the gas turbine and the sunlight tracking technology are combined, it can be guaranteed that a solar energy gas turbine power generation system efficiently absorbs solar energy, and therefore the utilization rate of energy is increased.

title: Solar energy window structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy window structure which comprises a main frame with an opening fitted at the top of the building. The main frame is provided with a modular solar energy light penetrating window plate and a driver, wherein the modular solar energy light penetrating window plate receives solar energy and converts solar energy into electric energy which can be output, and the driver connects with the modular solar energy light penetrating window plate and drives the modular solar energy light penetrating window plate to move on the main frame to close or open the opening. The solar energy window structure is fitted at the top of the building to light, generate electricity, and ventilate.

title: High-concentration solar energy receiving module
abstract: The invention relates to a high-concentration solar energy receiving module which comprises a solar energy receiving module; the solar energy receiving module is arranged in a high-concentration solar energy module and comprises a non-imaging solar energy concentrator, a solar energy cell receiver and a heat radiator which are arranged from top to bottom; the solar energy receiving module also comprises an enclosed housing which is sleeved outside the non-imaging solar energy concentrator and the solar energy cell receiver; and at least the top of the enclosed housing is provided with an opening or a perspective window corresponding to the top surface of the non-imaging solar energy concentrator. The enclosed housing is sleeved outside the non-imaging solar energy concentrator and the solar energy cell receiver to form an enclosed high-concentration photovoltaic (HCPV) module so that all components inside the enclosed housing can be prevented from pollutions and interferences of substances, such as dust, vapor, compounds in air, humidity, and the like in the external environment and the blockage to the presentation of all the components is avoided, and therefore the service life of each component is prolonged and the photoelectric conversion efficiency and the reliability of the solar energy receiving module are improved.

title: Flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy
abstract: The utility model provides a flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy. The flexible transparent display screen comprises a flexible transparent display screen body, a solar substrate, a solar energy storage device and a dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch. Wherein the solar energy storage device is respectively connected with the flexible transparent display screen and the solar substrate through conductive circuits; the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is connected with the solar energy storage device and the flexible transparent display screen through wires. The solar substrate is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy, and the solar energy storage device stores the electric energy converted by the solar substrate and supplies power to the flexible transparent display screen; and the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is used for switching to mains supply to supply power to the flexible transparent display screen when the power supplied by the solar energy storage device is insufficient.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Portable solar semiconductor lighting device
abstract: The utility model provides a separated solar energy lamp which comprises a solar energy polar plate and a lamp body which is integrated with the solar energy polar plate, wherein an accumulator which is communicated with a circuit of the solar energy pole plate and a luminous body which is electrically connected with the accumulator are arranged in the lamp body. The connecting part of the accumulator and the solar energy polar plate is provided with an electric circuit jack, and an electric plug which corresponds to the circuit jack is arranged at the free end of an electric connection line which is led out from the solar energy polar plate. The lamp body and the solar energy pole plate can be separated or integrated by the jack, the plug and the connecting line, the lamp absorbs solar energy by the solar energy pole plate, the solar energy is converted into electric energy and the electric energy is stored into the accumulator. When occasion demands, the plug is pulled off from the jack to make the lamp body and the solar energy pole plate separate and the lamp can be used for a large range or big efficiency.

title: Solar energy umbrella
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a solar energy umbrella, umbrella pole including covering the umbrella face on the rib and linking to each other with the rib is equipped with film solar energy component on the umbrella face, can charge for the electric energy solar energy transformation for the electronic product. Solar energy umbrella still including setting up the sombrero in umbrella pole one end, is provided with solar energy umbrella control circuit and energy storage battery in the sombrero, make the distance between solar energy umbrella control circuit and the energy storage battery very little, has not only effectively utilized the space in the sombrero, also makes solar energy umbrella overall structure compact reasonable. The two reduces solar energy umbrella control circuit and energy storage battery with film solar energy component distance, has not only reduced the electric energy excess loss who leads to because of the circuit overlength effectively, has still avoided the wire to expose the life -span that influences electronic component outward and solar energy umbrella's aesthetic property. The embodiment of the utility model provides a solar energy umbrella easily makes and the assembly, has improved the holistic processing performance of solar energy umbrella.

title: Sheathing solar energy system and construction method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a sheathing solar energy system and a method for constructing the same. The sheathing solar energy system comprises: a solar rack; and a sheathing framework, and the solar rack includes a solar energy panel. According to the invention, the spread of solar energy can be expanded.

title: Solar energy lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy lamp, which is characterized in that the solar energy lamp comprises a lampshade with an interface, a solar energy lamp and a connecting device for connecting the lampshade and the solar energy lamp, wherein the solar energy lamp comprises a solar energy power supplying device, an LED lamp, a base of the LED lamp and a connecting wire for connecting the solar energy power supplying device and the LED lamp. The lampshade, the solar energy lamp and the connecting device of the solar energy lamp provided by the utility model can all be disassembled and replaced so that the using convenience of the solar energy lamp and the reutilization rate of resources are enhanced, and meanwhile, the assembling height of the LED lamp can be carried out with adaptive regulation according to the different shapes and sizes of the lampshade so that the utility model obtains the optimum illuminating effect. The solar energy lamp of the utility model has the advantages of safety and beautiful appearance and is suitable for using as an illuminating or decorating lamp inside and outside rooms of different occasions.

title: Foldable solar energy assembly and mobile vehicle having the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar energy assembly having a main frame, at least one solar energy panel frame, a driving device, and an electrical assembly. The at least one solar energy panel frame is pivotally and foldablly connected with the main frame. Each solar energy panel frame has multiple solar energy panels mounted thereon. The driving device is mounted on the main frame and connected to the at least one solar energy panel frame to pivot the at least one solar energy panel frame related to the main frame. The electrical assembly has a battery electrically connected to the solar energy panels on the at least one solar panel energy frame and a distribution box electrically connected with the battery.

title: Solar energy drive shutter
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy drive shutter. The solar energy drive shutter comprises blades, ladder bands and a drive mechanism of the blades. A solar cell panel is connected with the blades in a welded mode, a binder mode or a clamp groove mode. The solar cell pane collects solar energy, and accesses electric energy which is converted from the solar energy into a solar energy drive system through wires in the conductive ladder bands. The electric energy is used for driving lifting and overturn of the solar energy drive shutter. Redundant electric energy is stored for other use. The solar energy drive shutter has the advantages of being ingenious in structural design, novel in conception, creative and capable of collecting ignored energy sources in daily life to use, and achieving purposes of environment protection and energy saving.

title: Solar energy glass energy supply automatic watering device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy glass energy supply automatic watering device, including the support, locate the support top the flowerpot, locate support bottom water bottle, locate medialwater pump of support and controlling means, install solar energy glass and solar cell strip on the window frame, the solar cell strip is connected with solar energy glass, is used for utilizing theabsorptive light of solar energy glass turns into the electric energy and stores, water pump and controlling means connect the solar cell strip. Solar energy glass has replaced traditional ordinary glass, makes to project the solar energy that does not have utilized on the glass originally and obtained effective utilization, solar energy glass stores solar energy transformation for the electric energy, for controlling means and water pump are supplied power, have reduced traditional automatic control and have watered the device to the consumption of family's electric energy, and be energy -concerving and environment -protective, needs other installation not only to install loaded down with trivial detailsly and need occupy big space in addition for traditional solar cell panel simultaneously.

title: Factory agricultural multi-stage solar energy and other energy compensation thermal power generation system
abstract: The utility model aims to provide a factory agricultural multi-stage solar energy and other energy compensation thermal power generation system which comprises solar energy collecting systems and power generator sets. The solar energy collecting system and the power generator set form a set of solar energy power generation system. The factory agricultural multi-stage solar energy and other energy compensation thermal power generation system comprises at least two sets of solar energy power generation system and at least a set of energy system provided by the energy except for the solar energy. Supplementary energy is supplied for the solar energy power generation system. One set of solar energy power generation system can be connected with another set of solar energy power generation system in series and/or in parallel. The waste heat after power generation of one set of power generation system is used by another set of power generation system, thereby realizing power generation with multi-stage waste heat utilization. Two sets of solar energy power generation systems can be composed of a set of solar energy low-temperature power generation system and a set of solar energy high-temperature power generation system. The waste heat of the double-stage power generation system can be used by the other stage, thereby performing step collection and utilization on the solar system with different collection temperatures.

title: IN-VEHICLE SOLAR ENERGY CHARGING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME
abstract: An in-vehicle solar energy charging system and a method for controlling the same are disclosed. The in-vehicle solar energy charging system comprises a solar energy cell panel (110), a solar energy charger (120), a starting battery (130), a power battery (140) and a controller (150), in which the solar energy cell panel (110) is electrically connected to the solar energy charger (120), the starting battery (130) and the power battery (140) are electrically connected to the solar energy charger (120) respectively, the solar energy charger (120), the starting battery (130) and the power battery (140) are electrically connected to the controller (150) respectively, and the controller (150) is configured for performing a maximum photovoltaic power tracking algorithm so as to control the output power of the solar energy charger (120). The system may realize flexible control and maximize the output power of the solar energy.

title: Solar energy refrigerator
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy refrigerator, including the refrigerator body, refrigerator door, accumulate device, refrigerating plant and heat abstractor, refrigerator body top is equipped with central solar panel, a solar panel, the 2nd solar panel and the 3rd solar panel respectively with the central solar panel swing joint on refrigerator body top, just the cross sectional shape that center solar panel, a solar panel, the 2nd solar panel and the 3rd solar panel have continuous zigzag, the center is equipped with the spotlight unit on the solar panel, is equipped with spotlight unit, light detecting unit and the control unit on a solar panel, the 2nd solar panel and the 3rd solar panel respectively, a solar panel, the 2nd solar panel and the 3rd solar panel with be equipped with electronic telescopic regulation pole between the refrigerator body, the ice bottom half is equipped with the universal wheel, and the solar panel area is big, can fold, carries everywhere, and it is convenient to move.

title: Teaching aid for converting solar energy into electric energy to kinetic energy
abstract: The utility model discloses a teaching aid for converting solar energy into electric energy to kinetic energy, and relates to the technical field of solar energy. The device comprises a solar cell panel, a supporting plate and a solar protective cover, and is characterized in that the solar cell panel is embedded in the supporting plate, the solar protective cover is embedded in the upper surface of the supporting plate, a rotating shaft welding seat is embedded in the lower surface of the supporting plate, a rotating seat is connected to the lower surface of the rotating shaft welding seat, and a protective cover is embedded in the lower surface of the rotating seat; a rotating shaft is arranged in the rotating seat, and a tempered glass plate is embedded in the upper surface of the solar cell panel. Reciprocating swing of the executing mechanism is achieved through the power transmission system and ingenious application of the incomplete gear, the reasonable and compact structural layout is achieved, in addition, solar energy is ingeniously converted into kinetic energy through the kinetic energy conversion system, and the product effect is guaranteed through the design.

title: Systems and Method for Producing Mechanical Energy
abstract: A system is provided for producing mechanical energy. The system may include a solar collector configured to receive solar energy and an external heater configured to provide secondary thermal energy. Furthermore, the system may include an engine disposed in communication with the solar collector and the external heater. To this end, the engine may be operable to receive the solar energy from the solar collector, receive the secondary thermal energy from the external heater, and convert the solar energy and the secondary thermal energy to mechanical energy. Additionally, the system may include a controller in communication with the solar collector, the engine, and the external heater. The controller may be configured to control an amount of solar energy and an amount of secondary thermal energy received by the engine.

title: Flying assisting device and kite
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy, and particularly discloses a flying assisting device and a kite, the flying assisting device comprises a solar energy assembly, an energy storage assembly, a solar energy controller and a flying assembly; the solar module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage assembly is connected with the solar assembly and used for storing electric energy. The solar assembly and the energy storage assembly are connected with the flight assembly through the solar controller. Wherein the solar controller isused for switching connection between the solar assembly and the energy storage assembly and the flight assembly; the flight assembly is connected with the solar controller and used for achieving flight of the flight assisting device. According to the flight assisting device, the solar assembly and the energy storage assembly are used for providing electric energy needed by work for the flight assembly, self-sufficiency of the electric energy is achieved, normal work of the flight assembly can be guaranteed, under the condition that the flight assembly works normally, the influence of the environment or human factors on the flight assisting device is avoided, and the flight effect of the flight assisting device is improved.

title: Optical energy integrated test system
abstract: The invention discloses an optical energy integrated test system, and relates to the technical field of solar energy application. The optical energy integrated test system is mainly composed of a solar energy collecting assembly, an electric energy measuring device and a timer. The solar energy collecting assembly is composed of a solar cell panel, a controller and a storage battery, wherein the solar cell panel is connected with the storage battery through the controller, and the electric energy measuring device and the timer are respectively connected with the storage battery. Due to the fact that the electric energy measuring device and the timer are connected with the storage battery of the solar energy collecting assembly, optical energy data of the solar energy are measured and collected in the process of collecting the solar energy, solar energy illumination intensity data of solar energy illumination engineering installation sites are obtained, and accurate guide data are provided for engineering installation, a good foundation is laid for the stable operation of the illuminating engineering. The optical energy integrated test system has the advantages of being low in manufacturing cost, short in measurement period, and accurate in data measurement.

title: Solar energy sightseeing elevator
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy sightseeing elevator, comprising an elevator body, a solar energy control system, an inversion system, a power-off detection system, and a power supply transition system, the solar energy control system comprises: a solar energy receiving panel, a solar energy converter, and a storage battery set, the solar energy control system, the inversion system, the power supply transition system, and the power-off detection system are successively connected with a motor in the elevator body. The solar energy sightseeing elevator can effectively uses solar energy, is advantaged by environmental protection, and is worthy of popularization.

title: Air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary type hot water device
abstract: The invention discloses an air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary type hot water device, which comprises an air energy heat pump, a regenerative heat exchanger, a heat pump heat exchanger, a hot water output heat exchanger, a solar energy hot water heat exchanger, a solar energy hot water circulating pipe, a solar energy heat collector and an expansion water tank, wherein a heating unit of the air energy heat pump is connected with the regenerative heat exchanger, the regenerative heat exchanger is provided with the solar energy hot water heat exchanger and the hot water output heat exchanger, the solar energy hot water heat exchanger is connected with a solar energy heat collector through the solar energy hot water circulating pipe, and a solar energy lower circulating pipeline is connected with the expansion water tank. The air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary type hot water device uses the air energy heat pump and a solar energy hot water system to form a double-energy hot water system, fully uses air heat energy, also change direct using of solar energy hot water into indirect using of the solar energy hot water, increases use rate of air heat energy and exchanges air indoor in time at the same time, keeps air fresh, further guarantees quality of the solar energy hot water, can heat at once when using, prevents bacteria growth, and keeps hot water to be used in health standard.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Energy management system associated with solar generation
abstract: The present invention relates to an energy management system associated with solar energy generation and, more specifically, to an energy management system associated with solar energy generation which is optimized for an individual building performing solar energy generation, which may easily calculate the amount of solar energy generation and which may accurately diagnose a state of a solar energy generation device by providing a comprehensive analysis of status information of a power plant associated with power supply of a solar energy generation device, the amount of electricity used of an individual building where a solar energy generation device is installed and weather information.

title: Rotary solar generating device
abstract: The utility model relates to a rotary solar generating device, which solves the problem that solar energy cannot be fully and effectively utilized by the present fixed solar device. The rotary solar generating device includes a pedestal; the pedestal is provided with a rotating disk with a pulley; the rotating disk is fixedly provided with a rotating shaft; the top of the rotating shaft is hinged to a solar energy plate; the solar energy plate is hinged to the rotating shaft through an electric telescopic rod; and the output terminal of the solar energy plate is connected with a solar energy controller, a storage battery, a solar energy inverter and a time controller in sequence. The rotating disk in the device enables the solar energy plate to rotate automatically, and the elevation angle of the solar energy plate can be adjusted by the electric telescopic rod. According to the rotary solar generating device, the structure is simple, the design is ingenious, mounting and dismounting are rapid, solar energy is fully utilized, the solar generating efficiency is substantially raised, investment cost is reduced, production benefit is raised, and much investment value is provided.

title: BIFACIAL PHOTOVOLTAIC SOLAR ENERGY APPARATUS
abstract: A bifacial photovoltaic solar energy apparatus is provided to receive solar light under an optimum condition by improving the structure of a reflector and prevent increase of load of a solar tracking system by minimizing the weight of the reflector. A bifacial photovoltaic solar energy apparatus includes a double-sided solar energy unit(30), a first reflector(40), and a second reflector(50). The double-sided solar energy unit has a front surface and a rear surface for receiving solar light, and is inclined in one direction by 40 to 50 degrees. The first reflector is arranged at the right side of the double-sided solar energy unit, and inclined by 85 to 95 degrees from the double-sided solar energy unit. The first reflector is arranged to reflect solar light to the front surface of the double-sided solar energy unit. The second reflector is spaced apart from the left side of the double-sided solar energy unit, and inclined by 40 to 50 degrees in the direction opposite to the first reflector such that the second reflector reflects solar light to the rear surface of the double-sides solar energy unit.

title: All-weather solar energy heat accumulation and consumption method and device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar energy equipment and discloses an all-weather solar energy heat accumulation and consumption method and device. The solar energy heat accumulation and consumption device comprises at least one sunlight thermal energy collecting system, a stored energy heat exchanger, an energy heat exchanger and conducting oil, wherein the at least one sunlight thermal energy collecting system consists of a solar energy reflector and a solar energy heat exchanger; the solar energy heat exchanger located at the focus of the solar energy reflector is communicated with the stored energy heat exchanger by an oil conduit; the stored energy heat exchanger is communicated with the energy heat exchanger by the oil conduit; the sunny exposure direction of the solar energy reflector with a paraboloid baffle-board corresponds to the sun direction by a solar energy tracking system. The all-weather solar energy heat accumulation and consumption method and device are used for collecting and storing thermal energy of sun, the thermal energy is used for processing food, heating, bathing and baking, energy is saved, fuel consumption and greenhouse gas emission are reduced, the problem of current gradual energy lack can be relieved, and the effects of protecting environment and saving energy are achieved.

title: Solar energy component's solidification equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy component's solidification equipment, place board and support including device body, solar energy component, the top of support is provided with the device body, this internal solar energy component of being provided with of device places the board, the top that solar energy component placed the board is provided with first heating member, the top of first heating member is provided with first hot -blast fan, the below that solar energy component placed the board is provided with the second heating member, the hot -blast fan of below second of secondheating member solar energy component places the board and is connected with solar energy component transmission track. The utility model provides a solar energy component's solidification equipment through the position of adjusting solar energy component, has improved solar energy component's solidification quality, through transmitting orbital conveying, can damage in transport and solidification process by the effectual solar energy component of preventing.

title: Solar energy automobile
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy automobile. The solar energy automobile comprises an electric automobile body and a solar energy device, wherein the solar energy device comprises a plurality of solar energy panels, a plurality of charging control circuits connected with the solar energy panels, and a plurality of sets of independent battery sets connected with the charging control circuits, wherein the sets of independent battery sets are connected with an electric motor through change-over switches; the electric motor is used for driving the automobile; and the solar energy panels are mounted on the surface of the box body of the automobile. According to the solar energy automobile disclosed by the invention, automobile body area and bottom space are sufficiently utilized, the sets of independent battery sets and sets of charging control electric circuits are arranged, so that, storage of the solar energy is realized, the endurance capability of the solar energy automobile is greatly improved, and the solar energy automobile is especially suitable for a small-scale truck, a small-scale passenger car and a bus.

title: SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION DEVICE
abstract: A solar energy utilization device, which comprises at least one solar light condenser unit, the solar light condenser unit comprises a condenser lens, a first solar energy utilization unit, and a second solar energy utilization unit. The condenser lens comprises a first lens portion and a second lens portion, where connection regions of the first lens portion and the second lens portion have been configured as more narrow, and the condenser lens forms an hourglass-shaped structure; the first solar energy utilization unit is located at a first end of the first lens portion, and the second solar energy utilization unit is located at a second end of the second lens portion, i.e., the first solar energy utilization unit and the second solar energy utilization unit are located at two respective ends of the condenser lens; the first lens portion can focus light to the first solar energy utilization unit, and the second lens portion can focus light to the second solar energy utilization unit, so that two faces and two sides of the first solar energy utilization unit and the second solar energy utilization unit can all be used to collect light, thereby increasing the light collection area of the first solar energy utilization unit and the second solar energy utilization, and consequently improving power generation capacity and power generation efficiency.

title: Energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy
abstract: The invention provides an energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy. The system comprises a solar power generation subsystem and an energy-saving control subsystem; the solar power generation subsystem is used for converting solar energy into electric energy and supplying power to the energy-saving control subsystem; and the energy-saving control subsystem is used for adjusting the environment of a greenhouse by utilizing the electric energy provided by the solar power generation subsystem. The energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy has the beneficial effects that the energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy is provided, and power support is provided for the environment adjustment of the greenhouse through solar energy, so that full utilization of solar energy and accurate control of the environment of the greenhouse are realized, the environment is protected to the maximum extent, and the system is of great significance for sustainable development of the greenhouse and for the construction and protection of the environment of beautiful homeland of humans.

title: Solar chemical heat storage system for heating
abstract: The invention relates to a solar chemical heat storage system for heating. The solar chemical heat storage system for heating comprises an energy storage assembly, a storage battery and a boiler body,wherein the energy storage assembly is used for absorbing solar energy and adjusting the absorption amount of the solar energy, the storage battery is used for storing the solar energy for chemical energy conversion, and the boiler body is used for outputting heat for heating; and the energy storage assembly comprises a solar main board and solar auxiliary boards movably arranged on two sides ofthe solar main board, the solar auxiliary boards are rotationally accommodated at the bottom of the solar main board through fixing pieces, and the solar auxiliary boards are rotationally supported ontwo sides of the solar main board through locking pieces to form the same horizontal plane with the solar main board. In short, by means of the technical scheme, through a coherent and compact structure, the problems that scale is prone to generation and high-temperature steam cannot be generated greatly when traditional solar energy chemical energy storage is applied to a heating system are solved, and the problem that the solar energy absorption amount cannot be adjusted according to the requirement of a real-time situation when the traditional solar energy chemical energy storage is applied to the heating system is further solved.

title: Photoelectric and photo-thermal integrated assembly
abstract: At present, in the field of solar energy application, two modes are mainly adopted, one mode is to absorb solar energy to generate electricity, and the other mode is to absorb solar heat to heat water, but the two modes cannot be combined, and precious clean energy of solar energy is wasted to a great extent. The invention relates to the field of solar energy application, and especially relates to a device for converting solar energy absorbed by a solar power generation panel and a heat absorber into electric energy and heat energy. The device can be widely applied to various occasions with sufficient illumination.

title: Solar energy mouse
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy mouse comprising a mouse body, an optical sensor, an internal light source, a battery, a lens, a solar module and an energy management device. The solar energy mouse uses the lens arranged on the mouse body to focus rays; the solar module receives the rays; and the energy management device transforms the rays into electrical energy and then carries out the management of charging the battery of the mouse. The solar energy mouse can solve the problem that the traditional solar energy mouse is required to wait for the solar module to absorb enough solar energy to continue the operation when electrical power for maintaining action is insufficient.

title: Portable solar energy charger
abstract: The utility model discloses a portable solar energy charger comprising a shell and a solar panel arranged on the shell. A groove used for installing a charging module is arranged on the shell, the charging module is adapted with the groove, and a solar energy output interface is arranged in the groove; the charging module comprises a charge-discharge storage battery, a solar energy charging input interface and a solar energy charging output interface; the charge-discharge storage battery is arranged in a box body, the solar energy charging input interface and the solar energy charging output interface are arranged on the box body, the solar panel is electrically connected with the solar energy output interface by a control circuit, and the solar energy output interface is electrically connected with the solar energy charging input interface. A solar energy charger main body and the charging module can be conveniently disassembled; the charging module carries out charging, and the using is more convenient; under the condition that both an electrical appliance and the charging module are not electrified and AC electricity charging is inconvenient, the solar energy charger only needs to be placed in the sun, and then the charge-discharge storage battery can be directly charged.

title: Embedded wearable solar power supply system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an embedded wearable solar power supply system and a control method thereof. The system comprises a solar cell module, an energy storage module and a controller, wherein the solar cell module is a flexible solar cell array and is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage module is composed of multiple super capacitors and is used for storing the electric energy; the controller is used for calculating a continuously changing maximum power point according to a maximum power point tracking algorithm when outside illumination intensity changes. Charging and discharging management is conducted according to the magnitude of energy needed by a load, and if the energy needed by the load is less than energy provided by the solar cell module, the solar cell module supplies power to the load and the energy storage module simultaneously; when the energy needed by the load is larger than the energy provided by the solar cell module, the solar cell module and an energy storage element supply power to the load simultaneously. According to the embedded wearable solar power supply system and the control method thereof, the solar energy can be effectively collected, and the efficiency of collecting the solar energy by the system is improved through the maximum power point tracking algorithm.

title: Solar power energy system in a bicycle
abstract: A solar power energy system in a bicycle, which comprises: a first solar energy transferring unit with electric connection, an electric energy storage unit and an output unit. The first solar energy transferring unit is formed with several solar energy plates on the topside of a mudguard, or it is set several solar energy plates on a sliding plate, which is pivoted under the carriage frame of the bicycle, to collect the solar energy in the daytime by solar energy plates on the mudguard or sliding plate and then transfer to electric power stored in the electric energy storage unit to provide to output unit. It has a regular appearance and convenient application.

title: Solar energy mouse
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy mouse comprising a mouse body, an optical sensor, an internal light source, a battery, a lens, a solar module and an energy management device. The solar energy mouse uses the lens arranged on the mouse body to focus rays; the solar module receives the rays; and the energy management device transforms the rays into electrical energy and then carries out the management of charging the battery of the mouse. The solar energy mouse can solve the problem that the traditional solar energy mouse is required to wait for the solar module to absorb enough solar energy to continue the operation when electrical power for maintaining action is insufficient.

title: Foldable solar energy assembly and mobile vehicle having the same
abstract: The present utility model relates to a solar energy assembly having a main frame, at least one solar energy panel frame, a driving device, and an electrical assembly. The at least one solar energy panel frame is pivotally and foldablly connected with the main frame. Each solar energy panel frame has multiple solar energy panels mounted thereon. The driving device is mounted on the main frame and connected to the at least one solar energy panel frame to pivot the at least one solar energy panel frame related to the main frame. The electrical assembly has a battery electrically connected to the solar energy panels on the at least one solar panel energy frame and a distribution box electrically connected with the battery.

title: Solar energy power generation system for power grid
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy power generation system for a power grid. The system comprises a substrate, solar energy cells and leads, wherein the substrate is laid on the ground, an upper end surface of the substrate is provided with a sunlight reflection layer, the sunlight reflection layer on the substrate is provided with multiple solar energy cells arranged in an array mode, the solar energy cells are cylindrical, the solar energy cells are vertically mounted on the substrate, an outer wall of the solar energy cells is provided with a mirror reflection layer, height of the solar energy cells is in a range of 1-10mm, the solar energy cells are respectively provided with the leads, and current generated by the solar energy cells are conducted to electrical storage equipment of a power grid system through the leads.

title: Mobile solar energy storage device
abstract: The utility model discloses a mobile solar energy storage device which comprises a solar controller, a mobile box, a solar mounting rack, a bottom supporting mechanism, an angle supporting mechanism and two solar charging mechanisms. According to the mobile solar energy storage device, the solar charging mechanism is used for charging the storage battery through the solar controller, and the requirements of solar power generation and energy storage are met; the two solar charging mechanisms are stored in the moving box, and the solar energy storage device is convenient to move or store due to the foldable structure of the solar energy mounting frame; the solar energy mounting rack provides mounting conditions for the two groups of solar energy charging mechanisms, and the solar energy collection effect is good; the lower end of the bottom supporting mechanism is supported on the ground so that the moving box can be positioned, the lower ends of the angle supporting mechanism and the bottom supporting mechanism are supported on the ground, and the angle between the solar mounting frame and the two solar charging mechanisms can be adjusted by adjusting the length of the angle supporting mechanism.

title: Solar voltage-stabilized power supply circuit
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar voltage-stabilized power supply circuit, which relates to the technical field of solar power supplies and comprises a solar module used for solar power generation and voltage stabilization by an output control module; the voltage detection module is used for carrying out undervoltage judgment on the solar energy, controlling the first energy storage module to discharge and controlling the second energy storage module to charge when the solar energy is undervoltage, and controlling the first energy storage module to store energy and controlling the second energy storage module to discharge when the solar energy is not undervoltage; and the illumination detection module is used for detecting illumination and controlling the operation of the voltage detection module. According to the solar voltage-stabilized power supply circuit, the output control module carries out voltage stabilization processing on the input electric energy, the voltage detection module judges whether the solar voltage is under-voltage, when the solar voltage is not under-voltage, the second energy storage module and the solar module supply power to the first energy storage module together, and when the solar voltage is under-voltage, the second energy storage module supplies power to the second energy storage module. The first energy storage module is used for auxiliary power supply, and the second energy storage module is used for storing solar energy.

title: High temp and capacity vacuum solar accumulator
abstract: A high-temperature high-volume vacuum solar energy-accumulating device having a solar energy heat collection system, a solar energy transmission system, a solar energy storage system and a solar energy vacuum heat insulation system inside. The device can accumulate the solar energy in a high-temperature, high-volume and high-intensity manner, and keep the temperature in a vacuum manner.

title: NEW CONCEPT SMART PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATIOR
abstract: The present invention relates to an advanced concept intelligent solar power plant. The advanced concept intelligent solar power plant includes: a rotation reflector (10) transmitting solar energy to an upper plate condensing mirror (20); the upper plate condensing mirror (20) collecting the solar energy and transmitting the same toward the inner side; an upper plate scattering mirror (40) scattering the solar energy transmitted from the upper plate condensing mirror (20) and transmitting each of the scattered solar energy to each solar module (50); the solar module (50) generating electricity by using the solar energy; a lower plate reflecting mirror (70) reflecting the solar energy which is not allowed to be adsorbed in the solar module (50) and transmitting the same to the solar module (50); and a control box (80) in which a battery (82) storing electric energy is installed, thereby maximizing generating efficiency of the solar energy.

title: Solar energy multidirectional tracking photovoltaic power generating system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy multidirectional tracking photovoltaic power generating system, which adopts a group of solar energy optical lenses consisting of a plurality of reflecting mirrors, a Fresnel lens and a plane mirror; a rotating shaft of each solar energy optical lens is arranged on a solar energy lens support frame with different shapes; each solar energy optical lens can rotate around the shaft; the solar energy lens support frame also can move simultaneously so as to achieve the multidirectional tracking of the solar energy lenses rotating around the rotating shaft and moving along with the solar energy lens support frame; because the multidirectional tracking reduces the difficulty of single-shaft tracking, the scope of a focus in a cylinder region is simultaneously reduced, the focal time is improved, and the use temperature is improved; because a solar energy photovoltaic battery board is arranged within the cylinder region and can be arranged on the ground or a building and keep unchanged during the movement of the solar energy lenses, the focus of the solar energy photovoltaic battery board adopts changed focus tracking; and various utilization of focus tracking solar energy can be achieved through arranging the solar energy photovoltaic battery board in a cylinder. The utility model provides an array structure, is suitable for systems with different scales and is also suitable for the large-scale utilization of the solar energy simultaneously, in particular to the photovoltaic power generation and the heat utilization of the solar energy.

title: Solar charging station with automatically function of charging
abstract: The utility model provides a solar charging station with automatically function of charging, including the solar charging system and the fixing device that charges, the solar charging system with the fixing device that charges links to each other, solar charging head with the first telescopic link of solar charging links to each other, the solar energy protective sheath sets up the first telescopic link of the solar charging outside, solar energy butt joint connecting block is fixed solar energy protective sheath both sides, solar energy butt joint connecting block passes through solar energy butt joint axis of rotation with solar energy butt joint pole with solar energy butt joint dead lever links to each other, solar energy butt joint pole with solar energy butt joint dead lever links to each other, solar energy butt joint pole free end with solar energy butt joint movable pulley links to each other. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that effectively improving the automation of charging station and dismantling the function, the resource of the charging station of being convenient for is allocated, and the self-calibration function has effectively improved the automatic charging capability of charging station moreover, has effectively saved the manpower.

title: Energy-saving solar electric motorcycle
abstract: The utility model relates to a motorcycle, in particular to an energy-saving solar electric motorcycle. The energy-saving solar electric motorcycle comprises an electric motorcycle, a solar battery, a supporting plate, a supporting rod, a supporting pipe, a solar controller, a storage battery, a charger and an automatic changeover switch, wherein solar energy is converted into electric energy through the solar battery, so as to be stored in the storage battery and serve as the power source of the energy-saving solar electric motorcycle; and electric energy supply is used for supplementation. The energy-saving solar electric motorcycle has the advantages of original conception, compact structure, easiness in manufacture, and convenience in use, develops solar energy, saves electric energy, achieves energy conservation and consumption reduction, has obvious economic benefits, can be widely popularized and applied, and is also suitable for the energy-saving improvement of the conventional electric motorcycle.

title: Maximum power tracing method for solar power system and solar power device
abstract: The invention discloses a maximum power tracking method for a solar energy power supply system and the solar energy power supply unit thereof, relating to solar power generation technical field. And the method tracks the maximum power of the solar energy system by dynamic balancing. According to the method, it adds in intelligent charging-discharing mechanism to form an intelligent coordination solar energy device, comprising at least a solar panel, super capacitor, DC/DC buck-boost converter, pulse width modulation driver, storage battery, logic controller and load; and the method is characterized in that an instant power type super capacitor is connected between the solar panel and the DC/DC buck-boost converter to act as an energy dynamic balancer; it converts the electric energy produced by the solar panel into capacitor type electric energy to make the maximum power calculation, able to largely simplify calculation program, improving tracking calculation real-timeness and reliability and raising solar energy system efficiency. And the invention can be widely applied to solar LED lamps, and solar energy lamps, especially solar energy street lamps, solar traffic signal lamps, solar energy engineering lamps, etc.

title: STEREOSCOPIC SOLAR AND SOUND ENERGY ABSORPTION AND CONVERSION DEVIECE
abstract: A stereoscopic solar and sound energy absorption and conversion device includes a base, a solar energy absorption converter, a sound energy absorption converter, a storage battery and an execution device. The base is stereoscopic. The solar energy absorption converter, the sound energy absorption converter, the storage battery and the execution device are installed on the base. The solar energy absorption converter and the sound energy absorption converter are connected with the storage battery, so as to absorb solar energy and sound energy and convert them into electric energy. The storage battery supplies power for the execution device. The solar and sound energy absorption and conversion device absorbs solar and sound energy in the daytime, then converts them into electric energy, and at night, the electric energy is used for illumination or music playing and so on.

title: Solar power system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar power system. The solar power system comprises a solar energy collecting device, a solar energy collecting unit, a controller, a load circuit, a storage battery and a remote management server, wherein the solar energy collecting device is used for collecting sunlight beams and converting solar energy into electric energy; the solar energy collecting unit comprises a plurality of photosensitive elements, a microprocessor and a driving module; the controller is used for controlling the electric energy to supply power to the load circuit or charge and discharge the storage battery, monitoring the states of the storage battery and the solar energy collecting device, and transmitting monitored state information to the remote management server; and the storage battery is electrically connected with the controller, and used for storing or releasing electric energy. Through adoption of the solar power system disclosed by the invention, the sunlight beams can be tracked automatically; the solar energy is utilized at maximum efficiency; real-time monitoring of the storage battery and the solar energy collecting device is realized; and the occurrence of faults of the solar power system is prevented.

title: Solar energy photovoltaic device of vacuum glass tube and method
abstract: The invention aims to provide a solar energy photovoltaic device of a vacuum glass tube. Solar energy optical to electrical material is arranged and processed in the vacuum layer of the vacuum glass tube to convert solar energy into electric energy; after the vacuum glass tube is sealed, the vacuum glass tube can be directly used and does not need to be packaged so as to lower the cost of the existing optical to electrical material; meanwhile, fluid or a heat pipe can be arranged in the cavity of a vacuum glass tube transmitting device to control the temperature of the solar energy optical to electrical material, so that the solar energy optical to electrical material can always keep high-efficiency conversion effect, and heat energy is comprehensively utilized after being transferred by the fluid or the heat pipe, and thus, solar energy generation and temperature control are realized, solar energy conversion efficiency is improved, and solar energy heat is comprehensively and integrally utilized. In order to improve solar energy utilization efficiency, a solar energy mirror is arranged out of the device to focus solar energy, i.e. reflect, refract, project solar energy, and in order to reduce heat waste, an insulating layer is added out of the device.

title: Method for incubation and production through combination of solar energy and air energy or through application of solar energy in series connection with boiler
abstract: The invention discloses a method for incubation and production through combination of solar energy and air energy or through application of the solar energy in series connection with a boiler. A solar energy heat collecting device (2) is combined with an air energy hot water device (12) for use, or the solar energy heat collecting device is connected with the boiler in series for use. Water is used as a carrier, heat energy is transmitted to an incubation and production workshop (9), and therefore an incubation temperature is obtained in incubation. The solar energy is combined with the air energy for use or the solar energy is connected with the boiler in series for use, when it becomes cloudy and solar heat energy cannot meet the requirement for production, the air energy hot water device is started or the boiler performs heating to overcome the defects of the solar heat energy, and therefore energy is saved, emission is reduced and efficiency is improved.

title: Solar energy water heater of a compact structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy water heater of a compact structure, characterized in that; the solar energy water heater comprises a set of solar energy battery arrays capable of conversing the solar energy into the electric energy and an electric heater connected with the solar energy battery arrays by wires, the electric heater is arranged in a heat collection plate to heat the water in the heat collection plate, the solar energy battery arrays are laid on the upper surface of a hot water tank. Because a set of the solar energy battery arrays on the upper surface of the hot water tank and the matched electric heater are added, the hot water heated by the solar energy is heated for the second time and the solar energy is completely used.
