title: Solar energy collecting system
abstract: A solar energy system for collecting solar energy in the form of solar radiation and for storing and utilizing the energy collected including stationary solar energy collecting units each comprising a generally concave reflective surface for reflecting solar radiation onto a plurality of energy collectors positioned within the surface, the surface and the energy collectors positioned with respect to each other to provide varying concentration of solar radiation on each of the energy collectors depending on the angle of incidence of the solar radiation on the solar energy collecting unit. Each of the energy collectors is associated with a pipe for fluid circulation and solar energy absorption through which fluid to be heated by the solar radiation is circulated. The pipe may be surrounded by a glass enclosure and the space between the pipe and the glass enclosure may be evacuated to provide insulation. The surface of the glass enclosure may be reflective to provide for further concentration of solar radiation upon the pipe. The system includes thermostatically controlled valves associated with each of the energy collectors for selectively transferring away only that fluid which has been heated to a predetermined temperature.

title: Omnidirectional rotation type solar energy intelligent automatic control sun-shading system
abstract: An omnidirectional rotation type solar energy intelligent automatic control sun-shading system can overcome the defects of single rotation direction of an existing solar energy sun-shading plate. The omnidirectional rotation type solar energy intelligent automatic control sun-shading system comprises solar energy sun-shading plate frameworks, energy conversion devices, driving devices and support devices, wherein each solar energy sun-shading plate framework comprises a solar energy sun-shading plate, a solar energy sun-shading plate inner frame and a solar energy sun-shading plate outer frame, and the solar energy sun-shading plate inner frame is connected with the solar energy sun-shading plate outer frame by solar energy sun-shading plate rotation shafts; each driving device is composed of two sets of electric machine push rods, the first electric machine push rod is installed on a the window body support, the second electric machine push rod is installed on the solar energy sun-shading plate outer frame, slip joints of the two sets of electric machine push rods are matched with sliding grooves in the solar energy sun-shading plate inner frame and the solar energy sun-shading plate outer frame respectively; each energy conversion device comprises the solar energy sun-shading plate, a storage battery, a charging protector, an inverter and a programmable controller; the support device is used for supporting the whole system. Through the system, a plurality of element modules can be connected into a whole and then fixed on a window body.

title: Variable focal distance and adjustable direction Fresnel solar energy reflection field
abstract: Solar energy is inexhaustible clean energy, but its energy density is low, and solar energy development and utilization must have a huge solar energy field to gather solar energy. The present invention provides a new, high efficient and economic solar energy reflection field with high concentrating ratio-a variable focal distance and adjustable direction Fresnel solar energy reflection field. The field is a vertical projection of a huge spinning paraboloidal in parallel to earth axis on the horizontal plane, the focal distance is variable and the direction is adjustable, so that the trough type linear focusing becomes spot type focusing by using a solar energy reflection sheet, large-scale industrialized manufacturing of economic and high efficient solar energy field with high concentrating ratio is possible and a new revolution in the whole solar thermoelectric field certainly will generate.

title: Solar energy electric fan
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy electric fan, which includes a solar energy battery, an electric fan and a plug connected with the electric fan. The solar energy electric fan is characterized in that a box body is further included, the solar energy battery is nested on the top surface of the box body, a jack matched with the plug is formed on the box body, and the plug can be inserted into the jack and communicated with a lead of the solar energy battery. After the plug and the jack are matched, the solar energy battery and the electric fan are communicated through the lead, and the solar energy battery can continuously adsorb the solar energy and converts into electric energy under the outdoor sunny environment, so that the electric fan can be driven to run for a long time and have the advantages of energy conservation and environmental protection.

title: Solar charger
abstract: The invention discloses a solar charger, comprising a box, a solar panel arranged on the surface of the box, a charging control module and a charging module, wherein the charging control module and the charging module are arranged inside the box; the solar panel converts received solar energy into electric energy and then outputs the electric energy; the charging control module is respectively electrically connected with the solar panel and the charging module and is used for controlling the electric energy transmission of the solar panel and the charging module; the charging module receives the electric energy output by the solar panel and supplies power to the outside; the charging module comprises a power storage unit and a power supply unit; and the power storage unit is used for receiving the electric energy output by the solar panel, storing electric energy and transmitting the stored electric energy to the power supply unit. Thus, the charger can not only convert the solar energy into the electric energy and supply power to the outside, but also convert the solar energy into the electric energy and then store the electric energy, so that the charger can supply power to or charge other electronic equipment in the open air.

title: Intelligent solar power supply system
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent solar power supply system, which comprises a solar energy collection module, a solar energy detection module, a central control module, a power supply module and an electric energy output module, wherein the central control module is internally provided with a low solar energy storage capacity database corresponding to the low storage capacity, a high solarenergy storage capacity database corresponding to the high storage capacity and a medium solar energy storage capacity database corresponding to the storage capacity between the low storage capacity and the high storage capacity according to the solar energy storage capacity detected by the solar energy detection module; and the power supply module internally stores a low power supply capacity database corresponding to the low solar energy storage capacity, a medium power supply capacity database corresponding to the medium solar energy storage capacity and a high power supply capacity database corresponding to the high solar energy storage capacity. The intelligent solar power supply system can reasonably control the use of power according to the strength of solar energy.

title: Patrol robot device and patrol system
abstract: The invention provides a patrol robot device and a patrol system. The device comprises a spherical shell, an energy storage cell, solar cell modules and a travelling mechanism; each solar photovoltaiccell module comprises a solar energy collection film layer and a solar energy conversion circuit; the solar energy collection film layer coats the outer side of the spherical shell and is used for collecting solar energy and converting, through the solar energy conversion circuit, the solar energy into electric energy and inputting the electric energy into the energy storage cell; a U-shaped opening is formed in a preset position of the spherical shell; the patrol robot device is hung on a preset wire of an electric transmission line through the U-shaped opening; and the travelling mechanismis arranged in the spherical shell, and is used for driving, according to the electric energy provided by the energy storage cell, the patrol robot to travel on the preset wire.

title: 2two dimensional solar energy system
abstract: PURPOSE: A two-dimensional solar energy system is provided to pragmatize, generalize and commercialize the solar energy by making the solar energy utilized in a small space. Thus, a multi-stage combination solar energy system composed of solar cells is built up. In the two-dimensional solar energy system, a both-sided mirror, a polygonal mirror, a spherical mirror, a cylindrical mirror and a pole-shaped mirror are installed. Herein, chain reflection of light occurs and the light is continuously reflected. The light is geometrically activated, intensified and developed. Therefore, the amount of the light and heat absorbed in the solar energy system is maximized.

title: Solar energy charging press-key modular construction
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy charging press key module structure which comprises at least one transparent touch panel, at least one printing layer, a brightness enhancement film, a solar panel and a circuit board; the structure of the invention is the solar energy charging press key module structure in which the solar panel is arranged under the transparent touch panel provided with a touch point or the press key to cause the solar panel to be capable of absorbing light energy and transforming the light energy to electrical energy and then accumulating the electrical energy. The brightness enhancement film and the solar panel are arranged under the printing layer, which are used for absorbing and transforming the light energy to the electrical energy. Furthermore, the circuit board is arranged under the solar panel and electrically connected to touch components and/or the solar panel. The solar panel absorbs and transforms the light energy to the electrical energy so as to provide electric power required by an electronic device provided with the solar energy charging press key module structure.

title: Portable solar lighting device
abstract: The utility model relates to a portable solar energy lamp, which comprises a lamp shade 3, a lamp base 5 and a solar energy photovoltaic electroluminescence device composed of a solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1, an electroluminescence sheet 2 and a solar energy charging and discharging processor 4, wherein the lamp shade 3 is fixed to the lamp base 5. The solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1 is connected with the solar energy charging and discharging processor 4. The solar energy charging and discharging processor 4 is connected with the electroluminescence sheet 2. The solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1 and the electroluminescence sheet 2 are fixed to the lamp shade 3. The solar energy charging and discharging processor 4 is fixed to the lamp base 5. The utility model has the advantages of environmental protection, energy resource and manpower saving, and high brightness.

title: Solar energy power supply device for street lamp

The solar energy power supply device comprises a solar panel, a solar controller, a storage battery and a galvanostat, wherein the solar controller is connected with the solar panel and controls the solar panel to receive solar energy, the solar controller is connected with the storage battery and controls the storage battery to charge and discharge, and the solar controller is connected with the street lamp through the galvanostat and controls turning on and turning off of the lamp. The solar energy power supply device for the street lamp has the advantages of being simple in equipment structure, fully utilizing renewable solar energy and reducing energy loss and discharge of carbon dioxide.

title: Solar self-heating floor
abstract: The invention discloses a solar self-heating floor comprising a solar cell panel which is installed on an external wall; a solar absorption panel which is installed on the solar cell panel for absorbing the solar energy; an energy emission unit which is installed under the solar cell panel; an energy reception unit which is installed inside a base plate; an energy storage unit which is installed around the energy reception unit; a control unit which is used for controlling the on and off of the solar self-heating floor. title: Cold region solar energy integrated electricity and heat combined supply system and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a cold region solar energy integrated electricity and heat combined supply system and a control method. A cold region solar integrated electricity and heat combined supply system comprises a solar photoelectric system and a solar heat collection and supply system, the solar photoelectric system is used for converting solar energy into electric energy and transmitting the electric energy to an electric load, and the solar heat collection and supply system is used for converting solar energy into heat energy and transmitting the heat energy to a heat load; the system further comprises electricity storage equipment and heat storage equipment, the electricity storage equipment is connected with the solar photoelectric system so as to store redundant electric energy in the electricity storage equipment, and the heat storage equipment is connected with the solar photoelectric system and the solar heat collection and supply system so as to store the redundant electric energy in the electricity storage equipment. Redundant electric energy is converted into heat energy, the heat energy is stored in the heat storage equipment, and redundant heat energy is stored in the heat storage equipment; and the heat storage equipment is connected with the thermal load so as to supply heat to the thermal load. title: OUTDOOR UNIT FOR AIR CONDITIONER
abstract: An outdoor unit for an air conditioner is provided to supply electric energy by using solar energy. An outdoor unit of an air conditioner including a casing forming the appearance of the outdoor unit. A collection section(300) is provided on one surface of the casing to collect solar energy. abstract: The utility model discloses a self-adaptive solar energy collecting device based on a cooling water tower of a power station, and belongs to the technical field of design and manufacture of solar energy collecting devices. title: Solar energy shed
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy technologies, in particular to a solar energy shed. The solar energy shed comprises reflection elements, at least two solar energy battery assemblies, a shed body and supporting parts in the same number with the solar energy battery assemblies, wherein all the supporting parts are fixed on the top end of the shed body in the straight direction; the bottom end of each battery assembly is fixed with the top end of the shed body; the top end of each solar battery assembly is fixed with the top end of one supporting part; and one reflection element is arranged between every two solar energy battery assemblies, and the two ends of the reflection element are respectively connected with the solar energy battery assemblies at the two sides. According to the solar energy shed provided by the utility model, sunlight around the solar energy battery assemblies can be fully utilized, and the working efficiencies of the solar energy battery assemblies can be improved.

title: Solar energy umbrella
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy umbrella which structurally comprises solar energy sheets, a storage battery, an electric energy converter, a controller, an LED lamp bulb, a switch, sunshade cloth and an umbrella handle. The solar energy sheets are embedded in the sunshade cloth to be fully arranged on the surface of the sunshade cloth in an embedded mode. The electric energy converter, the storage batteries, the controller, the switch and the LED lamp bulb are installed on the umbrella handle from top to bottom and sequentially connected through wires. Heat energy is absorbed through the solar energy sheets on the sunshade cloth and converted into electric energy through the electric energy converter, the electric energy is stored in the storage batteries, the storage batteries can be chargeable batteries, and the chargeable batteries are charged through solar energy. title: Solar energy eave covering
abstract: Provided is a solar energy eave covering. The solar energy eave covering comprises a covering main body and a solar energy power supply device, wherein the covering main body and the solar energy power supply device are arranged in a vertical mode. The solar energy power supply device comprises a seat body which is fixedly installed on a wall body of a house, a flexible solar cell panel which can be rolled up inside the seat body and can cover a surface, exposing to the sun, of the covering main body, and a storage battery which is connected with the flexible solar cell panel. The solar energy eave covering is reasonable in structural design, and uses solar energy which is renewable energy. Power supply requirements of electric equipment such as a lamp in front of a door and an automatic rolling door are satisfied. title: Solar combined heat energy and cold energy supplying system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar combined heat energy and cold energy supplying system which is a solar energy utilizing product which can generate heat energy and cold energy at the same time by means of solar energy. The solar combined heat energy and cold energy supplying system is mainly composed of a condenser (1), a photovoltaic cell (2), a heat circulation pump (3), a heat energy storage tank (5), a cold energy storage tank (7), a cold circulation pump (8), a cold exchanger (9), a semiconductor chilling plate (11), a heat exchanger (12) and a medium (13). The solar combined heat energy and cold energy supplying system is characterized in that electric energy generated through solar energy is directly used for conducting heating and refrigerating, two purposes are achieved, the comprehensive solar energy utilization rate is increased, a large amount of solar energy can be used for supplying a large amount of heat energy and a large amount of cold energy to people for production and living, solar energy can be used for heating and refrigerating in areas where sunlight is sufficient, and the solar combined heat energy and cold energy supplying system is suitable for the field of heating and refrigerating for industrial and agricultural production and for living of people.

title: Heating control system based on solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a heating control system based on solar energy. The heating control system comprises a solar heating module connected with a control module for acquiring the solar energy and heating a hot water collecting tank through the solar energy, a temperature obtaining module for obtaining a temperature T of the hot water collecting tank, a solar power storage module for acquiring the solar energy and converting the solar energy to electric energy, an electric energy heating module for heating the hot water collecting tank through the electric energy in the solar power storage module, and a control module connected with the solar heating module, the temperature obtaining module, the solar power storage module and the electric energy heating module; the control module obtains T through the temperature obtaining module within preset time t1; T is compared with a preset heating temperature T0; the solar heating module and the solar power storage module are controlled to act according to the compared result; the control module obtains T within preset time t2; T is compared with a preset electric energy heating temperature T1; and the solar heating module and the solar power storage module are controlled to act according to the compared result.

title: Solar energy and multi-energy complementary air conditioner
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioning equipment, and discloses a solar energy and multi-energy complementary air conditioner which comprises a fan coil. The electric energy refrigeration part is communicated with the fan coil and used for providing a cold source for the fan coil, and the electric energy refrigeration part is communicated with an external power supply; the solar refrigeration assembly comprises a heat collection part and a solar refrigeration part, the solar refrigeration part is communicated with the fan coil, a circulation pipeline is formed between the solar refrigeration part and the fan coil, the solar refrigeration part provides a cold source for the fan coil, the fan coil provides return water for the solar refrigeration part, and the solar refrigeration part is communicated with the heat collection part. The heat collection part is used for converting solar energy into heat energy and supplying the heat energy to the solar refrigeration part; the water purification unit is communicated with an external water source, and the water purification unit is used for providing the water source for the electric energy refrigeration part, the solar energy refrigeration part and the fan coil. Combined use of solar energy and electric energy is achieved, and constant temperature is guaranteed while energy is saved.

title: Solar energy sea water desalination apparatus
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy sea water desalinating apparatus, which is composed of a solar energy water heater of a vacuum pipe, a solar energy evaporator, a solar energy desalinating evaporator, a draught fan, a steam condenser, a water pump and a fresh water storing tank, wherein, the water pump, the steam condenser, the solar energy water heater of a vacuum pipe and the solar energy evaporator are connected together in series through a pipeline, the solar energy evaporator is connected together with the head and the tail of the solar energy desalinating evaporator in series, the top end of the solar energy evaporator is connected with the draught fan in series through a pipeline and is connected with a steam inlet of the steam condenser, and a condensed water outlet of the steam condenser is connected with the fresh water storing tank through a pipeline. The solar energy sea water desalinating apparatus has the characteristics of reasonable design, simple structure, easy processing, convenient use, energy saving, etc.

title: Solar charger
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar charger which comprises solar panels that can receive the solar energy and transform it into electrical energy. The solar panel is connected to the mobile phone omnipotent charger by electricity, and installed with an output terminal of the power supply which is electronically connected with two solar panels. The two solar panels is in parallel connection and connected with the output terminal of the power supply which is connected with the solar charger in parallel and the solar charger itself by electric wires. The solar charger, depending on the solar panel to transforming the solar energy into electrical energy, outputs the electrical energy to the omnipotent charger by the mobile phone. The omnipotent charger is used to meet the demands of charging different types of phone batteries and the needs of charging the phone batteries at any times and at any places by taking advantage of the solar energy. Besides, by using the output function of the electrical energy on the solar panel, the demand of supplying electrical energy to various digital products and small household appliances is achieve.

title: Structure of solar-energy plate
abstract: The utility model relates to a structure of a solar-energy plate and belongs to machinery. One side of the solar-energy plate is provided with a solar-energy receiving surface, the other side of the solar-energy plate is provided with a temperature control device, and the solar-energy plate and the temperature control device are in electric connection with an energy storage assembly. The temperature control device can be cooling slices, watering pipelines and conductors with impedance. When the solar-energy receiving surface receives solar energy in daylight, the temperature control device is positioned in the energy storage assembly. When the temperature tends to rise or lower, energy in the energy storage assembly is used for driving the temperature control device to cool or heat.

title: Photovoltaic modules for solar concentrator
abstract: An energy conversion system comprises a solar cell adapted to receive solar energy and convert the solar energy into electrical energy. The energy conversion system also comprises a solar concentrator adapted to receive solar energy and direct the solar energy to the solar cell. The solar concentrator has a lens that comprises at least one line focus section comprising an off-axis configuration, at least one spherical section adjacent to the at least one line focus section, the at least one spherical section comprising an off-axis configuration, and an unpatterned section adjacent to the at least one line focus section and the at least one spherical section.

title: Multifunctional solar energy curtain
abstract: The invention relates to multifunctional solar energy curtain equipment, in particular to an integrated curtain with a solar energy cell, a lighting lamp, a charger and a monitoring device. The invention relates to the novel curtain, in particular to the multifunctional solar energy curtain. The solar energy curtain comprises 1, a piece of curtain cloth with the solar energy cell, 2, a curtain frame connecting all parts, 3, an energy storage system composed of an accumulator and a microcontroller and 4 three independent functional systems of the lighting lamp, the charger and the monitor. The multifunctional solar energy curtain is characterized that the multifunctional curtain is the equipment which combines the curtain, the lighting lamp, the charger and the monitor to be a whole; the multifunctional curtain is a curtain and also can illuminate and provide the charging and monitoring functions; and the solar energy cell of the multifunctional curtain provides electricity for the multifunctional curtain. The multifunctional solar energy curtain has the beneficial effects that the solar energy curtain has the characteristics of diverse functions, energy saving, safety and quick mounting, when the solar energy curtain is used, energy is clean, and environmental friendliness is facilitated.

title: Ocean power generation and solar power generation combining system adopting nanometer friction generator
abstract: The invention discloses an ocean power generation and solar power generation combining system adopting nanometer friction generators. The invention aims to solve the problem that there is no such a power generation system capable of using ocean energy and solar energy for power generation at the same time in the prior art. The system comprises an ocean power generator, a solar energy assembly and an energy storage device. The ocean power generator comprises at least one nanometer friction generator used for converting mechanical energy into electric energy. The solar energy assembly is composed of a plurality of solar batteries. The solar batteries are connected in series or in parallel to form at least two output ends of the solar energy assembly. Each solar battery is a photoelectric conversion unit which is made of semiconductor material and is of a PN junction type structure. The energy storage device is connected with the output ends of the nanometer friction generators and the at least two output ends of the solar energy assembly, and is used for storing electric energy output by the nanometer friction generators and electric energy output by the solar energy assembly.

title: Vehicle-mounted solar tracking power generation system
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted solar tracking power generation system. The system comprises a fixed solar panel, a sliding solar panel, a support, a double-axis driver, an elevation mechanism, a moving device, a controller and a solar energy conversion device, wherein the fixed solar panel is mounted on the support, the sliding solar panel is in sliding connection with the fixed solar panel via the sliding mechanism, and the sliding solar panel can be unfolded or folded relative to the fixed solar panel; the support is mounted on the elevation mechanism via the double-axis driver, and the double-axis driver drives the support to rotate and swing; the elevation mechanism is mounted on the moving device; and the controller and the solar energy conversion device are arranged on the moving device, the controller is connected with the double-axis driver, the elevation mechanism, the sliding mechanism and the solar energy conversion device, and the solar energy conversion device converts solar energy into electric energy. The power generation system can improve the absorption efficiency of solar energy and the convenience in movement, solar energy can be used for power generation in the driving process, and the solar panels are convenient to store and transport.

title: Novel solar energy warning post
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel solar energy warning post, its characterized in that: a novel solar energy warning post is including warning post body, solar cell panel body, LED warning light, reflection of light lens, warning capital portion is equipped with the opening and screw, bottom are equipped with the base, the solar cell panel body is installed in the opening of warning capital portion and through screw, the LED warning light is connected to the waterproof connector of solar cell panel body output connection, the outer screw reflection of light lens of LED warning light, the solar cell panel body includes: solar energy protective housing, solar panel base, solar energy LED lamp, the solar energy protective housing glues through glue with the solar energy base and fuses, install solar panel on the solar energy base, solar panel passes through the wire and connects solar control board, solar energy poultry battery, solar energy LED lamp, the wide application of this product in the bus stop and the people moving walkways district section of highways at different levels. Can show the emergence in order to avoid the traffic accident to the driver as police dispatch in low visibility such as greasy weather weather.

title: Household cluster type solar energy generating system
abstract: A household cluster type solar energy generating system comprises a commercial power connecting end, a load circuit, a cluster type solar energy generating device and a storage battery. An inversion system is disposed between the storage battery and the load circuit, and is connected with the cluster type solar energy generating device. The inversion system is also connected with the commercial power connecting end. The household cluster type solar energy generating system relates to a solar energy generating device. Power is supplied to a load together by the cluster type solar energy generating device and a commercial power. The cluster type solar energy generating device is capable of storing electric energy converted from solar energy in the storage battery, and when the storage battery can not be fully stored with the solar energy, the storage battery can be charged through the commercial power.

title: Solar energy and wind energy complementary communication base station tower
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy and wind energy complementary communication base station tower, which comprises a tower pole, a first base station load, a control box, a solar battery module, a solar controller, a wind energy generator, a wind energy controller, a storage battery, an inverter and a second base station load, wherein the solar battery module is connected with the solar controller; the wind energy generator is connected with the wind energy controller; the solar controller and the wind energy controller are connected with the storage battery; and the storage battery, the inverter and the base station loads are sequentially connected. Through the solar battery module and the solar controller, solar energy is converted into electric energy and is stored in the storage battery; through the wind energy generator and the wind energy controller, wind energy is converted into electric energy to be stored in the storage battery; then, the electric energy in the storage battery is converted into alternating current through the inverter, and electricity is supplied to the base station loads; the solar energy and wind energy complementary communication base station tower is applicable to remote mountainous areas with lagging electric power facilities; clean and pollution-free solar energy and wind energy are used for supplying electricity to a base station; the electric energy is saved for the mountainous areas lack of electric power; and the trouble of arranging and distributing electric networks on the mountain is avoided.

title: Device for tracking, receiving and transmitting solar energy
abstract: The utility model relates to a device for tracking, receiving and transmitting solar energy, which is provided with a supporting structure for supporting a solar-energy battery board structure and driving the solar-energy battery board structure to rotate and a driving circuit for driving the solar-energy battery board structure to overturn and driving the supporting structure to drive the solar-energy battery board structure to rotate. The solar-energy battery board structure is provided with a solar-energy battery board, an optical receiving unit, an overturn motor and a positioning structure, wherein the optical receiving unit is formed above solar-energy battery board and connected with the driving circuit; the overturn motor is used for driving the solar-energy battery board to overturn; and the positioning structure is used for fixing the solar-energy battery board on the supporting structure and can simultaneously and easily overturning the solar-energy battery board. The driving circuit is provided with a roller driving circuit, a first relay circuit, a second relay circuit, a third relay circuit, a fourth relay circuit and a resetting circuit, wherein the first relay circuit, the second relay circuit, the third relay circuit and the fourth relay circuit are used for controlling the roller driving circuit and simultaneously and respectively controlling the overturn and the rotation of the solar-energy battery board structure according to signals of the roller driving circuit. In the utility model, the solar-energy battery board is always dead against solar, so that the availability of the solar energy is improved.

title: Self-adaptive solar energy collecting device mounted on power plant cooling water tower
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive solar energy collecting device mounted on a power plant cooling water tower, and belongs to the technical field of solar energy collecting device designing andmanufacturing. The device can realize solar energy collection, and has the functions of adjusting an illuminated surface and adjusting a light-facing angle. The device comprises a foldable solar energy collecting part, a fixing ring part and a winch part, wherein a fixing ring is fixed to the outer surface of the power plant cooling water tower, the foldable solar energy collecting part and a winch system are arranged on the fixing ring, and a solar automatic tracking device is mounted on the illuminated surface of the solar energy collecting part. Under the monitoring of the automatic tracking device, the foldable solar energy collecting part can rotate around the cooling water tower as solar energy operates from east to west, and angles between solar panels and a horizontal plane can beautomatically adjusted at the same time, so that the solar panels are always in a vertical state with incident light; and the self-adaptive solar energy collecting device is mainly applied to the field of solar energy collection.

title: Photovoltaic solar energy, solar heat and air energy water heater and gravity circulation air conditioner integration system
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of solar energy utilization, and relates to a photovoltaic solar energy, solar heat and air energy water heater and gravity circulation air conditioner integration system, in particular to an integration system which achieves air conditioning on the same heat collection and exchange device and heats water through photovoltaic solar energy, solar heat and air energy. Structurally, the integration system is mainly composed of the wall-mounted photovoltaic solar energy, solar heat and air energy heat collection and exchange device (a), a gravity circulation air conditioner terminal (b), a compressor and a water tank heat exchanger (3). The integration system has the advantages that the manufacturing process and installing process are simple, installation and decoration are integrated and can be personally customized, energy conservation and consumption reduction are achieved through gravity circulation of air, and the solar heat collection and exchange device can collect the photovoltaic solar energy, the solar heat and the air energy at the same time when exchanging heat so that the solar energy utilization ratio can be increased and the cost can be lowered.

title: Roof module having an integral solar energy concentrator
abstract: The present invention relates to a roof module having an integral solar energy concentrator. The present modules can be combined to form a weathertight roof with an integral solar concentrator. Radiant solar energy can be collected from this modular roof using reflected solar energy collectors, among other solar energy concentrating or energy transferring elements. The present invention results in a lower weight and easier to install system for placing solar energy concentrators atop a structure, and thus, lower the cost collecting radiant solar energy from atop a building or roofed structure.

title: Solar hybrid regeneration eddy-current gas-turbine power generation system
abstract: The utility model relates to a system capable of converting solar energy into electric energy and particularly relates to a solar hybrid regeneration eddy-current gas-turbine power generation system. The power generation system comprises a solar energy-electric energy conversion assembly and a solar energy focusing device, wherein the solar energy-electric energy conversion assembly internally comprises a solar heat energy collector, a turbine, an air compressor, a power generator and a heat regenerator; the solar heat energy collector receives solar energy from the solar energy focusing device; the turbine, the air compressor and the power generator are coaxially arranged; the compressor is connected with the heat regenerator; the heat regenerator is connected with the solar heat energy collector; and an output shaft of the turbine is connected with an input shaft of the power generator.. The solar hybrid regeneration eddy-current gas-turbine power generation system provided by utility model serves as an energy source conversion system which is high in efficiency and less in heat loss, generates electricity by utilizing high-temperature heat energy generated by the focusing of a renewable resource, solar energy, and is low in equipment cost; and the power generation system provided by utility model solves the technical problems that the energy consumption required by power generation is high, the efficiency is low, and the operating cost is high in the prior art.

title: Solar energy storage system
abstract: A solar energy storage system comprises an electromagnetic power generator for first-level solar energy, an electromagnetic power generator for second-level solar energy, a transformer, a frequency modulation chip and an energy storage structure, wherein the electromagnetic power generator for first-level solar energy, the electromagnetic power generator for second-level solar energy, the transformer, the frequency modulation chip and the energy storage structure are electrically communicated; a lead-out port of the electromagnetic power generator for second-level solar energy is connected with an access port of the transformer, the transformer adopts a multi-winding coil structure, and the energy storage structure adopts a solar cell. The defect that absorbed solar energy cannot meet the requirement due to the fact that the coverage area of a photovoltaic module is usually not large enough is overcome effectively.

title: Non-heat pump type photovoltaic photo-thermal energy complementation system and complementation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of comprehensive utilization of solar energy, in particular to a non-heat pump type photovoltaic photo-thermal energy complementation system which comprises an energy basic unit, a photovoltaic photo-thermal solar system, a power supply and heat supply compensation system and a heat supply system. The photovoltaic photo-thermal solar system is used for converting solar energy into heat energy, carrying out building indoor heating compensation or/and geothermal compensation and meanwhile converting the solar energy into electric energy; a heat energy storage unit of the photovoltaic photo-thermal solar system is connected with an energy basic unit and a heating system. The photovoltaic solar panel is connected with an electricity storage device of the solar power system, and the heating system is connected with the energy base unit and is used for indoor heating or refrigeration of a building. The photovoltaic photo-thermal solar system is connected with the heating system and the energy base unit, and a heat energy storage unit of the photovoltaic photo-thermal solar system is connected with the energy base unit; and geothermal energy can be supplemented, and energy complementation is achieved.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION
abstract: A system for solar energy utilization is described. The system comprises a solar receiver, a solar energy concentrator mounted on a pole extending from the solar receiver along the main axis of the system, and a solar tracking system. The solar receiver is configured for receiving solar energy from the sun and concentrating the received solar energy at a predetermined spot area. The solar receiver includes a plurality of flexible mirrors independent of each other and radially arranged around a main axis of the system. The flexible mirrors are configured to be either deployed for operation or collapsed, for example for transportation or in the cases of possible damage of the system. The solar energy concentrator is located at the predetermined spot area in which the solar energy reflected from said plurality of flexible mirrors is concentrated, and configured for converting the concentrated reflected energy into electric energy. The solar tracking system is configured for sensing position of the sun and tilting the system for directing the solar receiver towards the sun to receive and reflect maximum sunlight onto the predetermined spot area.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION
abstract: A system for solar energy utilization is described. The system comprises a solar receiver, a solar energy concentrator mounted on a pole extending from the solar receiver along the main axis of the system, and a solar tracking system. The solar receiver is configured for receiving solar energy from the sun and concentrating the received solar energy at a predetermined spot area. The solar receiver includes a plurality of flexible mirrors independent of each other and radially arranged around a main axis of the system. The flexible mirrors are configured to be either deployed for operation or collapsed, for example for transportation or in the cases of possible damage of the system. The solar energy concentrator is located at the predetermined spot area in which the solar energy reflected from said plurality of flexible mirrors is concentrated, and configured for converting the concentrated reflected energy into electric energy. The solar tracking system is configured for sensing position of the sun and tilting the system for directing the solar receiver towards the sun to receive and reflect maximum sunlight onto the predetermined spot area.

title: Simple solar device
abstract: Disclosed is a simple solar device to overcome the inconvenient usage of the conventional solar panel. The simple solar device comprises at least one solar panel, a charge and discharge controller, and a storage battery, wherein each solar panel comprises a plurality of solar battery slices which transform the solar energy into the electric energy; the solar battery slices store the transformed electric energy at the interior; the charge and discharge controller is arranged at the back side opposite to the sensitive surface of the solar panel; the storage battery is connected with the charge and discharge controller; the storage battery stores the energy of the solar panel via the charge and discharge controller; and the charge and discharge controller controls the storage battery to provide energy to an external load. The simple solar device of the utility model integrates a charge and discharge assembly and a solar panel together and can store the energy converted from the solar energy, thereby allowing to provide energy to an external load at any time any place, which is convenient for carryover and usage.

title: Solar energy greenhouse
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy greenhouse. With the development of science and technology, a variety of solar energy greenhouses are available at present. However, the existing solar energy greenhouses are low in conversion efficiency so that the planting efficiency is influenced, and furthermore, many solar energy greenhouses are assisted by virtue of other devices, and the effects of low carbon and environment protection can not be achieved. The solar energy greenhouse disclosed in the invention comprises a greenhouse body and a ceiling at the top end of the greenhouse body, wherein the ceiling and the greenhouse body are in an integral structure. The solar energy greenhouse is characterized in that a solar energy conversion device is arranged on the ceiling and comprises a controller, a regulation device and an application device. In the integrally designed structure of the solar energy greenhouse, the solar energy conversion device is arranged on the ceiling; the power supply is automatically controlled; and the equipment resources are completed. Therefore, the effects of high efficiency, environment protection, energy conservation and remote control are achieved, and the solar energy greenhouse is convenient to use.

title: Sun jar
abstract: The utility model discloses a sun jar which comprises a jar body, wherein a solar panel, a battery and a lamp are arranged in the jar body; the solar panel is used for receiving solar energy and converting the received solar energy into electric energy; the battery is used for storing the electric energy; and the lamp is communicated with the battery. According to the sun jar, the solar panel which is used for receiving solar energy and converting the solar energy into the electric energy, the battery used for storing the electric energy and the lamp communicated with the battery are arranged in the jar body of the solar jar, so that in the daytime, the sun jar is placed in the sun, an area receiving sunlight on the solar panel is exposed in the sun, the solar panel can converts the received solar energy into the electric energy, and the electric energy is stored in the battery; and at night or in a darker environment, the lamp is communicated with the battery, and the battery is charged fully and provides electric energy for the lamp, so that the lamp can emit sunlight, and a person can see that the sun jar emits the sunlight through the jar body. The sun jar is very attractive, can add warmth to the hearts of people and bring people comfort and courage, and the like.

title: Solar pack
abstract: The utility model relates to a rechargeable solar pack, which can be portable, environment-friendly and energy-saving. The solar pack comprises a pack body, a solar panel fixing frame, a solar panel, a solar charging circuit, an energy storage device, a voltage conversion circuit and a charging panel, wherein the solar panel fixedly arranged on the solar panel fixing frame is electrically connected with the solar charging circuit in the pack body via a lead and used for receiving solar energy, converting the solar energy into electric energy through the solar charging circuit and then outputting the electric energy to the energy storage device in the pack body, the energy storage device is electrically connected with the solar charging circuit and the voltage conversion circuit via leads respectively, the tail end of the voltage conversion circuit is electrically connected with the charging panel and used for converting voltage conducting from the solar charging circuit into voltage required by the charging panel, and the charging panel is provided with a plurality of charge interfaces applicable to external electronic equipment.

title: Current collection type solar energy brick
abstract: The utility model relates to a current collection type solar energy brick, and belongs to the solar energy generating technical field; the solar energy brick is flexible and convenient in usage, needs no mass land occupation in concentration, can be used in the city, and is high in energy utilization rate; the solar energy brick comprises a brick body, a support body, and a solar energy panel arranged between the two; an end face, opposite to the solar energy panel, of the brick body is processed in an indent arc, thus enlarging light receiving angle of the solar energy panel; connecting lines used for connecting adjacent solar energy bricks are arranged in the brick body, so the solar bricks are connected in series in a plugging mode, thus preventing outer complex wiring arrangement; the solar energy brick can be paved in a walking street, a waiting hall and a building wall in the city, and the collected power energy can supply power for surrounding facilities or a power transmission grid.

title: Double-energy solar energy thermal power plant and solar energy collector
abstract: The utility model provides a double-energy solar energy thermal power plant and a solar energy collector. The solar energy collector comprises a solid body having a substantially planar solar energy absorbing collecting surface. The solid body has a first thickness at a center portion tapering to a second thickness at each of a pair of opposing edge portions defining a width of the body. A bore extends completely through the body along its length and is aligned along an axis at the center portion. A window transparent at most solar radiation in the visible spectrum and near UV to infrared-red solar energy wavelengths is disposed at a distance from the collecting surface, the window sealed around a periphery of the collecting surface to define a sealed nitrogen filled gap between the collecting surface and the bottom surface of the window. The solar energy collector is a major component of a large scale solar thermal power plant.

title: Cooling and heating system with solar energy storage coupled fuel gas and heat pump
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar heat utilization and heat pump air conditioners, and discloses a solar energy storage coupling fuel gas and heat pump cooling and heating system which comprises a solar heat collector used for collecting solar energy and converting the solar energy into heat energy; the heat pump is used for realizing refrigerating and heating functions; the gas-fired boiler is used for providing an auxiliary heat source when the solar energy is insufficient; the energy storage device is used for storing redundant energy; the intelligent energy management platform is used for monitoring and optimizing system operation in real time, the solar heat collector is connected with the energy storage device and used for transmitting collected heat energy to the energy storage device to be stored, and the energy storage device is connected with the heat pump and the gas-fired boiler. And by arranging the energy storage device, flexible storage and allocation of cold energy and hot energy are achieved. When the solar energy is sufficient, redundant energy can be stored in the energy storage device, and when the solar energy is insufficient or at night, the energy storage device releases energy to provide auxiliary energy for the heat pump or the gas-fired boiler.

title: Solar energy bicycle
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy bicycle belongs to the vehicle field, it is similar with ordinary bicycle on the whole, and the difference lies in having set up solar power system, battery and light. Solar power system is storage battery charging, and the battery provides the electric energy for the light. It is when outdoor, and solar power system is transformed into solar energy the electric energy and stores in the battery, and the battery can provide the electric energy for the light. And, can also adjust solar cell panel's position according to the bicycle for solar position toin make full use of solar energy. Above -mentioned solar energy bicycle is convenient for travel at night to need not charge, and the device is very convenient in use.

title: Hat with solar polished section
abstract: A hat with a solar polished section relates to the solar hat field and is characterized in that a solar polished section is embedded on the hat; wherein the solar polished section is used for absorbing solar energy and generating electrical energy. The hat comprises the solar polished section which is embedded at the top part of the hat and is used for absorbing solar energy to generate electrical energy.

title: Micro-optics concentrator for solar power satellites
abstract: There is an increasingly intense need to harness solar energy due to an ever growing shortage of conventional energy sources, The instant invention is concerned with method and apparatus for solar concentrator micro-mirrors on solar power satellites and the moon to focus and reflect large quantities of solar energy. Method and apparatus are taught for directly reflecting solar energy to the Earth; reflecting solar energy to a microwave converter in space which transmits microwave energy to the Earth; and reflecting solar energy to a laser radiation converter which beams laser radiation to the Earth. The concentrated energy received at the Earth may be converted directly to electricity or indirectly by thermo-mechanical means. The advantages and disadvantages of the different means of sending such concentrated energy to the Earth are discussed. A particularly important objective of this invention is the focussing of sunlight for solar power conversion and production. The instant invention can contribute to the goal of achieving environmentally clean solar energy on a large enough scale to be competitive with conventional energy sources.

title: Cogeneration solar boiler
abstract: Disclosed is a cogeneration solar boiler, which belongs to the technique field of high-efficient solar energy utilization. The solar boiler optimizes and matches a photovoltaic generation solar panel with a heat abstractor of a solar thermal utilization product which are connected and combined into the cogeneration solar boiler. The boiler can fully utilize the light and heat of sunshine, and utilize the heat of the rest parts while converting the part that can be directly converted into electric energy in the radiation energy into electric energy. The solar boiler thereby can substantially increase the energy conversion rate of solar energy utilization products, greatly reduce manufacturing costs, and provide a new technical proposal for high-efficient solar energy development and utilization.

title: Solar energy sloping roof utilizing load bearing wall to transfer weight
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy sloping roof utilizing a load bearing wall to transfer weight, which comprises a foundation component, a solar energy heat-collecting device and a solar energy storing and applying device, wherein the foundation component is constructed at the top of a building; the solar energy heat-collecting device and the solar energy storing and applying device are mounted on the foundation component; a transmitting body and the solar energy heat-collecting device of the solar energy sloping roof are in force-transferring connection with the load bearing wall and a vertical wall of the building through the foundation component; and the foundation component comprises a truss beam column. The solar energy sloping roof has the beneficial effects that the transmitting body and the solar energy heat-collecting device of the solar energy sloping roof are in force-transferring connection with the load bearing wall and the vertical wall of the building through the foundation component, thereby providing a technical scheme for constructing the solar energy sloping roof on an old building without enough floor bearing capacity. An embodiment combined with a reference drawing is provided.

title: Solar energy auxiliary power tent
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy auxiliary power tent, which comprises a tent body, and at least one solar collecting board which is arranged at the tent body for absorbing the energy of the solar light source or other light sources; the utility model also comprises a solar energy and electric energy conversion device connected with the solar collecting boards to convert the energy provided by the solar collecting board into electric energy.

title: Distributing type MPPT solar charging system and solar car
abstract: The utility model discloses a distributing type MPPT solar charging system and solar car, this system includes power battery, wherein, the system still includes: a plurality of solar energy chip, it is a plurality of the solar energy chip alternate segregation, and it is a plurality of the solar energy chip encapsulation is at bodywork surface, a plurality of distributed MPPT, every MPPT's first end links to each other with a solar energy chip who corresponds, and every MPPT's second is held and is the output, the output common with power battery links to each other. The utility model providesa solar energy chip of distributing type MPPT solar charging system and solar car through setting up the alternate segregation, solar energy chip generates electricity after absorbing the sunlight, the electric energy is exported through distributed MPPT and is charged for the power battery on the car, because every solar energy chip all is separated sets, in case certain solar energy chip breaksdown, solar energy chip's influence to other is very small, compared with the prior art, so that the power generating efficiency is raised, and the conversion rate of electric energy has been improved.

title: Novel solar cross-seasonal energy storage heating device
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel solar energy cross-seasonal energy storage heating device which comprises a solar energy collecting system, a high-position heat storage water tank, an energy storage well group and a low-position circulating water tank, and the solar energy collecting system comprises a solar photovoltaic panel and a solar water heating system; the photovoltaic panel converts sunlight into electric energy, and the solar water heating system converts solar energy into heat energy. The two systems capture solar energy to supply energy; the solar energy collection system is connected to the high-position heat storage water tank and the low-position circulation water tank and provides electric energy for the water tanks. The high-position heat storage water tank is connected with an energy storage pump set. According to the novel solar seasonal energy storage heating system, through the layered heat exchange mode, the height difference design and long-term storage of heat energy, heat loss is effectively reduced, the heating time is prolonged, and cold and heat balance of natural resources is achieved.

title: Solar energy heatpump water heater
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy heatpump water heater, which is characterized in that an evaporator outlet and a solar energy collector outlet are respectively connected with a compressor through an electromagnetic valve; the compressor is connected with a condenser through a four-way reversing valve; the solar energy collector outlet is also connected with a condenser outlet through another electromagnetic valve; the condenser outlet is respectively connected with the evaporator outlet and the solar energy collector outlet through the electromagnetic valve, a capillary, a desiccator and a filter; a solar energy collector is provided with a solar energy electric eye plate; temperature sensors are arranged in a water tank, on the solar energy collector outlet and the evaporator outlet; each temperature sensor and the solar energy electric eye plate are electrically connected with an input end of a main controller; and the main controller is connected with and controls a compressor switch and each electromagnetic valve. The utility model can select natural circulation, solar energy heatpump circulation, solar energy plus evaporator heatpump circulation and evaporator heatpump circulation to produce hot water according to the strength of radiation of solar energy illumination, and is energy-saving and economic.

title: Solar energy support frame with elastic telescopic structural
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy support frame with elastic telescopic structural, including bottom support, solar energy pipe and solar energy water tank, the internally mounted of bottom support has the support spring, be provided with central body frame directly over the lower platform, body frame distance adjusting bolt's top is provided with the interior pole of activity, the middlepart of horizontal pole is provided with the roller bearing, the right side of solar energy pipe is provided with solar energy pipe baffle, shockproof interlayer is installed to the inboard of solarenergy pipe, the centre of side bearer is provided with side bearer distance adjusting bolt, the both sides of solar energy water tank all are provided with the water tank baffle, the both ends of solar energy pipe all are provided with solar energy pipe groove, and this solar energy support frame with elastic telescopic structural structure is more complicated and changeable, and are enough nimble, can change and the change along with solar angle, this just leaded to solar energy can be utilized more thoroughly, next this solar energy pipe is provided with safeguard procedures.

title: Solar energy air heat collector
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy air heat collector, including the solar energy absorber plate, the setting is at the backplate at the solar energy absorber plate back, the side seal board, this side seal board sets up on the side of this solar energy absorber plate and backplate, this solar energy absorber plate, the backplate becomes the thermal -arrest cavity with the side seal hoarding, set up the gas pocket with this thermal -arrest cavity intercommunication on this solar energy absorber plate, be equipped with the air outlet trachea with this thermal -arrest cavity intercommunication on this backplate, wherein, this solar energy absorber plate includes the metal substrate, establish in the positive solar energy of this metal substrate heat absorption coating, the setting is in this metal back of the substrate's infrared coating. This solar energy air heat collector simple structure, can great limit ground absorb solar energy and transfer the hot -air to the great limit of solar energy ground, hot -air rethread air extractor is taken out indoorly, realizes utilizing the solar heating, low cost, construction simple to operate, the effect of keeping warm are ideal.

title: Photovoltaic combined energy storage power station
abstract: According to the photovoltaic combined energy storage power station provided by the utility model, the solar light panel assembly is arranged on the outer surface of the energy storage power station, so that after light energy is converted into electric energy by the solar light panel, the electric energy can be directly transmitted to the energy storage power station to be stored, and the loss of the electric energy is reduced. A solar light panel assembly is installed on the outer surface of a shell and comprises a first solar light panel, a second solar light panel and a third solar light panel, an electric energy converter is installed at the upper end of the shell, and the first solar light panel is installed above the electric energy converter; the first solar light panel, the second solar light panel and the third solar light panel are all electrically connected with the electric energy converter, the interior of the shell is divided into a plurality of containing cavities through cross bars, and reserve batteries are placed in the containing cavities and electrically connected with the electric energy converter.

title: Wireless communication sun-shading and rain-proof cover based on solar power supply
abstract: The utility model provides a wireless communication sun-shading and rain-proof cover based on solar power supply, which comprises a sun-shading and rain-proof cover body, the sun-shading and rain-proof cover body comprises a solar panel, the back of the solar panel is provided with a solar panel circuit, and the solar panel circuit is connected with the sun-shading and rain-proof cover body. The solar panel circuit is electrically connected with an energy storage conversion circuit installed on the solar panel through a wire, and the energy storage conversion circuit is connected with an energy storage battery installed on the solar panel through a charging plug. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that the solar panel can collect light energy emitted by solar radiation, the solar panel circuit can convert the light energy emitted by the solar radiation into heat energy, the energy storage conversion circuit can convert the heat energy into electric energy, and the energy storage battery can store the converted electric energy. The top of the sun-shading and rain-proof cover is changed into a plurality of solar panels, and the solar panels are bonded through waterproof silica gel, so that the sun-shading and rain-proof covers with different sizes can be formed.

title: Solar station on moon
abstract: The invention relates to a solar station applicable to the moon. The solar station comprises a solar cell module (1), a solar controller (2), an energy conversion device (3), a laser gun (4), a microwave transmission device (5), an energy receiving station (6) and an energy conversion station (7), wherein the solar controller (2) is used for transmitting the absorbed energy to the energy conversion device (3) after solar energy is absorbed by the solar cell module (1), the energy conversion device (3) is used for converting the energy to forms of laser and microwave and transmitting the formsof laser and microwave to the earth, the energy receiving station (6) is used for receiving the transmitted laser and microwave, the energy conversion station (7) on the earth is used for converting the laser and microwave to electric energy, and the electric energy is sent to a user by a power grid. By building the solar station on the surface of the moon, very rich and stable solar energy can beobtained, and thus, the problem of energy supply in future can be solved; and moreover, the energy is clean without pollution and is very stable.

title: Solar energy and wind energy hybrid catamaran
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy and wind energy hybrid catamaran. The solar energy and wind energy hybrid catamaran comprises a catamaran mother ship, a wind power system and a solar power system, which are used for supplying power to the catamaran mother ship, wherein the wind power system and the solar power system are mounted on the catamaran mother ship. According to the solar energy and wind energy hybrid catamaran, the wind power system and the solar power system are arranged on the catamaran mother ship, and the wind power system and the solar power system can supply electric energy converted by the solar energy and the wind energy to the catamaran mother ship while fuel energy is not required to be used, so that the effects of energy conservation and emission reduction are achieved, pollution gas generated in use of fuel oil is avoided, and the condition that the fuel oil leaks to pollute a sea area is further avoided.

title: Novel solar energy automatically tracking device
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel solar energy automatically tracking device. The solar energy automatically tracking device comprises a base, a solar energy receiving plate bracket, a photosensitive sensor and a control unit. The photosensitive sensor is arranged on the solar energy receiving plate bracket and connected with the control unit, a set of hydraulic cylinders are arranged on the base, and push rods of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with the solar energy receiving plate bracket through spherical hinges. Sliding chutes are formed in the solar energy receiving plate bracket, shafts which are hinged to solar energy receiving plates are arranged in the sliding chutes, and the control unit is connected with controllers of the hydraulic cylinders and controls the stroke of the push rods of the hydraulic cylinders. Hydraulic control is adopted, the solar energy receiving plates can be made large, and stability of the system is good; the solar energy receiving plates can be folded, in strong breeze and other severe weather, the solar energy receiving plates are folded under the control of the control unit, therefore, external force acted on a photovoltaic system is reduced, and stability of the system is improved; and the solar energy receiving plates are always perpendicular to sunlight, so that the utilization rate of solar energy is increased.

title: Automatically-controlled solar energy boiler system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar energy equipment, in particular to an automatically-controlled solar energy boiler system. The automatically-controlled solar energy boiler system comprises a solar energy heat collecting container, a circular-arc solar energy reflecting plate, a boiler, an outdoor temperature sensor, a controller, electric energy collecting equipment and a plurality of groups of heat energy utilizing equipment, wherein the solar energy reflecting plate and the outdoor temperature sensor are mounted on a base, the solar energy heat collecting container is arranged above the solar energy reflecting plate, heat absorbing plates are arranged on the outside the solar energy heat collecting container, the heat energy utilizing equipment is connected with the boiler, a pressure difference control valve with a flow regulating function is mounted on the water inlet pipeline of each group of heat energy utilizing equipment, a return water temperature sensor is mounted on the water return pipeline of each group of heat energy utilizing equipment, the return water temperature sensors and the outdoor temperature sensor are connected with the controller via circuits, the controller is connected with the pressure difference control valves and controls the opening degree of the pressure difference control valves, and the electric energy collecting equipment is connected with the heat absorbing plates. The automatically-controlled solar energy boiler system has the advantages that water supply flow can be controlled automatically, redundant solar energy can be converted into electric energy, and utilization rate of the solar energy is high.

title: Compressed gas energy storage sun orientation tracking device
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of solar energy collection and energy storage technology and provides a compressed gas energy storage sun orientation tracking device. A solar energy collecting device is arranged on the upper surface of an airbag group, the deflection angle of the solar energy collecting device is controlled through adjusting the air pressure and amount in each airbag in the airbag group, so that the solar energy collecting device always faces to the sun orientation, then the sun position can be tracked, and the energy can be stored. According to the invention, the device has advantages: the solar energy collecting device and a solar tracking device are integrated without occupying extra spaces, the solar energy orientation can be tracked, the collected solar energy can be stored, the power supply peak-valley value of the solar energy can be adjusted, stable and reliable power supply is achieved, and the quality of power supply is improved.

title: Solar illuminating pen
abstract: The invention discloses a solar illuminating pen, which mainly comprises a solar battery, an energy accumulator, a charge controller, a light source, a switch, a penholder and a pen head. The solar battery converts received solar energy into electric energy and stores the electric energy in the energy accumulator through the charge controller, and when the switch is switched on, the electric energy in the energy accumulator is supplied to the light source to make the light source work. The solar illuminating pen integrates a solar component with the penholder, so the solar illuminating pen can be carried about, can be charged by using solar energy, can be used at any time, provides convenience for people's lives, and has the advantages of energy conservation, environment friendliness and the like.

title: Waterproof and dustproof solar equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a waterproof and dustproof solar energy device, comprising a solar energy housing, the solar energy housing is internally provided with a cavity, the solar energy housing is provided with a cover body, the cover body covers the solar energy housing, the cavity is internally provided with a solar energy panel, and the solar energy panel is provided with a waterproof layer. The side face and the bottom of the solar panel are each provided with a supporting plate used for fixing the solar panel, a heat dissipation layer is further arranged in the cavity and located between the supporting plates and the solar shell, a first sealing ring is arranged on the heat dissipation layer and located between the solar shell and the cover body, and a second sealing ring is arranged on the first sealing ring and located between the solar shell and the cover body. The solar panel has good dustproof and waterproof performance, and good heat dissipation performance is guaranteed while dustproof and waterproof performance is guaranteed.

title: SYSTEM FOR MANAGING SOLAR ENERGY SALES
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a user with a toll collection form in accordance with a used quantity of solar energy and to provide a sales management system for the same.

SOLUTION: A solar energy management device, which is connected to a solar energy collecting and accumulating device of a solar system and manages the quantity of solar energy, is provided with a storage device for registering solar energy quantity totalization information, a measuring means for measuring a supply temperature of a heating medium supplied to the solar energy collecting and accumulating device, a used temperature at the time of using the medium heated by the solar heat collecting and accumulating device, a temperature difference between the supplied temperature and the used temperature, and a used quantity of the heating medium the user has used, a solar energy quantity charging means which adds to a solar energy totalized quantity the quantity of solar energy calculated by multiplying a specific gravity, a specific heat, and a used quantity of the heating medium with the temperature difference obtained by the measuring means, and charges for the used quantity of the solar energy, and a charg collecting means for calculating the quantity of solar energy the user has used for a prescribed period of time, and collecting the toll.
