title: Solar energy bag
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy bag, including inclusion and solar power system, the front side of inclusion is equipped with accomodates the layer, solar power system includes solar moduleand output interface, solar module and output electrical connection interface, solar module locates and accomodates the in situ to can take out from accomodate the layer, solar module includes the solar cell panel of a plurality of series connection to it is collapsible between every two adjacent solar cell panel. The utility model discloses having set up on solar energy bag and having accomodatethe layer, the realization is accomodate solar module's, has guaranteed charging performance's persistence, solar power system's solar cell panel is equipped with a plurality ofly, has effectively improved the power that charges.

title: Indoor environmental control system of solar energy
abstract: The utility model relates to an indoor environmental control system of solar energy, including solar electric source device and indoor environment control device, the solar electric source device with indoor environment control device is connected, and is right the power supply of indoor environment control device, wherein: the solar electric source device includes: the curtain is rolled up to the film solar energy that is solar energy transformation the electric energy, and with film solar energy is rolled up the curtain and is connected, stores the solar battery of electric energy, indoor environment control device includes: with solar battery is connected, receives indoor temperature and humidity's warm and humid regulating unit is adjusted in solar battery's power supply, and with solar battery is connected, receives solar battery's power supply, indoor air purification's air purification unit. The utility model provides a technical scheme rolls up the curtain through film solar energy and provides the electric energy, has solved the limitation that silicon wafer solar energy was used, has reduced the power consumption of people to the requirement of environment travelling comfort.

title: Energy-saving apparatus for receiving, converting and storing solar energy in field occasion
abstract: The utility model discloses an energy-saving apparatus for receiving, converting and storing solar energy in a field occasion. The energy-saving apparatus includes a solar energy receiving and converting structure, a device supporting structure and an energy storing device, wherein the solar energy receiving and converting structure is located at the upper middle part of the apparatus, the device supporting structure is installed at the lower side of the outer end of solar energy receiving and converting structure, and the energy storing device is located at the exterior of the structure; a solar receiving board is arranged at the exterior of the upper end of the solar energy receiving and converting structure; a solar energy receiving and converting device is installed at the inner side of the middle of the solar receiving board; and a connecting line is installed at the inner side of the middle of an energy absorbing device. The energy-saving apparatus of the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design and low cost. According to the energy-saving apparatus, an energy storage barrel is adopted, so that the receiving and conversion of solar energy in the field can be fully utilized, and therefore, the energy-saving apparatus can be applied in a more humane manner and has a brighter development prospect in the development of solar energy receiving and converting devices.

title: Solar heat system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar heat system which comprises a solar receiver, a focusing unit, a heat exchanger, a heating medium supplementing unit, a photosensitive adjusting unit and an electric energy converter. The solar receiver is used for absorbing heat of the sun and heating a heating medium contained in the solar receiver. The focusing unit is used for focusing solar radiation after solar radiation enters the solar receiver. The heat exchanger is used for enabling the heating medium contained in the solar receiver to flow in the solar receiver to transfer heat energy so as to heat circulating fluid which produces steam in the system. The heating medium supplementing unit is connected with the solar receiver through a pressure valve and used for supplementing the lack of the heating medium. The photosensitive adjusting unit is used for sensing light beams and driving the focusing unit to rotate. The electric energy converter is used for converting heat energy in the heating medium into electric energy. According to the solar heat system, solar energy is promoted to be continuously converted into heat energy, the heat energy can be further converted into electric energy, the heat of steam and electric energy are continuously supplied and circulated, and the utilization rate of solar energy and the working efficiency of a turbine are greatly improved.

title: Solar energy charging speaker
abstract: The application discloses a solar energy charging speaker. The speaker comprises a solar energy charging device and a speaker body, wherein the speaker body comprises a body shell and an operation panel, a speaker processing system in the body shell and a loudspeaker arranged on the frontage of the body shell; the solar energy charging device comprises a solar energy cell panel, a solar energy controller and a lithium battery; the solar energy cell panel is installed on the upper surface of the body shell through a bracket; the solar energy controller comprises a DC conversion circuit. The solar energy charging speaker provided by the application achieves the following effects: (1) the speaker is simple in structure, economic and practical, reasonable in design and durable; (2) the speaker is environment-friendly; (3) the utilization efficiency of the solar energy is improved; (4) the alternative current and the electric energy converted from the self solar energy can be applied to the speaker, and the application is extensive; the use is unlimited by the sites, and the speaker has a huge market popularization and application value.

title: DATA-ANALYSIS-BASED CONTROL OPTIMIZATION OF FLOATING SOLAR ARRAY SYSTEM ENERGY HARVESTING
abstract: Data-analysis-based processes for optimizing energy harvesting from a floating solar array system are provided. The processes include obtaining a data-analysis-based control to control energy harvesting from a floating solar array system on water. The floating solar array system includes a floating solar array to harvest solar energy and a kinetic energy harvester to harvest kinetic energy. The data-analysis-based control is configured to determine an environmental condition to effect the floating solar array system, and to dynamically adjust a configuration of the floating solar array system to optimize net energy harvesting of the floating solar array system from the floating solar array and the kinetic energy harvester based on the determined environmental condition to effect the floating solar array system.

title: Solar energy conveyor for outdoors
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy conveyor for outdoors. The solar energy conveyor comprises a conveyor body, supporting columns and solar energy panels, wherein the supporting columns are arranged at four corners of the conveyor body, and the solar energy panels are arranged on the supporting columns. The solar energy conveyor is simple in structure and capable of saving energy and protecting environment; by means of the arrangement of the solar energy panels, the conveyor can be shielded from sunshine, and an additional power supply can be provided for the conveyor.

title: SOLAR ENERGY CONVERTER
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the energy converting efficiency and the timing rising characteristic of a solar energy converter by absorbing the solar energy by a solar heat absorbing system and converting the transmitted light of the system via a solar battery into an electric energy. CONSTITUTION:Long wavelength spectral energy of solar energy is converted into a heat energy by a heat absorber 1, and is further converted into an electric energy via a boiler 2, a turbine 3 and a generator 3. On the other hand, the short wavelength spectral energy of the solar energy is passed through the heat absorber 1, is converged and is emitted to the solar battery group 10, and is further converted into an electric energy by the battery group 10. Accordingly, the energy conversion efficiency can be largely improved on the same light receiving area. In addition, the timing rising characteristics of the energy converter can be improved.

title: Solar Stirling power generating system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar Stirling power generating system. The solar Stirling power generating system comprises a dish-type condenser, a solar collector, an energy storing device and a Stirling power generator; the dish-type condenser is used for reflecting and gathering sunlight, the solar collector is used for absorbing solar radiation and converting solar energy into heat energy; the solar collector and the energy storing device are connected through a flexible high-temperature heat pipe; and the energy storing device and the Stirling power generator adopt contact connection. According to the solar Stirling power generating system, on the overall structure, the solar collector and the energy storing device as well as the solar collector and the Stirling power generator are arranged in a separated mode, the flexible heat pipe is adopted to enable the solar collector and the energy storing device to be connected, thus separation of the solar collector and the energy storing device as well as the solar collector and the Stirling power generator is achieved to enable the mass and the size of the energy storing device not to be limited, high-capacity heat storing can be achieved, and the solar Stirling power generating system is more suitable for being applied to an energy-storing type large-power Stirling power generating system.

title: SOLAR FLUX ENHANCER
abstract: A solar energy concentrator is disclosed. The solar energy concentration comprises: (i) a primary reflector surface (3) for concentrating solar energy towards a focal plane; (ii) a solar energy receiver (5) for receiving reflected solar energy positioned behind the focal plane; (iii) a solar energy flux modifier (7) having a front aperture (9), internally mirrored walls (11) that diverge from the front aperture (13), and a larger rear aperture, the flux modifier being adapted to receive concentrated solar energy from the primary reflector surface via the front aperture and to re-direct solar energy via the mirrored walls and the larger rear aperture to the receiver.

title: Energy-saving solar panel streetlamp
abstract: The utility model provides an energy-saving solar panel streetlamp. The energy-saving solar panel adopting an umbrella or cone shape is arranged on a lamp of the streetlamp, so that the energy-saving solar panel can receive solar energy in all directions whenever and wherever the sun is. The energy-saving solar panel streetlamp comprises a lamp pole, a storage battery, a switch, a lamp and the solar panel, wherein the solar panel is connected with the storage battery; the storage battery is connected with the lamp with the switch; the solar panel adopting the umbrella or cone shape is arranged over the lamp to form a lampshade. For the adoption of the technical scheme, the solar energy not only can be absorbed more comprehensively, but the effects of protecting the lamp and saving the manufacturing cost are also obtained as the energy-saving solar panel serves as the lamp lampshade of the streetlamp.

title: SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTOR
abstract: A solar energy collecting device comprises: a manifold having a passage through which a fluid for collecting collected solar heat flows; a pipe connected to the manifold; and a solar energy absorbing unit converting solar energy inside the pipe. The solar energy absorption unit may include a bendable absorption plate that collects solar energy and is configured to be variable in shape according to temperature.

title: Solar energy and ground source heat pump combined energy saving system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy and ground source heat pump combined energy saving system comprising a heat preservation water tank, a solar energy collection module, a ground source heat pump hot water supplying module, a ground source heat pump heat supplying-refrigerating module, and a controller. The lower portion of the heat preservation water tank is connected with a tap water inlet pipe, the upper portion of the heat preservation water tank is connected with a hot water outlet pipe, a solar energy heat exchange coil is positioned in the heat preservation water tank, one end of a solar energy heat supplying pipe and one end of a solar energy circulating pipe are connected with two ends of the solar energy heat exchange coil respectively, the other end of the solar energy circulating pipe is connected with a liquid inlet of a solar energy heat collector, and the other end of the solar energy heat supplying pipe is connected with a liquid outlet of the solar energy heat collector. According to the solar energy and ground source heat pump combined energy saving system, a manner of combining solar energy heat collection and a ground source heat pump is used, and the solar energy and ground source heat pump combined energy saving system is capable of saving energy, environmental friendly, safe, reliable, good in effect, low in cost, small in occupation area, simple in maintenance, low in maintenance cost, and long in service life.

title: Intelligent switching method, device and system for solar charging and commercial power charging
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar energy and particularly relates to an intelligent switching method, device and system for solar charging and commercial power charging. The method comprises steps of obtaining a solar input voltage value in real time; according to the solar input voltage value, judging whether the solar input voltage value is within a preset charging voltage range or not; if yes, selecting the charging mode as a solar charging mode; and if not, selecting a commercial power charging mode. Whether the solar energy input voltage value is within the preset charging voltage range is judged according to the solar energy input current value and the solar energy input voltage value, so the solar energy is preferentially used for charging when the mains supply and the solar energy coexist and meet conditions, priority of solar energy charging is ensured, when the solar energy does not meet the condition, the mains supply is intelligently switched for charging, so the mains supply charging and the solar photovoltaic charging can be intelligently and flexibly switched, and working efficiency is remarkably improved.

title: Light-duty solar-energy tracking device
abstract: The utility model relates to a light-duty solar-energy tracking device and belongs to the field of solar-energy new energy application. The solar-energy tracking device is characterized in that the solar-energy tracking device comprises a load holder, an inclined-plane balance support, two solar-energy photovoltaic cell panels and a solar energy tracker. The inclined-plane balance support fixes the two parallel solar-energy photovoltaic cell panels by screws. An upper portion of the load holder is arranged on the middle of the inclined-plane balance support by screws and a lower portion is fixedly connected with the solar energy tracker. The inclined-plane balance support is provided with three presetting positions, comprising horizontal 180 DEG, vertical 90 DEG and 45 DEG. The tracking device provided by the utility model has the advantages of miniaturization, simple structure, low maintenance cost and relatively high tracking precision. Problems of complex structure and difficult installation of the minitype solar-energy tracking device are solved. The solar-energy tracking device is suitable for popularizing to solar-energy utilization devices in quantity.

title: Solar energy earphone
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy earphone. The solar energy earphone consists of a solar material, a work layer, an earphone cover and an energy storage layer, and is characterized in that the solar energy can be used for energy supply to be used in outdoor positions.

title: Solar energy acquiring device
abstract: The present invention discloses a solar energy acquiring device. The device comprises a first bracket and a first solar energy acquiring plate fixed on the outer surface of the top of the first bracket. At least one second solar energy acquiring plate is arranged in the first bracket. When the second solar energy acquiring plate is in an unexpanded state, the second solar energy acquiring plate islocated in a inner cavity of the first bracket; and when the second solar energy acquiring plate is in an expanded state, the second solar energy acquiring plate produces a position movement based ona first rotating component located in the first bracket, so that the second solar energy acquiring plate can protrude from the inner cavity of the first bracket. The device can solve the existing technical problem of low energy production efficiency because the solar energy acquiring plates are limited by the acquiring area in the conventional technology, and the land of the surrounding area of the solar energy acquiring device can be comprehensively utilized.

title: Solar-energy roof light
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar-energy roof light, which includes a housing made of light-transparent materials, and the housing is integrated with a mounting bracket and a mounting suction disc.The utility model is characterized in that a solar-energy battery panel is mounted at the top of the housing; a base is fixedly installed in the housing; a dispersing lens, two groups of luminous sources, a solar-energy storage battery and a solar-energy controller are fixedly mounted on the base; each group of luminous sources is realized through a plurality of white-light LEDs, that is, the white-light LEDs are divided into two groups and fixed on a light board; the white-light LEDs are connected with the solar-energy controller and the solar-energy storage battery; and the solar-energy controller is connected with a storage battery and the solar-energy battery panel. Compared with the prior art, the solar-energy roof light enhances the illuminating brightness of taxi lights; and sincethe inexhaustible solar energy is adopted for supplying power, the energy is saved.

title: Solar energy device
abstract: A solar energy device for converting solar energy to a usable form of energy which includes a solar energy collector arranged adjacent a solar energy collector surface in sun energy transferring relation and tracking means to orient the face in perpendicular relationship to the sun rays.

title: Solar energy module
abstract: The present invention is a solar energy module at least comprising: an optical refraction unit to receive the solar energy and turn the sun light toward a predetermined direction by refraction; a solar energy electro-optic plate corresponding to the light-exiting side of the optical refraction unit to receive the refracted light from the optical refraction unit, so as to form the whole solar energy module; and an associated storage unit whose input power port is for electrically connecting with each solar energy electro-optic plate, and having a secondary cell to store the electrical power. As a result, the damage to the solar energy electro-optic plate resulted from the solar radiation heat when the solar energy module receives the sun light is effectively reduced, thereby increasing the lifetime of the solar energy module.

title: Solar energy stretching motor system
abstract: The utility model relates to a motor, in particular to a rotary motor. A solar energy stretching motor system comprises a shell in which a stretching motor system is arranged; the stretching motor system comprises the motor connected with a stretching mechanism by a speed changing mechanism; the solar energy stretching motor system further comprises a control system and a power supply system; the power supply system comprises a solar energy power supply system, the solar energy power supply system comprises a solar panel and a storage battery, and the solar panel is connected with the storage battery. The solar energy stretching motor system adopts the above technical scheme; as solar energy is utilized to supply power for the entire system, the solar energy stretching motor system has obvious energy-saving effect.

title: Solar energy absorption device
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy absorption device. A solar energy absorber is provided with a storage power supply for supplying power to a refrigerator for refrigeration. The invention provides the solar energy absorption device, by employing the above structure, the solar energy absorption device can be effectively utilized, solar energy is absorbed and is converted into electrical energy, the electrical energy is stored in the storage power supply, the storage power supply is used to supply power to the refrigerator for refrigeration in needs, and the solar energy absorption device has the advantages of energy saving and environmental protection.

title: POWER GENERATING SYSTEM AND METHOD BY COMBINING MEDIUM-AND-LOW TEMPERATURE SOLAR ENERGY WITH FOSSIL FUEL THERMOCHEMISTRY
abstract: The present invention provides a power generating system by combining medium-and-low temperature solar energy and fossil fuel with thermochemical process, the system comprising: a material supply device configured to store fossil fuel; a material mixing device configured to mix the fossil fuel with non-reacted reactant; a material metering device configured to control an amount of material fed to a material preheating device in unit time; a material preheating device configured to heat the material; a solar energy absorption and reaction device configured to drive the fossil fuel by using solar thermal energy absorbed to make a decomposition reaction or reforming reaction, through which the solar energy is converted to chemical energy of hydrogen-rich fuel, obtaining solar-energy fuel; a solar energy heat collecting device configured to collect the solar energy with low energy flux density to medium-and-low temperature solar thermal energy with high energy flux density, so as to provide heat to decomposition reaction or reforming reaction; a condenser configured to cool reaction products; a gas-liquid separating device configured to perform gas-liquid separation for the cooled mixture; a fuel bypassing device configured to adjust a proportion of solar-energy fuel for storage to that for generating; a gas storing tank to store solar-energy fuel; a power generating apparatus to burnt the solar-energy fuel to output power. The invention achieves a higher efficiency of usage of solar energy.

title: Solar photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated circulating system
abstract: The invention provides a solar photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated circulating system. The solar photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated circulating system comprises a photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated solar energy device, a solar water tank, a groove type solar energy device, a refrigerating system and a heating system; the photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated solar energy device is connected with the solar water tank; the solar water tank is connected with the groove type solar energy device; and a heat collecting steam pipe and a heat collecting oil pipe are transversely installed in the groove type solar energy device in parallel. The solar photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated circulating system has the beneficial effects that the refrigerating system is preheated through the photovoltaic and photo-thermal integrated solar energy device and then heated into steam through the groove type solar energy device, a steam turbine is pushed through the steam, a mechanical shaft of the steam turbine is directly connected with a compressor shaft for refrigeration, losses of secondary conversion in the transmission process are reduced, and the solar energy conversion efficiency is improved.

title: Novel solar energy is collected device
abstract: The utility model relates to a novel solar energy is collected device, the cable is carried to solar collector, solar energy memory on suspend in aerial supporting disk, being fixed in the supporting disk and the solar energy that is used for connecting solar collector and solar energy memory, be equipped with the cavity in the supporting disk, it is gaseous that this cavity intussuseption is filled with the suspension. The utility model discloses a suspending, it is high aerial to make fixed solar collector above that lie in in aerial supporting disk to solar collector can be better solar energy collection, efficiency is higher.

title: SOLAR ENERGY REFRIGERATOR
abstract: The present invention discloses a solar energy refrigerator, comprising a refrigerator body (1), a refrigerator door (2), an electricity storage device, a refrigeration unit and a radiator unit; a center solar panel (4) is arranged on the top end of the refrigerator body (1); a first solar panel (3), a second solar panel (5) and a third solar panel (6) are moveably connected with the center solar panel (4) arranged on the top end of the refrigerator body (1) respectively; the center solar panel (4), the first solar panel (3), the second solar panel (5) and the third solar panel (6) have continuously serrated sections; a light condensing unit is arranged on the center solar panel (4); the first solar panel (3), the second solar panel (5) and the third solar panel (6) all are provided with a light condensing unit, a light detection unit and a control unit; an electric telescopic adjusting rod (7) is arranged between the first solar panel (3), the second solar panel (5), the third solar panel (6) and the refrigerator body (1); and a universal wheel is arranged at the bottom of the refrigerator body (1). According to the present invention, the solar panels have a big area and can be folded, the solar energy refrigerator can be carried anywhere and is convenient to move. Fig. 1

title: House with power and heat supplied through solar energy
abstract: The invention provides a house with power and heat supplied through solar energy. The house comprises a roof, an air outlet, a solar power generating module, an electric heating element, a heat insulation channel, an air intake electric control valve, an air inlet, a roof structure, a lower insulating layer, an electric heating layer, an upper insulating layer, a house body, an air exhaust electric control valve, a solar energy lighting device, a solar energy absorption unit, an energy converter, an energy storage, a control circuit, a detection circuit and a lighting device, wherein the roof is provided with the solar energy lighting device; the solar energy absorption unit is connected with the energy converter, the energy converter is connected with the energy storage, the energy storage is connected with the lighting device and the control circuit, and the control circuit is connected with the detection circuit. The house with power and heat supplied through solar energy can achieve lighting through solar energy, utilizes the solar energy to the greatest extent, saves energy and is environmentally friendly, simple in structure and convenient to use and popularize.

title: Solar absorption apparatus
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy absorption device, comprising a solar energy absorption plate, a battery and a controller. The controller is in electrical connection respectively with the solar energy absorption plate and the battery, and is also provided with a condenser. The condenser is at a corresponding position on the surface of the solar energy absorption plate. The condenser can be a convex lens; the primary optical axis of the convex lens is perpendicular to the surface of the solar energy absorption plate; the distance between the convex lens and the surface of the solar energy absorption plate is that: the imaging size of parallel light refracted via the convex lens coincides with the size of the solar energy absorption plate. The condenser can be concave face reflector as well; the central axis of the concave face reflector is perpendicular to the surface of the solar energy absorption plate; the distance between the concave face reflector and the surface of the solar energy absorption plate is that: the light concentration size of parallel light reflected by the concave face reflector coincides with the size of the solar energy absorption plate. Due to the structure, the solar energy absorption device can reduce the solar energy absorption plate under the condition with certain power, so as to save cost and improve light absorption efficiency.

title: Five-junction solar energy cell and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a five-junction solar energy cell comprising an InP substrate, and an InGaAs/InGaAsP/InAlAs three-junction solar energy cell and a GaInP/AlGaInP double-junction solar energy cell stacked on the InP substrate in order; the invention also discloses a five-junction solar energy cell preparation method comprising the following steps: forming the InGaAs/InGaAsP/InAlAs three-junction solar energy cell on the InP substrate; forming the GaInP/AlGaInP double-junction solar energy cell on a GaAs substrate; bonding wafers of the InGaAs/InGaAsP/InAlAs three-junction solar energy cell and the GaInP/AlGaInP double-junction solar energy cell, thus obtaining an InGaAs/InGaAsP/InAlAs/GaInP/AlGaInP five-junction solar energy cell. The five-junction solar energy cell can satisfy 0.73eV/1.05eV/1.47eV/1.89eV/2.2eV band gap combination, thus absorbing width spectrums, obtaining high voltage and low current output, effectively reducing solar energy cell resistance loss under high power optically focused light, and improving solar energy cell photoelectric conversion efficiency.

title: Power transmission line solar energy warning device and solar energy warning light
abstract: The utility model relates to a line protection has especially involved a power transmission line solar energy warning device and solar energy warning light. Power transmission line solar energy warning device includes solar energy warning light and fixing device, and the solar energy warning light includes solar panel and lamp body, and solar panel's energy -absorbing side department is equipped with and makes the debris landing or roll the miscellaneous structure of the row who falls, it is solar panel's slope side or is the inclined plane of cover on the outside transparent guard shield of solar panel to arrange miscellaneous structure. When using, the automatic probability that drops of leaf in the environment is greatly increased, and the snow sky drops on the snow landing of solar panel energy -absorbing side and the process of melting also can be corresponding increases soon, and during the rainy day, the rainwater also will strengthen the scouring effect of solar panel energy -absorbing side, to sum up, the utility model discloses a power transmission line solar energy warning device can prolong solar panel's operational use time, improves current power transmission line solar energy warning device's solar panel's efficiency.

title: Fixed point array solar energy hydrogen production system
abstract: The invention relates to the focusing utilization of solar energy, in particular to a solar energy hydrogen production system which realizes solar energy acquisition by adopting point focused solar mirrors and is applied to a fixed point array. The solar energy hydrogen production system comprises at least one or at least one group of point focused solar mirrors, at least one hydrogen production device and tracking control devices, wherein the solar mirrors are arranged on a solar mirror support, the hydrogen production devices are arranged in solar mirror focused punctate areas and are above or below the solar mirrors, the solar mirrors change in focal length in the process of tracking solar energy, and the focal lengths of the solar mirrors are maintained to be always positioned in punctate areas of the hydrogen production devices; and the tracking control devices are used for controlling the solar mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one hydrogen production device when the sunlight changes, and the hydrogen production devices do not move together with the solar mirrors in the process that the solar mirrors track the solar energy but maintain relative rest with the ground so as to realize the tracked focusing utilization of the solar energy.

title: Solar-energy-charged backpack
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar-energy-charged backpack which comprises a backpack and a solar-energy-charging device. The solar-energy-charging device is formed by a solar energy converting board a built-in storage battery. The solar energy converting board is arranged at the upper end of the backpack, the built-in storage battery is arranged inside the backpack, the solar energy converting board is connected with the built-in storage battery through connecting wries, and an outlet port is arranged on the built-in storage battery. The solar-energy-charged backpack is capable of containing and carrying objects people need to carry when people are on a business trip, travel or operate in a wild field. The solar-energy-charge backpack has the advantages that the solar energy charging device is integrated on the top portion of the solar-energy-charged backpack, and is capable of storing optical energy and converting the optical energy into electrical energy. The solar-energy-charged backpack is capable of providing a charging power supply for storage batteries of electric products like a moving picture experts group audio player III (MP3), a moving picture experts group audio player IV (MP4), a digital camera, a camera, a cell phone and the like.

title: Solar energy autonomous power supply system in mining area
abstract: The utility model relates to the solar energy application field, particularly to a solar energy autonomous power supply system in mining area. The solar energy autonomous power supply system of the utility model comprises a mine and a solar energy receiving plate which is arranged outside the mine and contacted with the atmosphere, wherein there is at least one solar energy receiving plate; the mine is internally provided with an accumulator and a load; and the solar energy receiving plate is connected with the accumulator and the load inside the mine. The solar energy autonomous power supply system of the utility model features convenient usage, great energy storage effect, energy saving and consumption reduction, and environmental protection. The electricity generated via solar energy can be used at normal time. When there is a dangerous situation, the direct current does not cause damage to human body. If some natural disasters occur, the solar energy generation is not interrupted.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CREATING A NETWORKED INFRASTRUCTURE DISTRIBUTION PLATFORM OF ENERGY GATHERING DEVICES
abstract: A system and method for creating a networked infrastructure distribution platform of energy gathering devices. In one embodiment of the invention, a vehicle comprises an energy storage system; and at least one solar energy generating device coupled to the vehicle. The at least one solar energy generating device is configured to generate electricity from sunlight. The at least one solar energy generating device is configured to electrically connect to a roadway system electricity grid. In another embodiment of the present invention is a method for a vehicle gathering solar energy and providing the same to the roadway system electricity grid. The method comprises the step of harnessing solar energy from a vehicle-based solar energy gathering device; converting solar energy into electrical energy; storing the electrical energy; and discharging the stored electrical energy to a roadway system electricity grid.

title: Power generating system and method by combining medium-and-low temperature solar energy with fossil fuel thermochemistry
abstract: The present invention provides a power generating system by combining medium-and-low temperature solar energy and fossil fuel with thermochemical process, the system comprising: a material supply device configured to store fossil fuel; a material mixing device configured to mix the fossil fuel with non-reacted reactant; a material metering device configured to control an amount of material fed to a material preheating device in unit time; a material preheating device configured to heat the material; a solar energy absorption and reaction device configured to drive the fossil fuel by using solar thermal energy absorbed to make a decomposition reaction or reforming reaction, through which the solar energy is converted to chemical energy of hydrogen-rich fuel, obtaining solar-energy fuel; a solar energy heat collecting device configured to collect the solar energy with low energy flux density to medium-and-low temperature solar thermal energy with high energy flux density, so as to provide heat to decomposition reaction or reforming reaction; a condenser configured to cool reaction products; a gas-liquid separating device configured to perform gas-liquid separation for the cooled mixture; a fuel bypassing device configured to adjust a proportion of solar-energy fuel for storage to that for generating; a gas storing tank to store solar-energy fuel; a power generating apparatus to burnt the solar-energy fuel to output power. The invention achieves a higher efficiency of usage of solar energy.

title: Solar energy collection transmitter capable of automatically tracking the sun
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy collection transmitter capable of automatically tracking the sun, i.e. a curved surface heliostat. The solar energy collection transmitter comprises a solar energy collecting device and a solar energy transmitting device. The solar energy collecting device is also provided with a first automatically tracking and correcting device which is used for automatically tracking direction of the sun. The transmitting device is provided with a second automatically tracking and correcting device which is used for regulating angles of a reflecting mirror. Sunlight collection is performed via a small concave mirror and a large concave mirror, and sunlight long distance transmission is performed via the reflecting mirror and a spreading cavity. The solar energy collecting device and the solar energy transmitting device are provided with the tracking and correcting devices, and rotation control is performed on a motor via a sensor and a processor, or a light-sensitive resistor and a relay respectively so that directions of the solar energy collecting device and the solar energy transmitting device are changed by the motor via a transmission device. The solar energy collection transmitter is overall enabled to aim at the sun to collect sunlight, and perform long distance transmission via the solar energy transmitting device so that light energy is provided for a tower type solar energy collecting device.

title: ENERGY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND ENERGY MANAGEMENT METHOD
abstract: To provide an energy management system that efficiently uses a photovoltaic power generation system and a solar thermal collection system to maximize cost advantage for a user.SOLUTION: An energy management system includes: a photovoltaic generation system including a solar panel for generating power based on sunlight; a solar thermal collection system for collecting solar heat based on sunlight; and a control unit that determines whether the solar thermal collection system can store heat from output characteristic of the photovoltaic generation system and, when determining that heat storage is possible, drives the solar thermal collection system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Solar energy collection device in universe
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy collection device suitable for the universe. The solar energy collection device is composed of a solar cell panel (1), a charged particle collecting device (2),an energy transmission device (3) and a ground energy receiving device (4). The solar cell panel (1) transmits collected solar energy to the energy transmission device (3), and the charged particle collection device (2) receives various cosmic charged particles for forming a current, and transmits the current to the energy transmission device (3); the energy transmission device (2) is responsiblefor converting energy, and then the energy is transmitted to the ground through a wireless energy transmission technology; the ground is provided with the ground energy receiving device (4) used for receiving and converting energy into electric energy which can be used by the human body. The solar energy collecting device can collect solar energy in places where an energy collection device cannotwork normally, solar energy which cannot be collected by the common energy collection device can be collected, and continuous energy can be obtained by the device.

title: High coefficient of heat conductivity's PE RT solar energy pipe
abstract: The utility model discloses a high coefficient of heat conductivity's PE RT solar energy pipe, including fixing base, mounting groove, mounting bracket, PE RT pipe and solar energy heat absorption fin, the base is installed to the top of fixing base, and the both sides of base are equipped with the connecting pipe, the mounting bracket is installed at the top of base, the solar energy pipe is installed in the front of mounting bracket, and the one end of solar energy pipe fixes in mounting groove's inside, the front of solar energy pipe is inlayed and is had solar energy heat absorption fin, one side that solar energy heat absorption fin was kept away from to the solar energy pipe is equipped with thermal insulating layer, is thermal insulating layer's inside equipped with PE RT pipe, and PE the inside of RT pipe is equipped with hollow heat exchange tube, the outside of hollow heat exchange tube is equipped with hot exchange pipe. The utility model discloses do you adopt PE for traditional solar energy pipe the RT material has improved the heat conductivity that solar energy was managed, and the solar energy heat absorption fin of setting can improve the endothermicity ability of solar energy pipe, and then improves the endothermic efficiency of solar energy pipe, convenient to popularize and use.

title: SOLAR ENERGY DISAGGREGATION TECHNIQUES FOR WHOLE-HOUSE ENERGY CONSUMPTION DATA
abstract: Systems and methods of the present invention are directed to disaggregating the contribution of solar panels from a whole house energy profile. Methods of disaggregating energy produced by solar panels from low frequency whole-house energy consumption data for a specific house, may include steps of: predicting solar energy generation for the specific house by estimating a solar capacity of the solar panels, predicting solar intensity associated with the specific house, and multiplying estimated solar capacity with predicted solar intensity; and subtracting the predicted solar energy generation from the low frequency whole house energy consumption data, thereby disaggregating the contribution of energy produced by the solar panels. Computerized systems of the same may apply machine learning models such as radial basis function, support vector, or neural network machines.

title: Dye-sensitized solar cell small-size isolated grid type curtain wall system
abstract: The invention provides a dye-sensitized solar cell small-size isolated grid type curtain wall system. The system comprises a dye-sensitized solar cell module, a solar energy controller, an energy storage unit and a load, wherein the dye-sensitized solar cell module converts absorbed luminous energy into electric energy; the solar energy controller has the maximum power tracking point function and is configured to succeed in tracking the maximum power point of the dye-sensitized solar cell module and output electric energy through the maximum power point; the energy storage unit stores electric energy output by the solar energy controller; power of the load is supplied by the solar energy controller or the energy storage unit. The system is influenced by installation orientation and incident intensity as well as the condition whether the system is sheltered or not.

title: A SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy system. The solar energy system comprises a solar collector for providing energy generated from incident solar radiation. The system comprises a first heat exchange system comprising an ejector that is arranged to operate using at least a portion of the energy provided by the solar energy collector. Further, the system comprises a second heat exchange system arranged to operate using energy from an energy source other than a source of solar source. The solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy between the first heat exchange system and a region and between the second heat exchange system and the region. Further, he solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy from the second heat exchange system for use by at least one of: the first heat exchange system and a system for heating water.

title: Solar energy condensation and utilization device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy condensation and utilization device which comprises a solar energy utilization device, a support (1) and a condensation device arranged on the support. The solar energy utilization device is located below the condensation device. The condensation device comprises a hemispheric condensation plate (2) fixedly connected to the support (1), and a plurality of lenses are arranged on the condensation plate. The solar energy utilization device is a solar water heater or a solar photovoltaic plate. Through the adoption of the structure, the condensation device is arranged on a common solar energy utilization device and enables light rays emitted by the sun to be gathered on the solar energy utilization device, and therefore the solar conversion efficiency is improved. The solar energy condensation and utilization device is simple in structure and convenient to use, and accords with the development tendency of energy conservation and environment protection.

title: Solar device
abstract: The invention relates to a solar device. The solar device comprises a solar energy acquisition board, a condensing unit, a micro electromechanical sensing unit, a bearing unit and a control unit, wherein the solar energy acquisition board is used for acquiring sunlight; the condensing unit is arranged on the solar energy acquisition board and is used for gathering the sunlight irradiated on the solar energy acquisition board; the electromechanical sensing unit is arranged on the solar energy acquisition board and is used for sensing the direction of the sun and outputting a light sensing signal; the bearing unit is used for bearing the solar energy acquisition board and adjusting the position of the solar energy acquisition board according to the light sensing signal; and the control unit is connected with the electromechanical sensing unit, and is used for receiving a sensing signal output by the electromechanical sensing unit so as to control the bearing unit to rotate to adjust the position of the solar energy acquisition board.

title: Solar energy lighting communication tower
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy lighting communication tower. The solar energy lighting communication tower comprises a tower body and ladder stands, wherein the ladder stands are installed on the tower body; and a solar energy absorbing panel is installed at the top end of the tower body and is connected with a solar energy battery located in the tower body, and the solar energy battery is connected with a lighting lamp. According to the solar energy lighting communication tower, compared with the prior art, solar energy is supplied to the lighting lamp, so that sustainable working performance of the lighting lamp is reinforced, energy expenditure is reduced, and use cost is reduced.

title: Solar energy air-conditioning device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy air-conditioning device, which comprises a solar energy cell, a mode switching device and a variable frequency air conditioner.The device can be automatically or manually switched between the power network electric energy work module and the solar energy work module.During the solar energy work module, the rotating speed of the compressor of the variable frequency air conditioner is controlled by solar energy optical power and the refrigerating capacity or heating capacity thereof is in proportional to the output power of the solar energy cell.Therefore, the air-conditioning device is a power saving device by utilizing the solar energy.

title: MICRO-OPTICS CONCENTRATOR FOR SOLAR POWER SATELLITES
abstract: There is an increasingly intense need to harness solar energy due to an ever growing shortage of conventional energy sources, The instant invention is concerned with method and apparatus for solar concentrator micro-mirrors on solar power satellites and the moon to focus and reflect large quantities of solar energy. Method and apparatus are taught for directly reflecting solar energy to the Earth; reflecting solar energy to a microwave converter in space which transmits microwave energy to the Earth; and reflecting solar energy to a laser radiation converter which beams laser radiation to the Earth. The concentrated energy received at the Earth may be converted directly to electricity or indirectly by thermo-mechanical means. The advantages and disadvantages of the different means of sending such concentrated energy to the Earth are discussed. A particularly important objective of this invention is the focussing of sunlight for solar power conversion and production. The instant invention can contribute to the goal of achieving environmentally clean solar energy on a large enough scale to be competitive with conventional energy sources.

title: Steel construction solar energy stage
abstract: The utility model discloses a steel construction solar energy stage, whole stage is the skeleton based on the steel construction of light, creatively has utilized solar energy and wind energy to provide the energy for stage itself, solar cell panel on the solar energy ceiling can utilize solar energy and wind generator system to save the energy for whole stage with the solar energy stage base on the stage base, and the storage is in the middle of the battery device, wind generator system not only provides the energy, the colored LED lamp of blade upper end still provides the positive role of beautifying the stage effect. Whole convenient operation, and with low costs, easy maintenance, practicality are good, and utilize solar energy and wind energy to practice thrift a large amount of energy, will receive people's welcome.

title: System and method for creating a networked infrastructure distribution platform of energy gathering devices

title: Solar energy mounting bracket for new forms of energy
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy mounting bracket for new forms of energy, including solar energy mounting bracket, base and grafting landing leg, the solar energy mounting bracket is located base upper end terminal surface, the grafting landing leg is located base bottom terminal surface, be equipped with solar cell panel on the solar energy mounting bracket, the unsettled lens that are equipped with of solar cell panel upper end terminal surface, the lens top is equipped with electrically heated glass, all peg graft on the solar energy mounting bracket in the both ends of electrically heated glass and lens, the one end symmetry of solar energy mounting bracket is equipped with the connection piece, be equipped with the spread groove post corresponding with the connection pieceon the base.
