title: Linear fresnel solar arrays and receievers therefor
abstract: Described herein are solar energy collector systems, components for solar energy collector systems, and methods for installing solar energy collector systems. The components for solar energy collector systems include but are not limited to solar radiation absorbers, receivers, drives, drive systems, reflectors, and various support structures. The solar energy collection systems, solar radiation absorbers, receivers, drives, drive systems, reflectors, support structures, and/or methods may be used, for example, in LFR solar arrays. Improved solar radiation absorbers, receivers and related methods are described here.

title: Solar energy-geothermal energy organic Rankine cycle power generation system and use method
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy-geothermal energy organic Rankine cycle power generation system and a using method, the system comprises a solar energy system, a geothermal energy system and an organic Rankine cycle power generation system, the solar energy system serves as a heat source of the organic Rankine cycle power generation system, and the geothermal energy system serves as a preheating device of the solar energy system; a high-temperature working medium of the solar system can release heat in the organic Rankine cycle power generation system through the energy transfer assembly, so that the organic Rankine cycle power generation system can operate; the cold tank and the heat storage heat tank are arranged in the solar system, so that the system not only provides energy for the organic Rankine cycle when solar energy is sufficient, but also can store excessive solar energy, and when the solar energy is insufficient, the energy stored in the heat storage heat tank is utilized to generate power.

title: Solar energy advertising device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy advertising device, which comprises a base frame, a solar energy panel that is arranged on the base frame, a storage battery that is connected with the solar energy panel and stores electric energy transformed from solar energy as well as an advertising unit, and the advertising unit includes an advertisement curtain, a luminescence unit sending out light and penetrating through the advertisement curtain from inside to outside and a switch unit, and the switch unit is connected between the luminescence unit and the storage battery for electric conduction. Compared with the background technique, the solar energy advertising device adopts the technical proposal that: because the solar energy panel absorbs solar energy in the daytime, the solar energy is transformed into electric energy which is stored in the storage battery, and the storage battery provides the electric energy for the luminescence unit for luminescence at night, therefore, the advertising device has the luminescence function and directly utilizes the solar energy, and has the advantages of environmental protection, energy and cost saving and having no need of replacement.

title: Solar camera
abstract: Disclosed is a solar camera, which comprises a camera main body (1), an image monitor screen (2), a rechargeable battery supplying power to the camera main body (1), a battery charging interface and a solar energy charging module. The solar energy charging module comprises a solar panel (3) and a solar energy charging control circuit connected with the solar panel (3), wherein an output end of the solar energy charging control circuit is connected with the battery charging interface, and the solar panel can absorb and convert optical energy into electrical energy and further can charge the battery via the solar energy charging control circuit. The battery of the solar camera can be charged in an environment with light, thereby the solar camera can continuously take pictures for a long time without carrying a plurality of batteries, which is extremely convenient for use.

title: Wind energy and solar energy power generation device of wind and light storing and charging integrated micro-grid system
abstract: The invention discloses a wind energy and solar energy power generation device of a wind and light storing and charging integrated micro-grid system to achieve wind energy power generation, or solar energy power generation, or wind energy and solar energy power generation and connect the power generated by the wind energy and the power generated by the solar energy to the grid. The wind energy andsolar energy power generation device comprises a solar energy battery panel, a rotating bracket, a rotary plate electric generator, and a bidirectional converter. The wind energy and solar energy power generation device can connect the power generated by the wind energy and the power generated by the solar energy to the grid and integrally connect the power to the integrated micro-grid system. Power generating efficiency is improved, and the utilization rate of clean energy is improved.

title: Lighting lamp combining solar energy and wind energy
abstract: The utility model discloses a lighting lamp combining solar energy and wind energy and belongs to the technical field of comprehensive utilization of the solar energy and the wind energy. The lighting lamp combining the solar energy with the wind energy comprises a main body, a bulb, a lamp post, a solar panel, blades, a generator and a storage battery. The lamp post supports the whole main body. The generator, the blades, the bulb and the solar panel are sequentially arranged at the upper end of the lamp post. The storage battery is installed at the bottom of the lamp post. The blades are connected with the generator. The bulb, the solar panel and the generator are respectively and electrically connected with the storage battery. The lighting lamp combining the solar energy and the wind energy has the advantages that the solar energy and the wind energy are effectively combined together, the advantages of the solar energy and the wind energy are utilized comprehensively, and resources are reasonably and effectively used, thereby supplying power to the lighting lamp in accordance with local conditions and circumstances and being economic, practical, safe and energy-saving.

title: Wind energy and solar energy mooring aerostat and accounting method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of aerostat design, and provides a wind energy and solar energy mooring aerostat and an accounting method thereof.The wind energy and solar energy mooring aerostat comprises a mooring aerostat body, an energy controller, a solar power generation device and a wind power generation device; the solar power generation device and the wind power generation device are both detachably arranged on the mooring aerostat, the energy controller comprises an energy source controller, a solar power source controller and an energy storage battery, and the first charging end is electrically connected with the wind power generation device through the wind power source controller. The second charging end is electrically connected with the solar power generation device through the solar power supply controller, and the power supply end is electrically connected with a load in the mooring aerostat. According to the wind energy and solar energy mooring aerostat, wind energy and solar energy power generation is applied to the mooring aerostat, the advantages of wind energy and solar energy power generation are fully played, and the purpose of stably supplying power to load equipment in the mooring aerostat for a long time is achieved.

title: Solar energy power supplying propaganda column
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy power supplying propaganda column which comprises a propaganda column, a lighting lamp, a solar energy battery and a controller. The lighting lamp is arranged on the propaganda column, and the solar energy battery is connected with the lighting lamp through the controller. By arranging the solar energy battery on the propaganda column, the solar energy battery is controlled by the controller to supply power to the lighting lamp, without a wire for supplying power to the propaganda column, so that the installation process of the solar energy power supplying propaganda column is effectively simplified. In addition, as solar energy is utilized to supply power to the lighting lamp, the power consumption of the solar energy power supplying propaganda column is effectively reduced.

title: SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy system. The solar energy system comprises a solar collector for providing energy generated from incident solar radiation. The system comprises a first heat exchange system comprising an ejector that is arranged to operate using at least a portion of the energy provided by the solar energy collector. Further, the system comprises a second heat exchange system arranged to operate using energy from an energy source other than a source of solar source. The solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy between the first heat exchange system and a region and between the second heat exchange system and the region. Further, the solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy from the second heat exchange system for use by at least one of: the first heat exchange system and a system for heating water.

title: Solar energy tea table
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy tea table comprising a tabletop, support frames, a solar energy photovoltaic panel; the tabletop is round; two sides of the tabletop bottom are provided with the support frames; the tabletop is peripherally provided with the solar energy photovoltaic panel; a heating plate is installed above the tabletop; the solar energy photovoltaic panel is connected with the heating plate. By the installation of the solar energy photovoltaic panel and the heating plate on the solar energy tea table of the invention, the solar energy is converted into electric power through the solar energy tea table to power the heating plate for heating, which facilitates heating water and making tea; the tea table is suitable for balconies and district gardens and it is convenient for use.

title: Solar powered automobile
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar powered automobile which comprises an automobile body, a bracket fixedly arranged on the top part of the automobile body and a fixed solar energy plate arranged on the bracket, wherein the bracket is provided with a slide rail; the slide rail is provided with a movable solar energy plate; and the movable solar energy plate is connected with a driving motor in a transmission way through a transmission mechanism. When a vehicle runs, the solar energy plate can be folded, the area is reduced, the resistance is reduced, and the safety of driving is not affected; and when the vehicle stops, the solar energy plate can be extended, the receiving area of the solar energy plate is enlarged, and generated electrical energy of solar energy is enhanced.

title: Wind energy and solar energy complementary electric automobile
abstract: The invention relates to a wind energy and solar energy complementary electric automobile, comprising a wind energy generator, a charging storage battery and a solar energy power supply unit with a solar panel, wherein a wind energy and solar energy complementary storage battery is connected with a solar cell of the solar energy power supply unit, the wind energy generator, and a storage battery charging and power supply program control device; the storage battery charging and power supply program control device is electrically connected with the charging storage battery; and the solar energy power supply unit and the wind energy generator which are arranged on an expandable link can be collected in the body of the electric automobile. In the invention, compared with prior art, the natural whether resources of wind energy and solar energy are fully utilized as energy of the electric automobile, power supply program is controlled by a complementary storage battery and a program-control device to realize natural resource utilization maximization, and solar energy and wind energy complementary utilization is good for improving continuity and stability of the power supply of the electric automobile.

title: New energy bicycle lock based on solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a new energy bicycle lock based on solar energy. A solar cell used for supplying power to a lateral lighting device and a lower LED lighting device is fixedly connected in an upper assembling groove of the lock, wherein the solar cell comprises solar cell panels, a glass plate and an outer frame, triangular through holes which are arranged in order are contained in the glass plate, the solar cell panels are fixedly arranged in the triangular through holes, each solar cell panel is in a honeycomb shape formed by connecting a plurality of regular hexagonal solar cell pieces, and each solar cell piece can generate the power independently. The solar cell is fixed at the top end of the lock, sunlight is used for supplying the power to the lateral lighting device and thelower LED lighting device, thus the cruising ability of a whole lighting system is greatly improved, and the use cost is reduced; and the solar cell has good compression resistance, the utilization rate of the sunlight is high, and even when the solar cell panels are partially damaged, the power generation of the solar cell can not be influenced.

title: In-vehicle cooling equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses in-car cooling equipment, and particularly relates to the field of cooling equipment, the in-car cooling equipment comprises a solar energy center plate and a car roof, the two ends of the solar energy center plate are rotatably connected with a first solar energy side plate, and one side of the first solar energy side plate is hinged with a second solar energy side plate; according to the technical key points, different states of a solar center plate, a first solar side plate, a second solar side plate and a third solar side plate are changed by rotating a rotating disc, and when the solar center plate, the first solar side plate, the second solar side plate and the third solar side plate are unfolded and carried on an automobile roof, solar energy is converted into electric energy; when the solar center plate, the first solar side plate, the second solar side plate and the third solar side plate are contracted and carried on the roof of the automobile, the storage battery is used for driving the fan to rotate and driving the airflow in the automobile to rotate, operation is easy, and the storage battery in the automobile does not need to be used.

title: SOLAR ENERGY DISAGGREGATION TECHNIQUES FOR WHOLE-HOUSE ENERGY CONSUMPTION DATA
abstract: Systems and methods of the present invention are directed to disaggregating the contribution of solar panels from a whole house energy profile. Methods of disaggregating energy produced by solar panels from low frequency whole-house energy consumption data for a specific house, may include steps of: predicting solar energy generation for the specific house by estimating a solar capacity of the solar panels, predicting solar intensity associated with the specific house, and multiplying estimated solar capacity with predicted solar intensity; and subtracting the predicted solar energy generation from the low frequency whole house energy consumption data, thereby disaggregating the contribution of energy produced by the solar panels. Computerized systems of the same may apply machine learning models such as radial basis function, support vector, or neural network machines.

title: PORTABLE CUP USING SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: PURPOSE: A portable cup using solar energy is provided to maximize the insulating effect of a cup by enhancing the efficiency of a solar panel. CONSTITUTION: A portable cup using solar energy comprises a body(1), a first solar panel(2), a second solar panel(3), a heat absorbing unit(4), a heat conduction unit, a temperature measuring unit(6), a storage battery, and a heating wire. The top of the body is open and a handle(11) is attached to its side. The first solar panel is installed on the top of the body to be able to open/close to convert solar energy to electrical energy. The second solar panel is rotatably connected to the upper outer part of the body to increase the absorption of the solar energy. The heat absorbing unit absorbs heat energy, which is generated from the solar energy. The heat conduction unit heat energy absorbed by the heat absorbing unit to the body.

title: Eutrophic water purifying device utilizing solar energy and biological floating beds
abstract: The utility model provides an eutrophic water purifying device utilizing solar energy and biological floating beds, which comprises a solar energy device, solar energy electric plates and the biological floating beds, wherein the solar energy device is mounted on a light corrosion-proof frame, the left side and the right side of the solar energy device are both connected with the biological floating beds, the front sides of the left and the right biological floating beds and the front side of the solar energy device are connected with the solar energy electric plate, and symmetrically, the rear sides of the left and the right biological floating beds and the rear side of the solar energy device are further connected with another solar energy electric plate. The eutrophic water purifying device combines solar energy biological recovery technology with the biological floating bed technology, and fully utilizes the advantages of the solar energy biological recovery technology and the biological floating bed technology to treat eutrophic water. The device has the characteristics of high treating efficiency, quick results, thorough purification, no secondary pollution, flexibility in operation, wide application scope, energy conservation and the like.

title: Solar energy assembly and device applying the solar energy assembly
abstract: The utility model provides a solar module used for collecting the solar energy for a solar device. The solar module comprises an upper glass cover plate, a bottom plate, a frame used for fixing the upper glass cover plate and the bottom plate, and at least four silicon solar energy sheets which are arranged between the upper glass cover plate and the bottom plate. At least one angle of the silicon solar energy sheets is a chamfer angle so that four chamfer angles can be formed to form gaps in the joints of the silicon energy sheets; and a through hole is formed in the corresponding joint for the penetration of the upper glass cover plate and the bottom plate into the solar energy component. Through a plurality of ventilation through holes arranged in the solar component, the solar component can improve the wind resistance performance of solar equipment, such as a solar component, a solar street light, a solar power supplying device, and the like, so that the solar equipment can be enabled to have more strong wind resistance strength.

title: Complementary integrated system of solar energy photovoltaic power generation and solar energy panel heat collection and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a complementary integrated system of solar energy photovoltaic power generation and solar energy panel heat collection and a control method thereof, wherein solar energy is collected by improving ordinary solar energy photovoltaic power generation systems and ordinary solar energy panel heat collection systems for carrying out photovoltaic power generation and panel heat collection. The system consists of a solar energy photovoltaic power generation system and a solar energy panel heat collection system; the solar energy photovoltaic power generation system consists of a solar cell component, water circulating pipes and a multipurpose power supply device; super-white toughened glass is arranged on the outer layer of the solar cell component, a solar cell panel is arranged in the middle of the solar cell component, and a transparent back board is arranged inside the solar cell component; the water circulating pipes tightly abut against the back of the solar cell component; the multipurpose power supply device comprises a charging and discharging controller, a storage cell, an inverter, a direct-current output socket, an alternating-current output socket and a direct-current load; and the solar energy panel heat collection system consists of a panel solar energy heat collector, a balcony wall-mounted water tank and a hot water use terminal.

title: Charging protection case of integration type solar energy electronic equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a charging protection case of integration type solar energy electronic equipment. The charging protection case of the integration type solar energy electronic equipment comprises a protection case and an integrated charging module. The protection case is mainly composed of solar energy plates. Each solar energy plate is composed of solar energy battery chips and thin film layers arranged on surfaces of two sides of each solar energy battery chip in a sealed mode. The integrated charging module is in an electric connection with the solar energy battery chips. The charging protection case of the integration type solar energy electronic equipment not only is used as a protection case of an electronic product, but also has a solar energy charging function and is lighter and thinner than an existing protection case and facilitates carrying and using by people.

title: Energy accumulative solar energy generator
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy conversion device, in particular to an energy storing type solar energy generator. The energy storing type solar energy generator adopts the technical proposal that a feeding tank, a heater, an energy storing tank, heat exchange equipment, a lighting plate, a supporting frame, etc., are included, wherein, the lighting plate is fixed on the supporting frame, the heater is installed above the lighting plate, the feeding tank is connected with the heater through a pipeline, the heater is connected with the energy storing tank through a pipeline, the energy storing tank is connected with the heat exchange equipment through a pipeline, and the heat exchange equipment is connected with the heater through a pipeline. The energy storing type solar energy generator solves the problems of solar energy conversion and energy storage, therefore, the solar energy function is fully exerted.

title: Solar energy and heat pump hot water composite heat-supply system and control method therefor
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy and heat pump hot water composite heat-supply system and a control method therefor. The solar energy and heat pump hot water composite heat-supply system comprises a heat pump hot water system and a solar energy power supply system, wherein the heat pump hot water system is used for circularly preparing required hot water through a hot pump hot water machine; the solar energy power supply system is used for absorbing solar energy to generate electric energy; and the electric energy generated by the solar energy power supply system is supplied to the heat pump hot water system. By adoption of the solar energy and heat pump hot water composite heat-supply system, the solar energy system and heat pump hot water system can be effectively combined together; the electric energy generated by the solar energy system is supplied to the heat pump hot water system to maintain the normal operation of the heat pump hot water system, so that the solar energy and the heat pump heat energy are effectively utilized; energy resource is effectively utilized while the energy resource utilization rate is improved; meanwhile, the shortcoming of high influence on an original single solar energy system and a single heat pump hot water system from weather, environment and other external factors also can be overcome; and all-weather operation of the solar energy and heat pump hot water composite heat-supply system can be realized.

title: Solar energy environment -friendly building
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy environment -friendly building, including the building roof, solar water heater, the solar energy power generation membrane, the battery, the electromagnetic energy water heater, endless belt, the driving shaft, driven shaft and motor, driving shaft and driven shaft rotate and set up on the building roof, the endless belt cover is established on driving shaft and driven shaft, the solar energy power generation membrane is fixed on endless belt, solar water heater, battery and electromagnetic energy water heater are all fixed on the building roof, solar water heater passes through being connected with the water end (W. E. ) of electromagnetic energy hydrophone and premises, the solar energy power generation membrane is connected with the battery, the battery is connected with motor and electromagnetic energy hydrophone respectively, the motor is connected with the driving shaft. The utility model discloses a saving solar energy conversion in the battery for the electric energy through the solar energy power generation membrane in the daytime to it adds hydrothermal mesh to reach to last in evening, secondly, can hide the solar energy power generation membrane automatically when the bad weather, protect the solar energy power generation filming.

title: Solar energy duplicator
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy duplicator. The solar energy duplicator consists of a solar battery pack, an intelligent charge controller, an energy storage battery, an inverter and a duplicator. The solar battery pack is arranged on the rooftop or the ground which are capable of receiving sunlight. The intelligent charge controller is respectively connected with the solar battery pack and the energy storage battery. The inverter is connected with the energy storage battery and the duplicator. The solar battery pack charges up the energy storage battery through the intelligent charge controller, and electrical energy of the energy storage battery outputs 220 volts of alternating current power supply to the duplicator and enables the duplicator to work. The solar energy duplicator does not need electric supply, is powered entirely by solar energy and has the advantages of long service life, energy conservation, environmental protection and the like.

title: Independent solar heating system
abstract: The invention provides an independent solar heating system. The independent solar heating system comprises a solar heat collection piece, a solar controller, an insulated water tank, a domestic water device, a heating stove, a floor heating device, a heating radiator device, a bed warming device, a water pump, a three-way automatic control device, a solar absorbing device, an energy converter, an energy storage device, a detection circuit, a control circuit and an illumination device, wherein the solar heat collection piece is connected with the solar absorbing device on a solar illumination device; the solar absorbing device is connected with the energy converter; the energy converter is connected with the energy storage device; the energy storage device is connected with the illumination device and the control circuit; and the control circuit is connected with the detection circuit. According to the independent solar heating system, solar energy can be utilized for illumination, the utilization rate of solar energy is increased, and the energy is further saved; and besides, materials are taken on site, the mounting is convenient, current resources are greatly utilized, and the waste of resources is reduced.

title: Assessment method of solar energy resources
abstract: The invention relates to an assessment method of solar energy resources, and belongs to the technical field of utilization of the solar energy resources. The method comprises the following steps: performing main component analysis on the overall solar energy resource assessment based on the basic principle of main component analysis to obtain the weight coefficients of four assessment indicators, including the rich degree of the solar energy resource, the solar energy resource utilization value, the solar energy resource stability and the optimal daily utilization time of the solar energy resources, so as to obtain a quantitative description formula for the overall solar energy resource assessment; and then assessing the solar energy resources based on the formula. With the adoption of the method, the assessment process can be simplified, so that the working hours can be decreased, the workload can be reduced, and moreover, accurate result can be obtained.

title: MODULE FOR SOLAR ENERGY GENERATION AND APPARATUS HAVING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention provides a solar energy generation module and a solar energy generation apparatus including the same. The solar energy generation apparatus includes a plurality of solar energy generation modules. The solar energy generation modules include: a frame unit having a polygonal pyramid shape and having an installation surface on a side surface thereof; and a plurality of solar panels provided on the installation surface.

title: Solar energy heat storage station
abstract: The invention relates to solar energy heat storage devices, particularly to solar energy heat storage devices with heat energy mobility. A solar energy heat storage station comprises a solar energy heat reservoir and is a light collecting and heat energy storing working system loop which is composed of a solar energy light collecting mechanism, a heat exchanger, a reversing valve and high-temperature connection valves. Heat energy collected by the light collecting mechanism is stored in the heat reservoir for standby, by means of the inversion of the reversing valve 4 and through the high-temperature connection valves to connect a solar energy mobile heat storage device, the solar heat energy collected by the light collecting mechanism can be directly stored inside the solar energy mobile heat storage device. The light collecting and heat energy storing working system loop works independently. A heat energy transfer working system loop is composed of the heat exchanger, a spiral working pump and the high-temperature connection valves, the solar energy mobile heat storage device is connected with the heat exchanger through the high-temperature connection valves, and the heat energy transfer working system loop also works independently. Through the pushing of the spiral working pump, the heat energy stored by the solar energy heat reservoir for standby can be transported to the solar energy heat storage device.

title: Solar fan umbrella
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy fan umbrella. Particularly, the solar energy fan umbrella comprises a sunshade, a solar panel and a fan, wherein the solar panel is positioned at the outer layer of the top end of the umbrella surface; and the fan is positioned at the inner top end of the umbrella surface, is fixed on an umbrella handle and is connected with the solar panel. The solar fan umbrella has simple structure, is energy-saving, is convenient to use and can supply air while shading the sun. Because solar energy is used for generating power, the solar energy fan umbrella is environmentally-friendly and energy-saving.

title: Solar energy attemperator and indoor solar energy temperature adjustment equipment
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy attemperator and indoor solar energy temperature adjustment equipment, belongs to the solar heat utilization technical field. Solar energy attemperator include: casing, solar heating supply device, electric heating element and fan, be provided with air intake and air outlet on the lateral wall of casing, electric heating element with the fan set up in in the casing, the solar heating supply device to heat energy is carried to the air intake, the fan to the air outlet air supply. Solar energy temperature adjustment equipment includes foretell solar energy attemperator. During this solar energy attemperator uses, weather factor's etc. Influence is not received, the whole day heat supply can be realized.

title: Solar energy deodorization shoes
abstract: The utility model discloses a pair of solar energy deodorization shoes capable of utilizing solar energy and performing deodorization function. The pair of solar energy deodorization shoes comprises deodorization shoes; solar energy electrical panels are arranged on the uppers of the deodorization shoes; solar energy storage batteries are arranged in heels; and one or more ventilation fans are arranged on two sides of each of the uppers respectively. The utility model has the advantages that the pair of solar energy deodorization shoes utilizes the solar energy as an energy source to ensure the environmental protection and supply required electrical energy for the running of the fans in the uppers, thereby fulfilling the forced deodorization function.

title: Pulling-expanding type solar energy generator with functions of tilting and elevation
abstract: The invention discloses a pulling-expanding type solar energy generator with functions of tilting and elevation, belonging to the solar power supply technology field. The invention solves the problems that the solar energy battery panel is single in arrangement mode and cannot effectively receive solar energy. The pulling-expanding type solar energy generator comprises a tilting mechanism, a telescopic mechanism, an elevation mechanism and a pulling type solar energy battery panel mechanism; a plurality of solar energy battery panels are in the expanding state during the usage; the expanded solar energy battery panels can perform height adjustment according to the sun position under the driving of the elevation mechanism, and form angle inclination under the driving of the tilting mechanism so as to realize the tracking of the sun position and the angle and guarantee that an optimal angle position is formed between the surface of the solar energy battery and the sun light. The invention is a solar energy generator.

title: Vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp. The vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp comprises a solar cell panel, an energy storage device, a controller and an illuminating device, wherein the solar cell panel is arranged at the top of a vehicle; the output end of the solar cell panel is electrically connected with the energy storage device;the output end of the energy storage device is electrically connected with the controller; and the controller is electrically connected with the illuminating device. By means of the manner, the vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp has the advantages that the structure is novel, solar energy is converted into electric energy, the electric energy is stored in time and can be usedat any time, energy resources are saved, the service life is long, and convenience and practicality are achieved, and has a wide market prospect in popularization of the vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp.

title: A solar energy system
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy system. The solar energy system comprises a solar collector for providing energy generated from incident solar radiation. The system comprises a first heat exchange system comprising an ejector that is arranged to operate using at least a portion of the energy provided by the solar energy collector. Further, the system comprises a second heat exchange system arranged to operate using energy from an energy source other than a source of solar source. The solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy between the first heat exchange system and a region and between the second heat exchange system and the region. Further, he solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy from the second heat exchange system for use by at least one of: the first heat exchange system and a system for heating water.

title: Vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp. The vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp comprises a solar cell panel, an energy accumulator, a controller and an illuminating device, wherein the solar cell panel is arranged at the top of an automobile; an output end of the solar cell panel is electrically connected with the energy accumulator; an output end of the energy accumulator is electrically connected with the controller; and the controller is electrically connected with the illuminating device. Through the abovementioned method, the vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp has the advantages that the structure is novel, solar energy is converted into electric energy, the electric energy is timely stored and can be utilized at any time, the energy is saved, the service life is long, the illuminating lamp is convenient and practical, and the like, and broad market prospect in popularization of the vehicle-mounted solar energy storage illuminating lamp is achieved.

title: Solar energy heating system
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy heating system. The solar energy heating system comprises a solar energy heat collector device, an energy storage device and a terminal device, wherein the solar energy heat collector device comprises a solar heat transfer coiler; the solar heating spiral pipe is arranged in the energy storage device, an energy storage medium is arranged in the energy storage device; the terminal device comprises a drinking water system, the drinking water system comprises a drinking water coiler, the drinking water coiler is arranged in the energy storage device, and at least part of the solar heat transfer coiler is surrounded outside the drinking water coiler. Through arranging the independent drinking water coiler, the solar energy heating system can absorb heat from the energy storage device, and provides healthful hot drinking water.

title: Solar energy back film laying device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy back films, and specifically relates to a solar energy back film laying device. The solar energy back film laying device comprises a solar energy plate, the solar energy plate is provided with a supporting block, guiding wheels attached on the solar energy plate are disposed in the supporting block, a back film channel and a connecting block are arranged on the supporting block, the connecting block is provided with a pressing board, and the external layer of the pressing board is provided with flannelette. During a laying process for a solar energy back film by the solar energy back film laying device, the back film is laid on the solar energy plate through the back film channel, and then the back film is firmly pressed by the pressing board, so that laying work can be completed rapidly and effectively, and good effects are achieved.

title: Rain-snow prevention solar energy power supply device
abstract: The invention discloses a rain-snow prevention solar energy power supply device, and relates to the technical field of solar energy power supply facilities. The rain-snow prevention solar energy power supply device comprises a rainfall inductor, a solar energy collecting element, a controller and a storage battery. The rainfall inductor is arranged on the solar energy collecting element and connected with the controller. The controller is further connected with an electrical heating element which is arranged on the back face of a solar energy collecting board of the solar energy collecting element. The controller receives a rainfall signal of the rainfall s inductor and controls the electrical heating element. When the back face of the solar energy collecting board is heated, rain and snow adhered to the surface of the solar energy collecting board melt and evaporate, so that cleaning of the surface of the solar energy collecting board is ensured. Solar energy collecting electric power storage efficiency in areas in the north wherein heavy snow days are long and in the south wherein plum rain days are long is improved. The rain-snow prevention solar energy power supply device is environment-friendly, energy-saving, low in manufacture cost, easy to maintain, and capable of being flexibly applied to areas in different climatic conditions.

title: Solar energy utilization and radiation refrigeration composite system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy utilization and radiation refrigeration composite system. The system comprises a radiation refrigeration system and a solar energy conversion and utilization system. The radiation refrigeration system comprises a radiation refrigeration device and a radiation cold energy collection and utilization system. The solar energy conversion and utilization system comprises a solar energy conversion device and an energy utilization system. The solar energy conversion device is located on the two sides of the radiation refrigeration device, a composite structure energy conversion device is formed by the solar energy conversion device and the radiation refrigeration device, the radiation refrigeration device converts heat energy into electromagnetic waves and radiates the electromagnetic waves to the space to achieve refrigeration, and meanwhile solar energy irradiated to the surface of the radiation refrigeration device is reflected to the solar energy conversion device; and the solar energy conversion device receives direct irradiation of sunlight, sunlight reflected by the radiation refrigeration device and radiation electromagnetic waves of a radiation refrigeration device body and converts the sunlight and the radiation electromagnetic waves into electric energy or heat energy or cold energy, and superposition utilization of solar energy and radiation refrigeration in the same area is achieved. According to the system, the energy utilization rate and the energy density of unit area can be greatly improved.

title: Energy saving and environment friendly signal lamp
abstract: The invention discloses an energy saving and environmental friendly signal lamp. The energy saving and environmental friendly signal lamp comprises a lamp pole, a hollow lamp pole seat, a square signal lamp casing, a long distance signal LED lamp, a solar energy battery plate, a solar energy controller, a solar energy storage battery, a solar energy power panel, a backup power, an electric tension monitor, a signal emitting device, and a single-chip computer, wherein the hollow lamp pole seat is located on the bottom of the lamp pole for supporting the lamp pole, the square signal lamp casing is located on the top of the lamp pole, the long distance signal LED lamp is located in the signal lamp casing, the solar energy battery plate is arranged on the top of the signal lamp casing in an inclined mode, and the solar energy controller, the solar energy storage battery, the solar energy power panel, the backup power, the electric tension monitor, the signal emitting device, and the single-chip computer are all arranged in the hollow lamp pole seat. The solar energy battery plate, the solar energy controller, the solar energy storage battery, the solar energy power panel, the electric tension monitor, the single-chip computer, and the signal emitting device are connected electrically in sequence. The solar energy power panel is electrically connected with the backup power and the long distance signal LED lamp, the solar energy power panel is further electrically connected with an external power supply through a relay, and the relay is electrically connected with the single-chip computer. The problem that a large energy consumption of prior art is not beneficial to environmental protection undertaking is solved.

title: Solar Energy Disaggregation Techniques for Whole-House Energy Consumption Data
abstract: Systems and methods of the present invention are directed to disaggregating the contribution of solar panels from a whole house energy profile. Methods of disaggregating energy produced by solar panels from low frequency whole-house energy consumption data for a specific house, may include steps of: predicting solar energy generation for the specific house by estimating a solar capacity of the solar panels, predicting solar intensity associated with the specific house, and multiplying estimated solar capacity with predicted solar intensity; and subtracting the predicted solar energy generation from the low frequency whole house energy consumption data, thereby disaggregating the contribution of energy produced by the solar panels. Computerized systems of the same may apply machine learning models such as radial basis function, support vector, or neural network machines.

title: SQUARE DANCING AUDIO DEVICE USING SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: A square dancing audio device using solar energy. The device comprises: a solar energy cell panel (10), being used for collecting solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy; a cell panel controller (20), being used for controlling the operating state of electric quantity of the solar energy cell panel (10), and being able to start the solar energy cell panel (10) to charge the solar energy storage cell (30); the solar energy storage cell (30), being used for storing the converted electric energy; a converter (40), being used for controlling the operating state of the solar energy storage cell (30), and being able to start the solar energy storage cell (30) to charge a music module (50); a wireless module (60), being used for receiving playback audio signals from a user terminal; and the music module (50), being used for performing playback according to the audio signals received by the wireless module (60). The device of the invention stores electric energy by utilizing the irradiation of the sun, and supplies the electric energy to a loudspeaker for playing back music.

title: Disclosed are solar energy supplementing device and solar lighting system
abstract: The utility model is applicable to the field of illumination. The utility model provides a solar energy supplementing device and a solar lighting system. Wherein the solar energy supplementing deviceis matched with the solar lamp; the solar lamp is provided with an access interface used for accessing electric energy. The device comprises an energy storage structure and a control circuit, the energy storage structure comprises a solar cell piece and a rechargeable battery. The control circuit is electrically connected with the energy storage structure and provided with an output interface matched with the access interface, and the control circuit can transmit electric energy stored by the energy storage structure to the solar lamp when the output interface is electrically connected with the access interface. The solar energy supplementing device provided by the utility model can provide standby electric energy for the solar lamp, and can be suitable for the existing solar lamp, so thatthe upgrading and reconstruction cost of equipment can be reduced, and the construction cost of laying a circuit network can be saved.

title: Tower solar energy collection system
abstract: The utility model provides a tower solar energy collection system, includes solar energy heliostat field and solar energy collection tower, solar energy heliostat field includes azimuth adjusting device, a plurality of heliostat, azimuth adjusting device is including a supporting bench and a carousel, the upper portion of installing at a supporting bench is rotated to the bottom of carousel, the heliostat all includes the support frame, supports the cross axle, gathers calorimeter mount pad and reflect meter, the rotational motion of supporting the cross axle makes the angle of pitch of reflect meter changes, the central point of carousel puts to put with the central point who props up supporting bench that corresponds and is equipped with a through -hole that runs through, the solar energy collection tower passes the through -hole and fixes subaerial, the solar energy collection tower includes solar energy collection tower support and sets up the solar energy collection ware on the support top, solar collector can absorb the solar energy of solar energy heliostat field reflection.

title: Solar energy water heater
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy water heater, belongs to the field of household appliances, and aims to achieve the purpose of sufficiently utilizing solar energy. The technical scheme of theinvention lies in that the solar energy water heater comprises a solar energy water heater body and a fixing device, wherein a reflective mirror is also mounted on the fixing device; a certain angle is maintained between the reflective mirror and the solar energy water heater body, so that the situation that light energy is reflected to the solar energy water heater body as much as possible is guaranteed; and the reflective mirror can also rotate. The solar energy water heater disclosed by the invention can receive a large amount of light energy, so that the light energy is utilized to the maximum degree; and the solar energy water heater is ingenious in design and simple in structure, and has great use value.

title: Solar energy thermometer
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy thermometer. The solar energy thermometer comprises a body, wherein a scale which can display temperature is arranged on the body. The solar energy thermometer is characterized in that a top portion of the body is provided with a solar energy plate, a charging cell connected with the solar energy plate is arranged in the body, a backlight light which is used for lighting for the scale is further arranged in the body, an output terminal of the charging cell is connected with the backlight light and used for supplying power for the backlight light. Compared with the prior art, the solar energy thermometer provided by the utility model is advantaged in that temperature data recorded by the solar energy thermometer provided by the utility model can be read at night or in a dark environment by arranging the solar energy plate at the top portion of the body and arranging the charging cell connected with the solar energy plate and the backlight light used for lighting for the scale in the body.

title: SOLAR POWER PLANT HAVING SOLAR TRACKING APPARATUS AND SOLAR TRACKING METHOD OF THAT
abstract: PURPOSE: A solar energy generating apparatus and a back-tracking method thereof are provided to prevent the generating efficiency from lowering due to a shadow formed in a solar energy generating module by rotating a solar energy generating module with a rotating unit. CONSTITUTION: A solar energy generating apparatus comprises solar energy generating modules(50), a rotating unit, and a back-tracking unit(70). The plural solar energy modules are arranged along the east-west direction. The rotating unit rotates the solar energy generating modules according to the height of the sun so that the position angle of the sun becomes perpendicularity. The back-tracking unit controls the rotation of the solar energy generating modules by controlling the rotating unit. The back-tracking unit prevents a shadow from being generated on the surface of the solar energy generating modules between the sunrise and the sunset.

title: Method and device for solar energy and fossil fuel power station complementary circulation
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for solar energy and fossil fuel power station complementary circulation and belongs to the filed of solar energy heat utilization. A combined circulation method formed by a fossil fuel thermodynamic system and a solar energy thermodynamic system is adopted, closed-type circulation with a heat storage device is adopted in the solar energy thermodynamic system, heat exchange between the solar energy thermodynamic system and boiler feed water of the fossil fuel thermodynamic system is carried out, the whole solar energy thermodynamic system is in paralleled connection with a boiler feed water heating system of the fossil fuel thermodynamic system, and the solar energy thermodynamic system is in serial connection with the boiler feed water heating system of the fossil fuel thermodynamic system. When solar energy radiation is low, working media enter into the heat storage device to be stored, and when the solar energy radiation can meet continuous operation demands of a boiler of the fossil fuel thermodynamic system, the working media enter into a heat exchange device to exchange heat with the boiler feed water; and when the solar energy radiation is too low to meet the lowest circulation demand, the working media can be reserved in the solar energy thermodynamic system. By means of the method and the device for the solar energy and fossil fuel power station complementary circulation, effective utilization time of the solar energy can be improved, solar energy thermal side efficiency is high, and safe and enforceable operation of a fossil fuel unit can be guaranteed.

title: PORTABLE TELEPHONE SOLAR HEAT CHARGE
abstract: A solar energy battery charger for cellular phone is provided to charge the battery by attaching a solar energy collecting plate on a cellular phone. A solar heat plate is adhered to a back side of a cellular phone like a solar heat plate of electronic calculator. The solar energy is collected in the solar heat plate. The energy collected in a solar heat plate is charged to a chargeable battery.

abstract: The utility model provides a sun-facing adjusting device of a solar energy photovoltaic panel, and aims at the defects that the solar energy receiving capacity of the solar energy photovoltaic panel is reduced and the generated energy of the solar energy photovoltaic panel is low due to that common consumers are difficult to accurately adjust a sun-facing angle of the solar energy photovoltaic panel. title: A MOLECULAR SOLAR THERMAL SYSTEM (MOST) FOR LONG-TERM STORAGE OF SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: The present invention relates to a molecular solar thermal system (MOST) based on a pair of isomers, comprising in its low energy ground stage primarily a first low-energy isomer which is excitable by solar light to form a metastable high-energy isomer and in its high energy state primarily a second metastable high energy photoisomer generated via photochemical conversion from the solar light excitable first isomer. Said MOST system is characterized by high photo isomerization yields due to the light driven out-of-equilibrium isomerization of the first isomer and is further characterized by a superior thermal stability of the second high energy photo isomer. This allows a long-term storage of collected solar light energy without occurrence of spontaneous unwanted back-isomerization. By applying a particular class of, optionally immobilized, strong basic catalysts, the stored solar energy is released in a controlled manner in a catalytic thermalback reaction to yield the low energy first isomer. This offers the possibility of establishing a cyclic process for repeatedly converting solar light energy into thermal energy. The present invention also provides methods of storing solar thermal energy, methods of releasing stored solar thermal energy, methods of reversibly storing solar thermal energy as well as particular solar thermal energy storage devices comprising the use of the above mentioned MOST pair of photoisomers. The present invention also relates to the use of such compounds for the reversible storing of solar energy. Further aspects of the present invention relate to a solar thermal energy capture device, a combined device for capturing solar thermal energy and solar photoelectric energy, as well as a device for operating a reversible MOST system of the present invention. In addition, the present invention relates to particular novel low and high energy photoisomers applicable in a MOST system of the invention.

Solar energy, the natural energy, is used as drive energy of a unit, a heating heat exchanger inside a generator inputs the solar energy into the solar heat pump device, and the solar energy provides power for operation of the unit. An air source heat exchange coiler is used for absorbing energy in air. The solar energy and the energy in air are released through condensation of refrigerant steam and fusion heat of the refrigerant steam and dilute solution and transmitted to hot water, and therefore an energy utilization rate is improved.

title: Solar Puer tea drying room energy device
abstract: The invention relates to a solar Puer tea drying room energy device and belongs to the technical field of Puer tea drying. The solar Puer tea drying room energy device comprises an energy collecting device and an energy converting device. The energy collecting device converts solar energy into heat energy to be stored in heat conducting oil. The energy converting device transfers heat energy in the oil conducting oil into water, and water steam is generated. The steam is used for improving the temperature in a Puer tea drying room. Surplus solar energy can be stored. The solar Puer tea drying room energy device has the advantages that solar energy is used as energy, pollution is avoided, heavy investment is of no need during a production process, the manufacturing cost of Puer tea is lowered, when solar energy is much, heat energy can be stored by an energy storing tank, the heat energy is released when solar energy is not much, the heat conducing oil is used for collecting solar energy, the boiling point and the specific heat of the heat conducting oil are high, much energy can be stored, the heat conducting oil is used for heating water, and water vaporization can happen easily.

title: Field solar energy power supply equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to field solar power supply equipment comprising a solar energy panel and a supporting bracket, wherein a runner is mounted at the lower end of the bracket and can rotate around a circular orbit arranged on the base; a rotating shaft for adjusting the solar energy panel and carrying out pitching rotations is further mounted on the solar energy panel; a light ray tracking device is mounted on one side of the solar energy panel and arranged side by side with the solar energy panel, and the light ray tracking device and the solar energy panel move synchronously; and both the runner and the rotating shaft are driven by the motor; and the motor is controlled by a singlechip. The field solar power supply equipment provided by the utility model can track the light rays irradiating the solar energy panel, detect and analyze the directions of the light rays, as well as automatically control and adjust the position of the solar energy panel, so as to ensure that the solar energy panel is perpendicular to the light rays, and improve the solar energy utilization efficiency accordingly. The field solar power supply equipment is suitable for meeting the requirements of power supply to a detecting instrument or equipment used in unattended field environment, so as to save the cost.

title: Solar-energy optical-fiber illumination system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar-energy optical-fiber illumination system, which at least comprises a solar-energy acquisition system and an optical-fiber transmission system, wherein the solar-energy acquisition system comprises a solar-energy battery component, a solar-energy electricity charging and supplying controller, and a storage battery, wherein the solar-energy battery component is connected with the solar-energy electricity charging and supplying controller; the solar-energy electricity charging and supplying controller is connected with the storage battery; the optical-fiber transmission system comprises an optical-fiber light source machine and a light-guide optical fiber; the light-guide optical fiber is mounted on the optical-fiber light source machine; and the optical-fiber light source machine is connected with the solar-energy electricity charging and supplying controller. The solar-energy optical-fiber illumination system can provide an environmental-friendly light source, which is not harmful to eyes; during the working, the energy consumption is low and the photoelectric conversion rate is high, so that the requirements of energy conservation and environment protection, made by people, can be met. The solar-energy optical-fiber illumination system has the advantages of long transmission distance of light rays, safety and reliability. The solar-energy optical-fiber illumination system is provided with adjustable light sources with many colors, so that many types of patterns can be made.

title: Highly-efficient solar energy air source heat pump machine set based on multi-mode operation
abstract: A highly-efficient solar energy air source heat pump machine set based on multi-mode operation relates to a highly-efficient solar energy air source pump machine set based on multi-mode operation, realizes complete combination between solar energy and air source heat pumps, and completely solves the intermittence and instability problems of solar energy heating. The highly-efficient solar energy air source pump machine set realizes that under various different solar radiation intensities, the solar energy can be used highly effectively, simultaneously, the efficiency of heat pump machine set also can be improved to a greater extend, thereby realizing saving energy. The device further has simple and compact structure, and is convenient for realizing integration of solar energy utilization and building. The system comprises a cooling agent circulating loop, a solar energy heat source loop and a solar energy cold and hot water loop.

title: Multifunctional energy storage solar lamp used for picking
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional energy storage solar lamp used for picking. The multifunctional energy storage solar lamp comprises a lamp housing, bulbs, a solar cell panel, a positive binding post, a storage battery and a negative binding post. The bulbs are arranged on the surface of the lamp housing. The positive binding post and the negative binding post are arranged at the two endsof the lamp housing. The storage battery is electrically connected with the positive binding post and the negative binding post. The multifunctional energy storage solar lamp used for picking has thebeneficial effects that solar energy is generated in the continuous nuclear fusion reaction process of sunspots inside the sun or on the surface of the sun; human beings depend on the energy including all renewable energy sources of other modes to survive, and although the total quantity of solar energy resources is equivalent to more than ten thousand times of the energy used by the human beingsat present, energy density of the solar energy is low; moreover, the solar energy is varied from places to places and from time to time, which is the main problem confronted for development and utilization of the solar energy; and the features of the solar energy can make the effects of the solar energy in the whole comprehensive energy system be limited to a certain extent.

title: Solar energy system
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy system. The solar energy system comprises a solar collector for providing energy generated from incident solar radiation. The system comprises a first heat exchange system comprising an ejector that is arranged to operate using at least a portion of the energy provided by the solar energy collector. Further, the system comprises a second heat exchange system arranged to operate using energy from an energy source other than a source of solar source. The solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy between the first heat exchange system and a region and between the second heat exchange system and the region. Further, the solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy from the second heat exchange system for use by at least one of: the first heat exchange system and a system for heating water.

title: A SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy system. The solar energy system comprises a solar collector for providing energy generated from incident solar radiation. The system comprises a first heat exchange system comprising an ejector that is arranged to operate using at least a portion of the energy provided by the solar energy collector. Further, the system comprises a second heat exchange system arranged to operate using energy from an energy source other than a source of solar source. The solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy between the first heat exchange system and a region and between the second heat exchange system and the region. Further, he solar energy system is arranged for direct or indirect transfer of thermal energy from the second heat exchange system for use by at least one of: the first heat exchange system and a system for heating water.

title: Solar energy toy car
abstract: A solar energy toy car comprises a car body, a wheel carrier unit which is used for supporting the car body, a driving unit which is arranged in the car body and is used for driving the wheel carrier unit to operate, a solar energy board which is arranged on the car body and is used for changing the solar energy into the electric energy, and a power-supply unit which is arranged in the car body and is used for supplying the solar energy to the driving unit. The solar energy board can change the solar energy into the electric energy, and the driving unit is driven by the electric energy which is stored in the water-supply unit to drive the wheel carrier unit to rotate in order to move the solar energy toy car. The useless solar energy can be changed into the electric energy which is used as the driving power to drive the toy car of the utility model, and thereby saving the electric energy and facilitating the playing of the toy car.

title: A ROOF MODULE HAVING AN INTEGRAL SOLAR ENERGY CONCENTRATOR
abstract: The present invention relates to a roof module having an integral solar energy concentrator (fig. 5). The present modules can be combined to form a weathertight roof with an integral solar concentrator. Radiant solar energy can be collected from this modular roof using reflected solar energy collectors (30), among other solar energy concentrating or energy transferring elements. The present invention results in a lower weight and easier to install system for placing solar energy concentrators atop a structure, and thus, lower the cost collecting radiant solar energy from atop a building or roofed structure.

title: Refrigerator using solar energy for refrigeration units - with opt. auxiliary operation by other energy sources
abstract: Refrigerator comprises refrigeration units which are supplied from an energy source comprising the solar energy collected in solar cells. The refrigeration units may be operated selectively or simultaneously by solar energy on by conventional energy sources such as the heat generated by electrical current, gas or an electric motor, to save energy at least partly, partic. under peak load. The solar cells may e.g. be mounted on roofs and exposed directly to solar radiation, to convert solar energy directly to utilisable heat by heating e.g. water with the solar energy and using it to operate heating equipment or water heating plants.

title: Solar charging type notebook computer handbag
abstract: The utility model relates to a handbag for solar energy charge type notebook computer, which comprises a handbag body; a solar energy electronic board arranged on outer surface of the handbag body; a solar energy conversion and control device; a DC output line arranged on the solar energy conversion and control device. The solar energy electronic board converts optical energy to electric energy and then outputs the electric energy to the solar energy conversion and control device, the solar energy conversion and control device outputs the DC power supply to the notebook computer by the DC output line. The utility model prolongs the outdoor work time of the notebook computer effectively, compared with the solar energy computer bag, light radiation area is added so that solar energy is utilized more sufficiently, backup battery charge circuit and voltage conversion circuit are also arranged so as to be able to charge the backup battery and other portable equipments, LCD is arranged on the handbag body so that the user can perform the control externally and visually, moreover the utility model has the function of environmental protection by utilizing solar energy.

title: Greenhouse light supplementing system
abstract: The utility model discloses a light supplementing system for a greenhouse. The light supplementing system comprises a solar controller, a solar cell panel, an energy storage device, a solar panel supporting mechanism, a solar tracking sensor and a light supplementing lamp. Wherein the solar cell panels are rotationally connected to at least one opposite side of the roof of the greenhouse and electrically connected with the solar controller, and the energy storage device is electrically connected with the solar controller. The solar panel supporting mechanism is movably connected with the solar panel and electrically connected with the solar controller, the solar panel supporting mechanism is used for adjusting the angle of the solar panel, the solar tracking sensor is electrically connected with the solar controller, and the light supplementing lamp is arranged at the top of the greenhouse and electrically connected with the solar controller. According to the greenhouse light supplementing system, light energy is converted into electric energy through the solar cell panel, then the electric energy is converted into light energy through the light supplementing lamp to irradiate plants, the problem that natural illumination time distribution is not uniform is solved, the utilization rate of solar energy is increased, and natural light irradiated to the ceiling cannot be shielded.

title: Wind energy and solar energy power generation device
abstract: The utility model discloses a wind energy and solar energy power generation device which comprises a supporting frame. The solar panel is obliquely arranged on the supporting frame; the wind power generation surface is arranged on the supporting frame, a plurality of wind power vibrating pieces are arranged on the wind power generation surface, and strain gauges are arranged on the wind power vibrating pieces; the converter comprises a wind energy converter and a solar energy converter, the wind energy converter is connected with the strain gauges, and the solar energy converter is connected with the solar panel; and the electric power storage device is respectively connected with the wind energy converter and the solar energy converter. The wind energy and solar energy power generation device overcomes the disadvantage of intermittence of a traditional solar panel, under the action of strong wind on the building top, the wind power vibrating piece can vibrate continuously, vibrating mechanical energy can be converted into electric energy, the electric energy is led out and gathered through the strain gage, dual-energy utilization of wind energy and solar energy is achieved, the energy transfer rate is greatly improved, and the energy utilization rate is improved. And stable supply of electric energy is ensured.

title: Solar energy storage device
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy storage device. The solar energy storage device comprises an energy storage shell, an energy storage battery and a heat dissipation assembly. The energy storage battery is arranged in the energy storage shell and used for being electrically connected with a solar power generation device. And the heat dissipation assembly is arranged on the surface of the energy storage battery. The solar energy storage device comprises an energy storage battery and a heat dissipation assembly arranged on the surface of the energy storage battery. The energy storage battery is used for being electrically connected with a solar power generation device and can store electric energy generated by the solar power generation device to charge external equipment. The heat dissipation assembly is arranged on the surface of the energy storage battery, heat transfer can be accelerated, and heat generated by the energy storage battery can be guided out of the solar energy storage device in time. Therefore, the problems that the charging efficiency is seriously influenced, the solar energy storage device is damaged, the service life is shortened, charging equipment is burnt out and even a fire disaster is caused due to the fact that heat generated by the solar energy storage device is accumulated in the solar energy storage device are solved.

title: Solar energy umbrella
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy umbrella, which is formed by an umbrella face and an umbrella handle. The umbrella face is equipped with a solar energy reception board and the solar energy reception board is connected with a lead, an electric torch and a storage battery arranged inside the umbrella handle. The solar energy umbrella of the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design, energy saving and environmental protection, wherein the solar energy conversion energy is utilized without external power supplies. The solar energy umbrella is suitable for further popularization and application.

title: Solar heat supply automatic light following heating structure
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy conversion, and discloses a solar heat supply automatic light following heating structure which comprises a solar energy absorption device and a supporting device. Through the arrangement of the solar energy absorption device, the solar energy condensation surface, the connecting block, the first steering engine, the disc and other structural components, the solar energy absorption device can absorb solar energy and can convert the absorbed energy into heat energy, through the use of the positioning device, the base and the supporting device can be fixed and separated, disassembly and assembly are convenient, and the practicability is high. By using the heat dissipation device, the solar energy absorption device can be cooled, the service life can be prolonged, the working efficiency can be maintained, the effects of boiling water by using novel energy, saving energy, integrating energy supply with the kettle and improving the solar energy collection efficiency and heating efficiency are achieved, and the problems that energy is not enough, and the kettle cannot be conveniently used anytime and anywhere are solved. And the use place is easily limited.

title: Solar panel module
abstract: The present invention discloses a solar panel module. The solar panel module comprises a solar energy frame and an upper glass cover plate, the solar energy frame is internally provided with the upperglass cover plate which sleeves and is connected with the internal portion of the solar energy frame, the solar energy frame sleeves and is connected with the upper glass cover plate, and the internal portion of the upper glass cover plate is provided with an installation groove in an embedding mode. Compared to a current solar energy module rain-proof method, the solar panel module is very convenient for later maintenance and replacement and enough to cover the solar energy module, rainwater is exhausted from a rain-proof groove to prevent the solar cell panel from being damaged, when the solar energy module is suffered from the load of the external force, the force is transmitted to a spring ring at the lower end when the solar panel is suffered from the load so as to prevent the solarpanel from being damaged caused by the action of the rigid force and improve the service life of the solar energy module.

title: CLEAN ENERGY GENERATION, STORAGE, AND DISTRIBUTION SOLAR SHADE DEVICE AND METHOD OF USE THEREOF
abstract: A solar shade-energy device comprising a solar shade having a photovoltaic solar panel and a support structure; a means of mounting said solar shade; an energy storage-distribution module having a housing, an energy storage device, power conditioning circuitry, and one-or-more energy distribution ports; a means of detachably mounting said energy storage-distribution module onto said solar shade; and a disconnectable electrical interface means between said energy storage-distribution module and said photovoltaic solar panel is disclosed. A method of using said solar shade-energy device is also disclosed.

title: Solar energy/dry air energy air-water air conditioner
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy/dry air energy air-water air conditioner which is formed by compounding a solar energy photoelectric/photothermal dry air energy cold-hot water unit, a solar energy photoelectric dry air evaporative cooling fresh air unit and a connection pipe between the solar energy photoelectric/photothermal dry air energy cold-hot water unit and the solar energy photoelectric dry air evaporative cooling fresh air unit, wherein the solar energy photoelectric/photothermal dry air energy cold-hot water unit comprises a solar energy photoelectric board a, a power controller a and a solar energy water heater and is provided with an air inlet a, a filter a, an air cooler a, a water tank a, a filling a, a water distributor a, a water baffle a, an exhaust fan and an exhaust outlet in the air inlet direction; and the solar energy photoelectric dry air evaporative cooling fresh air unit comprises a solar energy photoelectric board b, a power controller b and an auxiliary cold-hot source and is provided with an air inlet b, a filter b, a pipe type indirect evaporative cooling section, an air cooler b, a direct evaporative cooling section, a water baffle, an air supply fan and an air supply outlet in the air inlet direction. Through the solar energy/dry air energy air-water air conditioner, dry air energy is utilized to refrigerate so as to cool the rooms in summer and solar energy is utilized to heat so as to warm the rooms in winter.

title: A solar powered lighting system
abstract: Disclosed is a solar powered lighting system. The lighting system includes a solar module (102) and a lighting module (120). The solar module (102) is adapted to receive solar energy and transform received solar energy into electrical energy. The lighting module (120) electrically coupled to the solar module (102) and emits light using electrical energy generated by the solar module (102) only while the solar module (102) receives solar energy.
