The lighting module (120) including an illumination element having one or more low profile LEDs, being strip LEDs. The solar module (102) and the lighting module (120) are electrically couplable such that light emitted from the lighting module (120) mimics a characteristic of sunlight from which the solar energy is received.

title: SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy system with a plurality of solar panels arranged in a row, wherein there is an innermost and an outermost solar panel, and at least one holding element oriented in the longitudinal direction of the solar energy system, on which the solar panels are held one behind the other and along which the solar panels can be moved by an engagement means from an extended operating position into a retracted protective position and vice versa, wherein adjacent solar panels are connected to one another in an articulated manner, so that a pushing or pulling force can be transmitted from one solar panel to an adjacent solar panel. The outermost and innermost solar panels are pressed against each other in the protective position by a mechanical force, forming a stable package of solar panels that enables the solar panels to protect themselves from the weather.

title: Distributed energy device
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of energy devices, and discloses a distributed energy device. Distributed energy device, the device comprises an energy box, a solar panel, a solar water tank, astorage battery and an induction cooker, the energy box is a rectangular hollow box body; the hollow part of the energy box penetrates through the left and right wall surfaces; a solar panel is fixedly mounted above the energy box; a solar water tank is fixedly mounted on the lower wall surface in the energy box; a storage battery is fixedly mounted on the lower wall surface in the energy box; aninduction cooker is arranged in the energy box; an angle-adjustable solar panel is arranged on the left side of the energy box; a fixing plate is arranged on the right of the energy box; the solar water heater is simple in structure and convenient to carry, solar energy is absorbed and converted into heat energy and electric energy through the two solar panels, clean energy and hot water are provided for camping in the field through the solar water tank, the storage battery and the induction cooker, fuel is prevented from being used, and energy consumption and environmental pollution are greatly reduced.

title: Moving point array solar cooker
abstract: The invention relates to solar energy utilization, in particular to solar energy collection by using a point focusing solar mirror and application of the point focusing solar mirror to a moving point array solar cooker. The moving point array solar cooker at least comprises one or one group of point focusing solar mirrors, at least one solar cooker and a tracking control device for control, wherein the solar mirrors are arranged on a solar mirror support; solar cookers are arranged on a solar cooker support, and are arranged in a punctiform area focused by the solar mirrors and above or below the solar mirrors; and the tracking control device controls the solar mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one solar cooker when the sunlight changes, the solar cookers move in the process that the solar mirrors track solar energy, and each or each group of solar mirrors select the solar cooker capable of reaching the highest solar energy utilization efficiency for focusing, so that the solar energy is tracked, focused and utilized.

title: Solar energy heating stool
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy heating stool which mainly solves the problem that students having a class in the classroom which is not provided with heating equipment sit on cold stools. The solar energy heating stool comprises a stool body, wherein an electrical heating plate is arranged in the top surface of the stool body, one side surface of the stool body is provided with a solar energy solar panel, the side edge of the stool surface of the stool body is provided with a slide switch, and the electrical hating plate is connected with the solar energy solar panel by the slide switch. The solar energy heating stool is heated by the solar energy, is energy-saving, and the environment-friendly.

title: Energy-saving air source heat pump air-conditioning system
abstract: The invention discloses an energy-saving air source heat pump air-conditioning system. The system comprises an air source heat pump system, a solar electricity storage device and a solar heat collector; the air source heat pump system comprises an evaporator, a compressor, an expanding valve, a reversing valve and a condenser; the solar electricity storage device comprises an intelligent switch, a supporting device, a solar panel and a large storage battery; and the supporting device comprises a supporting plate, a bearing plate and bottom supports. According to the system, the solar energy can be fully converted into the electric energy through the solar panel; through the clean and inexhaustible solar energy and air energy, refrigeration can be carried out in summer, and heating can be carried out in winter; the temperature in summer is high, the conversion rate of the solar energy is high, and the electric energy formed by converting the solar energy collected by the solar panel in one day can completely meet the electricity requirements of the air source heat pump air-conditioning system of the day; and the utilization rate of the solar energy in winter is low, but the solar energy of a certain amount can be converted into the electric energy through the solar panel, and therefore the electricity consumption is reduced, and the use cost of consumers is lowered.

title: Solar watch
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar watch, including wrist -watch body, watchband, battery, locking mechanism and solar cover plate, the watchband demountable installation be in on the wrist -watch body, the watchband surface is equipped with solar energy extinction soft board, and can the batching circle or straighten for absorb solar energy and turn into the electric energy and store in the battery, the apron passes through what locking mechanism can open and close installs on the wrist -watch body, the apron is solar cover plate for absorb solar energy and turn into the electric energy andstore in the battery. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the watchband and the solar cover plate that utilize the surface to be provided with solar energy extinction soft board absorb solar energy to store solar energy transformation in the battery for the electric energy, utilize the compliance of solar energy extinction soft board, can the batching circle or straighten to thedifferent state of adaptation has been solved the wrist -watch that charges and influenced by the battery factor, need charge everyday and give people a lot of inconvenient problems of bringing.

title: APPARATUS FOR A PRE-TEMPERATURE ALTERATION FOR AN AUTOMOTIVE
abstract: A alternative energy system for a car is presented. The system has solar panel, the solar panel for harnessing the sun's energy. The solar panel utilizes the solar conversion system to convert and direct the sun's energy into electricity. A car has a solar panel attached to the top of the car and the solar panel supplies energy to the temperature control center of the car.

title: Solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes
abstract: The invention relates to clothes, in particular to solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes. The solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes belong to the technical field of clothes design. The simple solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes are designed by the scheme that energy is mainly provided by the sun to heat, and the back of the clothes is provided with a solar panel. The solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes comprise a heating vest and a jacket with the solar panel, wherein the vest and the solar panel are detachable. The solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes are characterized in that the clothes which are more environmentally friendly are made into the solar energy cell clothes, and the clothes temperature is regulated by the working principle of an electric blanket. The solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes are comfortable and beautiful, have a strong function and are easy to clean. According to the solar energy electric heating thermoregulation intelligent clothes disclosed by the invention, the defect for controlling circuit resistance to achieve a proper temperature in the prior art can be overcome, and more possibility is provided for the clothes heat retention property by the environmentally-friendly solar energy.

title: Testing system of solar energy module and method thereof
abstract: Disclosed are a testing system of solar energy module and a method thereof. The system includes: a horizontal adjustment mechanism for receiving the solar energy module positioned thereon and adjusting inclination of the solar energy module; a light source device for projecting a parallel light beam onto the solar energy module; and a processor electrically connected to the solar energy module for measuring an output power of the solar energy module, wherein the horizontal adjustment mechanism is adjusted for a plurality of times such that the processor measures a plurality of output powers of the solar energy module and the processor determines the maximum one among the plurality of output powers.

title: Solar-wind power generator
abstract: The utility model relates to a power generating device. The prior solar energy and wind energy generating device is simplex, wastes the energies and space which can be utilized at the same time and is not ideal. The utility model provides a solar energy and wind energy generating device which can utilize the solar energy and the wind energy at the same time. The solar energy and wind energy generating device which comprises a wind generating device and a solar energy generating device is characterized in that the utility model is provided with a solar panel which is connected with the top end of the original wind generating device by a sun tracking and rotating telescopic rod, has simple structure, is convenient to be used, can utilize the solar energy and the wind energy at the same time, and has good generating effect.

title: Efficient solar energy cleaning device
abstract: The invention discloses an efficient solar energy cleaning device. The efficient solar energy cleaning device comprises a base, a solar energy bracket device is arranged at the upper portion of the base, a rotating-type solar energy cleaning device is mounted in the solar energy bracket device, a washing cylinder cleaning device is arranged on one side of the solar energy bracket, and the solar energy bracket device is connected with the rotating-type solar energy cleaning device; and through the connection of a screw rod and a sliding seat, the sliding seat is connected with a cleaning cylinder for reciprocating washing, the washing cylinder cleaning device is arranged below one side of the rotating-type solar energy cleaning device, through the connection of a telescopic rod and a washing frame, a brush and a nozzle are arranged in the washing frame for washing the cleaning cylinder, and a control device is arranged on the base. The efficient solar energy cleaning device has the beneficial effects of being simple in structure and high in practicability.

title: Solar bag
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy bag comprising a bag and a solar energy plate; a combining element combined with the solar energy plate is arranged on the bag, the solar energy plate is removably connected on the bag through the combining element. The utility model adds a solar energy battery plate on a conventional bag, so as to satisfy the request for storing money, things and cards, and to have a solar energy charging function. The solar energy battery plate is a soft film solar energy battery piece which is flexile and flectional, the solar energy battery piece is integrated in a hand bag, can be charged as soon as being opened, and can supply power for mini size electric devices (such as: cell phone, MP3, electric torch) or the like, the solar energy battery piece also can be separated from the hand bag to be used solely, thereby the utility model is very suitable for working outside, travel, conference and any locations having no power supply.

title: Solar landscape lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar lamp technical field discloses a solar landscape lamp, including the lamp stand, be equipped with the lamp pole on the lamp stand, be equipped with the solar energy electroplax on the lamp pole, solar energy electroplax electricity is connected with the battery, and electrical connections battery has the fluorescent tube, still includes control system, the electric connection between control system and the solar energy electroplax, be equipped with the recess on the lamp pole, the solar energy electroplax lies in the recess, and control system is used for controlling the solar energy electroplax and slides in the recess. Through the utility model discloses the flexible of solar energy electroplax can be realized, the erosion of wind and rain to the solar energy electroplax is reduced.

title: Solar energy wind energy activity board house
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy wind energy prefab houses, including the room body, wind energy collection device, a solar panel, the 2nd solar panel and rotatory solar panel, room body top is equipped with wind energy collection device and rotatory solar panel, first organic toughened glass cover is equipped with in the rotatory solar panel outside, rotatory solar panel is connected with the rotation axis, a solar panel is equipped with on room body right side, a solar panel is equipped with in the outside the organic toughened glass of second cover, room sinistron side is equipped with the 2nd solar panel, the 2nd solar panel is equipped with in the outside the organic toughened glass of third cover, the internal portion in room is equipped with door and ventilator, the internal portion in room also is equipped with storage battery plant, the storage battery plant outside is equipped with dampproofing anti-corrosion coating, the utility model discloses simple structure, convenient operation, the more effectual resource that possess at one's side of having utilized, wind energy collection device solve unavailability in evening solar energy power generation and the power failure phenomenon that causes, not only energy-conservation but also environmental protection.

title: Wind energy and solar energy generator
abstract: The invention relates to a wind energy and solar energy generator. The wind energy and solar energy power generation technology is adopted to overcome the problem of singleness of existing wind energy and solar energy power generation, the properties of wind energy and solar energy are sufficiently utilized, and the two natural energy sources are adopted to supply power in a complementary way. The generator has the advantages that the power generation cost is reduced, and the economic benefit is improved; the generator is suitable for generating power in various areas.

title: Solar photovoltaic spot light subassembly
abstract: The invention relates to a light utilization technology of the solar energy photovoltaic assembly, specifically to a solar energy photovoltaic concentrating assembly. The solar energy photovoltaic concentrating assembly of the invention comprises a frame, a plurality of solar cell sheets mounted on the frame. A holding space is arranged between each pair of solar cell sheets. The holding space is provided with a reflecting mirror with a section in an isoceles triangle shape. The invention is simple in structure, easy to produce and mount. By adopting the reflecting mirror to concentrate light, the invention improves the solar luminous energy received on unit area solar energy cell to a great extend, which improves generated energy of unit area solar energy cell to a great extend and improves generating efficiency of the solar cell.

title: Stereo type solar energy and sound energy absorbing and switching device
abstract: The utility model provides a stereo type solar energy and sound energy absorbing and switching device, comprising a base seat, a solar energy absorbing switcher, a sound energy absorbing switcher, an accumulator and an execution device, wherein the base seat is a stereo shape; the solar energy absorbing switcher, the sound energy absorbing switcher, the accumulator and the execution device are mounted on the base seat; the solar energy absorbing switcher and the sound energy absorbing switcher are connected with the accumulator and used for absorbing the solar energy or the sound energy and switching the energy into electric energy; the accumulator supplies the power for the execution device. The beneficial effects are that: the solar energy absorbing switcher and the sound energy absorbing switcher are arranged in the urban district or sightseeing place, the attractive appearance is realized, the solar energy and the sound energy absorbed in the daytime is used and then converted into the electric energy and the electric energy is used at the night for lighting or playing the music, advertisement, broadcast or special data.

title: Solar energy electric energy combined hot water bathing system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy electric energy combined hot water bathing system. The solar energy electric energy combined hot water bathing system is utilized, when solar energy is sufficient, cold water is heated by a solar water heater, the solar water heater inputs hot water into an intelligent electric water heater for temperature regulation and mixing and then the hot water is conveyed to a shower for bathing use, at the moment, the intelligent electric water heater does not need to be electrically heated, and if the solar energy is insufficient, the intelligent electric waterheater heats the cold water and temperature regulation and then the heated water is conveyed to the shower for bathing use. Therefore, solar energy can be fully utilized, and it is guaranteed that hotwater supply is sufficient and convenient; the solar energy electric energy combined hot water bathing system has the functions of solar energy hot water and electric energy hot water, is energy-saving and environment-friendly, and is convenient to use.

title: Solar energy and air energy heat pump complementary winter heating system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy and air energy heat pump complementary winter heating system which comprises a cold water source, a hot water tank, a caliduct, a solar heating circuit and an air energy heat pump heating circuit. The caliduct, the solar heating circuit and the air energy heat pump heating circuit are connected with the hot water tank. The solar heating circuit comprises a first solar caliduct, a solar heat collection panel, a second solar caliduct and a third solar caliduct. A first circulating pump and a third valve are connected to the second solar caliduct. A second circulating pump and a fourth valve are connected to the third solar caliduct. The air energy heat pump heating circuit comprises an air energy heat pump, a first air energy heat pump caliduct and a second air energy heat pump caliduct. A second valve is connected to the first air energy heat pump caliduct, and a first valve is connected to the second air energy heat pump caliduct. The solar energy and air energy heat pump complementary winter heating system is novel and reasonable in design, convenient and rapid to use and operate, capable of fully utilizing solar energy, good in family energy conservation and consumption reduction effect, high in practicability and convenient to popularize and use.

title: Electric actuating mechanism based on solar energy
abstract: The utility model relates to an electric actuating mechanism based on solar energy. The electric actuating mechanism based on solar energy comprises a solar cell panel, a solar controller and a storage battery, wherein the solar controller is respectively connected with the solar cell panel, the storage battery and the inverter, the solar controller is used for controlling the solar cell panel tocharge the storage battery and is also used for controlling the storage battery to supply power to the inverter, the electric actuating mechanism comprises a motor, and the inverter is electrically connected with the motor. During use, the solar cell panel converts solar energy into electric energy, and the solar controller stores the electric energy into the storage battery. The solar controllerfurther controls the storage battery to provide band energy for the inverter, and the inverter converts the direct current into alternating current, provides electric energy for the electric actuatingmechanism and drives the electric actuating mechanism to rotate. The electric actuating mechanism can be powered by solar energy and is applicable to remote areas without electricity, and the application range of the electric actuating mechanism is greatly widened.

title: Utilize two source floor heating device of magnetic energy, solar energy
abstract: The utility model provides an utilize two source floor heating device of magnetic energy, solar energy, it is including installing at outdoor solar energy heating device and installing at indoor magnetic energy heating device and floor heating device, solar energy heating device includes solar panel, solar energy power generation ware, battery, heating device and support, solar panel installs on the support, the solar energy power generation ware sets up under the solar panel, too can the board the solar energy power generation ware battery, heating device electricity in proper order connect,magnetic energy heating device includes cavity heating pipe, first lid, second lid, sleeve pipe and centers on the solenoid that the sheathed tube outer wall set up, floor heating device include the water storage box and with the floor heating pipe of water storage box intercommunication, the water storage box respectively with magnetic energy heating device the solar energy heating device intercommunication. This utilize two source floor heating device of magnetic energy, solar energy have by the nature high, the advantage that can use in all weather.

title: Regenerated energy circulator
abstract: The utility model relates to a renewable energy circulator, which belongs to the solar energy generating set field, and mainly solves the problem that the solar energy generating set must have a solar panel. The renewable energy circulator comprises a solar energy heat collection component, a sun tracking control component, a biologic energy heat furnace, an engine component and a base seat frame having the adjusting function, the upper end of the base seat frame is moveably connected with a solar energy control component, and the upper end of the solar energy control component is connected with the solar energy heat collection component. The renewable energy circulator has the functional effects of power generation without the solar energy photovoltaic battery plate, simple generation procedure, wide application range, low generating cost, sustainable and circulating power generation and environmental protection.

title: Intelligent solar street lamp
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent solar street lamp. The intelligent solar street lamp comprises a solar energy box, an illumination adjusting mechanism is arranged on the upper end face of the solar energy box, and comprises five supporting rods which are uniformly distributed, the supporting rods are fixedly connected with the upper end face of the solar energy box, the upper ends of the supporting rods are fixedly provided with mirror frames, the mirror frames are internally provided with mirror grooves running through the mirror frames, convex lenses are embedded in the mirror grooves, a working cavity is formed in the solar energy box, and the upper end face of the solar energy box is provided with five expansion grooves with upward openings. The intelligent solar street lamp issimple in structure and convenient to use; a solar energy mechanism is added on the basis of the street lamp, a green energy source such as solar energy is utilized and is more environmentally friendly, the position of a solar panel can be automatically adjusted along with movement of the sun, thus the solar energy is better absorbed, the absorbing efficiency is improved, and the solar street lampis intelligentized as a whole.

title: Solar intelligent comprehensive utilization structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar intelligent comprehensive utilization structure, which comprises a building, a solar panel and a converting circuit, wherein, the solar panel is arranged on the outer surface with good illumination and daylighting conditions of the building; and electrical energy generated by the solar panel is converted by the converting circuit and then is output and utilized. The utility model provides a solar intelligent electric vehicle charging pole for the building, wherein, the charging pole takes the solar energy as an energy source and has the advantages of environmental protection, economy, low cost and the like; redundant electrical energy can also be stored in an energy storage battery unit; and the converting circuit can be utilized to convert the electrical energy stored in the energy storage battery unit so as to charge an electric vehicle and the like when no solar energy is irradiated. Meanwhile, the solar energy is absorbed by the solar panel, so that the consumed electrical energy caused by temperature reduction in summer can be reduced.

title: Solar energy system, and levelling element, and insulating layer for use in a solar energy system
abstract: Solar energy systems are used, for example, to heat water. A known solar energy system is composed of a plurality of foil layers. A drawback of such a solar energy system is that it does not function properly unless the foundation (base) is level. A solar energy system according to the invention comprises a levelling element for positioning the solar energy system so that it is level.

title: Solar energy basket of electric car
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy basket of an electric car. The solar energy basket is provided with solar light panels which can convert solar energy into electric energy so as to save resources. The solar light panels are fixed on the periphery of the electric car solar basket. When a power wire under the basket is inserted in a battery of an electric car, the purpose of charging is realized. The solar energy basket of the electric car is attractive and does not occupy space.

title: Standby power supply device
abstract: The invention provides a standby power supply device, which comprises a solar energy acquisition module, a solar light following module, an energy storage battery, an inverter and a load module, the solar energy acquisition module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the solar light following module is used for automatically adjusting the angle of the solar collection module according to the position of the sun; the energy storage battery is used for storing electric power generated by the solar energy acquisition module; the input end of the inverter is connected with the energy storage battery, the output end of the inverter is connected with the load module, and the inverter is used for supplying power to the load module through the energy storage battery.

title: Solar energy electric power storage battery
abstract: The present utility model discloses a storage battery, especially a solar energy electric power storage battery. The solar energy electric power storage battery comprises a storage battery body and a storage battery. The solar energy electric power storage battery is characterized in that the storage battery is arranged inside the storage battery body, a solar cell panel is arranged on the top part of the storage battery body, a solar energy luminous energy plate is arranged above the solar cell panel, a switching control switch is arranged on the bottom part of the storage battery body, and the storage battery, the solar cell panel and the solar energy luminous energy plate are made integrally.

title: Solar energy fusion and convergence panel
abstract: The present invention provides a solar energy fusion panel capable of using photovoltaic energy and solar thermal energy together at a low cost within a limited area. To this end, the solar energy fusion panel for using the photovoltaic energy and the solar thermal energy together comprises: a hollow box-shaped external body having an upper opening unit; a solar cell plate provided in the external body, converting the photovoltaic energy transferred through the upper opening unit into electric energy and heated by the solar thermal energy; and a heat absorption water supply unit provided in a lower space between the solar cell plate and an inner bottom surface of the external body, absorbing heat of the heated solar cell plate and heating water with the absorbed heat to supply the water.

title: Electronic device capable of increasing solar energy generating efficiency
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic device capable of increasing solar energy generating efficiency, comprising a device body and a reflecting piece, wherein the device body comprises an operation module and a solar energy board, the solar energy board is connected with the operation module and is used for converting optical energy into electric energy, and the reflecting piece is connected to the device body and corresponds to the solar energy board to reflect ray to the solar energy board.

title: Solar-energy mine lamp cap
abstract: The utility model provides a solar-energy mine lamp cap comprising a solar energy panel, a solar battery set and a lamp holder set, characterized in that: a housing of the mine lamp cap is the solar energy panel, the solar battery is strip-shaped and clamped in the mine lamp cap, and the solar battery set is connected with the lamp holder set. By using the solar energy as power source, the solar-energy mine lamp cap of the utility model has the advantages of small size, light weight, convenient carrying and comfortable wear.

title: Solar charging system and solar controller
abstract: The invention discloses a solar charging system and a solar controller, the system is applied to a new energy automobile, and the system comprises a photovoltaic panel, the solar controller and a power battery; the photovoltaic panel is connected with the input end of the solar controller, and the output end of the solar controller is connected with the input end of the power battery; the photovoltaic panel is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the solar controller is used for boosting the output voltage of the photovoltaic panel into the charging voltage of the power battery; and the power battery is used for supplying power to a driving motor of the new energy automobile. Therefore, according to the solar charging system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the power battery of the new energy automobile can be directly charged by utilizing solar energy through the photovoltaic panel and the solar controller. Due to the fact that other charging equipment such as a charging pile is not needed in the process of charging the power battery of the new energy automobile through solar energy, the dependence of the new energy automobile on the charging pile can be reduced, and the endurance mileage of the new energy automobile is increased.

title: Building-integrated water container heat collection type solar energy utilization method
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy utilization method which adopts a heat-collecting water tank integrated with the building and belongs to the solar energy utilization field. The solar energy heat-collecting device is integrated with the inclined roof, wall body or balcony retaining plate of the building to a whole; the cost is reduced greatly while the solar energy is utilized to the maximum limit; the heat-collecting pipe heat-collecting mode is replaced by the water tank heat-collecting mode to improve the solar energy utilization rate while the cost is reduced and the heat-collecting area is increased; the water storage tank is arranged in the room to reduce the heat loss when the water tank is arranged outside and improve the solar energy utilization rate while the manufacturing cost of the water tank is reduced; the solar energy utilization method not only can utilize the solar energy to supply hot water, but also can utilize the solar energy for heating and is a significant breakthrough and innovation on the solar energy utilization aspect.

title: Solar energy charging system
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy charging system. The solar energy charging system comprises a charging module integrated with a DC bus, and a conversion module, wherein electric energy generated by a solar energy panel is inputted to the charging module after being converted, and the energy generated by the solar energy panel is supplied to a charging load through the conversion module and the integrated DC bus. Compared with a scheme of converting electric energy generated from solar energy to a power supply grid through a complex inverter, the solar energy charging system has advantages of low cost and high electric energy conversion efficiency.

title: Solar plate assembly for electric torch
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy plate assembly for an electric torch, which comprises a cover plate, and the cover plate is connected with a solar energy plate, wherein the lower surface of the cover plate is also connected with a bracket. Sealing rings are fixed in a groove and an embedded groove on the edge of the lower surface of the cover plate, and thus the bracket can be connected to the cover plate on the lower surface of the solar energy plate. Thus sealability between the transparent cover plate and a torch body of an electric torch is good, and rain water and moisture can not leak and permeate into the electric torch to influence the normal work of the solar energy plate. In addition, the solar energy plate is clamped between the cover plate and the bracket, and thus the solar energy plate is protected by the bracket from damage, and the connection and the fixation of the solar energy plate are firm. Even if the electric torch is fallen on the ground, the solar energy plate assembly can not be disengaged from the electric torch. Thus work of the solar energy plate is stable, and the service life is prolonged. The solar energy plate assembly is suitable for being arranged on various solar energy electric torches of different shapes and structures.

title: Novel solar energy window
abstract: The utility model discloses a novel solar energy window, including solar energy window body, solar energy window body on be provided with solar energy component, solar energy window body's below be provided with the electric energy recess, the electric energy recess on be provided with storage battery, solar energy component on be provided with waterproof layer, solar energy window body's upper portion be provided with the light harvesting board, storage battery's lower extreme be provided with the steady voltage output, its simple structure, convenient to use, easy operation, simple manufacture, energy -concerving and environment -protective, waterproof, service life is long, supplies the daily use of nuclear family, reduces power consumption.

title: A MOLECULAR SOLAR THERMAL (MOST) SYSTEM FOR LONG-TERM STORAGE OF SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: The present invention relates to a molecular solar thermal system (MOST) based on a pair of isomers, comprising in its low energy ground stage primarily a first low-energy isomer which is excitable by solar light to form a metastable high-energy isomer and in its high energy state primarily a second metastable high energy photoisomer generated via photochemical conversion from the solar light excitable first isomer. Said MOST system is characterized by high photo isomerization yields due to the light driven out-of-equilibrium isomerization of the first isomer and is further characterized by a superior thermal stability of the second high energy photo isomer. This allows a long-term storage of collected solar light energy without occurrence of spontaneous unwanted back-isomerization. By applying a particular class of, optionally immobilized, strong basic catalysts, the stored solar energy is released in a controlled manner in a catalytic thermalback reaction to yield the low energy first isomer. This offers the possibility of establishing a cyclic process for repeatedly converting solar light energy into thermal energy. The present invention also provides methods of storing solar thermal energy, methods of releasing stored solar thermal energy, methods of reversibly storing solar thermal energy as well as particular solar thermal energy storage devices comprising the use of the above mentioned MOST pair of photoisomers. The present invention also relates to the use of such compounds for the reversible storing of solar energy. Further aspects of the present invention relate to a solar thermal energy capture device, a combined device for capturing solar thermal energy and solar photoelectric energy, as well as a device for operating a reversible MOST system of the present invention. In addition, the present invention relates to particular novel low and high energy photoisomers applicable in a MOST system of the invention.

title: Solar energy chip packaging part and have vehicle of this solar energy chip packaging part
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy chip packaging part and the vehicle that has the solar energy chip packaging part. The solar energy chip packaging part is fit for being applied to installation base surface, and the solar energy chip packaging part includes protection shield, solar energy chip and limiting rubber circle, wherein, the limiting rubber circle fixed connection be in near edgeof protection shield below, installation base surface has first surface and sunken second surface, solar energy chip bonds on installation base surface's the second surface, and the protection shieldis installed under the state of solar energy chip top the protection shield with the interval has between the solar energy chip.

title: Solar energy table lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a lamp, in particular to a solar energy table lamp. The solar energy table lamp comprises a table lamp and is characterized in that the power supply of the table lamp is connected to a storage battery, the storage battery is connected with a solar energy collection plate, and a support is arranged at the back of the solar energy collection plate. The solar energy table lamp provided by the utility model has the benefits as follows: the solar energy table lamp is directly used for bed-room lighting, and other energy sources can be saved.

title: Solar energy heat collection water tank with luminous identification
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy heat collection water tank with luminous identification. The solar energy heat collection water tank comprises an outer barrel (1), an inner barrel, a heat-preservation layer, a solar energy battery (2), a light-emitting diode (LED) lamp assembly (3) and a storage battery. The solar energy heat collection water tank is characterized in that the outer barrel (1) is made of colorful steel plates or stainless steel plates, identification patterns are arranged on the outer barrel (1) in a hollowed-out mode, epoxy resin is used for filling the hollowed-out portions, the LED lamp assembly (3) is embedded into the surface of the heat-preservation layer of the inner side of the hollowed-out identification, the solar energy battery (2) is a flexible film solar energy battery or a silicon solar energy battery, the solar energy battery (2) is fixed on the surface of the outer barrel (1), and the storage battery is fixed on the inner side of an end cover of the outer barrel (1). A solar energy battery board and LED luminous characters can be decorated on the solar energy heat collection water tank harmoniously, so that the solar energy heat collection water tank can form a whole, and aesthetic effect of a solar energy water heater is improved.

title: Wind energy and solar energy complementary electric automobile
abstract: The invention relates to a wind energy and solar energy complementary electric automobile, comprising a wind energy generator, a charging storage battery and a solar energy power supply unit with a solar panel, wherein a wind energy and solar energy complementary storage battery is connected with a solar cell of the solar energy power supply unit, the wind energy generator, and a storage battery charging and power supply program control device; the storage battery charging and power supply program control device is electrically connected with the charging storage battery; and the solar energypower supply unit and the wind energy generator which are arranged on an expandable link can be collected in the body of the electric automobile. In the invention, compared with prior art, the natural whether resources of wind energy and solar energy are fully utilized as energy of the electric automobile, power supply program is controlled by a complementary storage battery and a program-controldevice to realize natural resource utilization maximization, and solar energy and wind energy complementary utilization is good for improving continuity and stability of the power supply of the electric automobile.

title: Energy gathering type solar water heater
abstract: The utility model relates to an energy cumulating type solar water heater which comprises a solar energy cumulating structure. The solar energy cumulating structure comprises a plurality of pellet lenses which are combined and connected into a two-dimension matrix structure, and the solar energy cumulating structure is also assembled on the top surface of a flume. The energy cumulating type solar water heater is a device which can raise water temperature by utilizing the solar energy cumulating structure, the solar energy cumulating structure can receive sun incoming rays from any position and transmit and focus collected light beams in the water inside the flume positioned under the solar energy cumulating structure, and the collected light beams are focused to collect heat energy so as to raise the water temperature.

title: Apparatus is worn to solar charging formula
abstract: The utility model discloses an apparatus is worn to solar charging formula, including the cap shell, the cap shell includes bottom buffer layer and solar energy absorbed layer that from interior to exterior set gradually, the solar energy absorbed layer is connected with conversion input connection line, conversion input connection line connection has solar converter, the last detachably of solarconverter pegs graft there is the data line, the data line is pegged graft with electronic equipment, carry out the collection of heat energy and light energy with solar energy through the solar energy absorbed layer, solar converter turns into the electric energy with solar radiation, and electronic equipment is connected with solar converter through the data line and charges, the solar energy ofreceiving head -mounted apparatus has carried out abundant utilization, and the clean energy environmental protection is pollution -free, and whole solar energy absorbs with the part of conversion for a short time, and light in weight can not increase the heavy burden for the user, and convenience of customers carries and uses.

title: METHODS FOR ORIENTATION AND TILT IDENTIFICATION OF PHOTOVOLTAIC SYSTEMS AND SOLAR IRRADIANCE SENSORS
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and systems for identifying PV system and solar irradiance sensor orientation and tilt based on energy production, energy received, simulated energy production, estimated energy received, production skew, and energy received skew. The present invention relates to systems and methods for detecting orientation and tilt of a PV system based on energy production and simulated energy production; for detecting the orientation and tilt of a solar irradiance sensor based on solar irradiance observation and simulated solar irradiance observation; for detecting orientation of a PV system based on energy production and energy production skew; and for detecting orientation of a solar irradiance sensor based on solar irradiance observation and solar irradiance observation skew.

title: Solar corridor low-carbon energy-saving lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar corridor low-carbon energy-saving lamp, which comprises a switch, a low-carbon energy-saving lamp, an electricity storage device and a solar panel, and is characterized in that: the solar panel is arranged outdoors to be used for absorbing solar energy and is sequentially and electrically connected with the electricity storage device and the low-carbon energy-saving lamp, and the electricity storage device receives and stores solar energy absorbed by the solar panel, and simultaneously supplies electric energy to the low-carbon energy-saving lamp; and the low-carbon energy-saving lamp is arranged in a corridor and is turned on or off by the switch. During the day, the solar panel of the solar corridor low-carbon energy-saving lamp absorbs solar energy and is in an electricity storage state, accordingly, in a dark environment, the electricity storage device can supply electric energy, so that the low-carbon energy-saving lamp emits light to illuminate the corridor, and thus the low-carbon and energy-saving purposes are achieved, and the environment protection, low-carbon and energy saving are fully realized.

title: Combination formula solar array device of convenient transportation
abstract: The utility model relates to a combination formula solar array device of convenient transportation is refered in particular to in group battery equipment field, and it includes square base, and this square base upper surface is provided with first solar energy electroplax, and this first solar energy electroplax articulates respectively all around has second solar energy electroplax, third solar energy electroplax, fourth solar energy electroplax, the 5th solar energy electroplax, the bottom surface middle part of square base is provided with the connection square column, it is provided with draw -in groove A, draw -in groove B, draw -in groove C and draw -in groove D respectively in four side middle parts all around to connect the square column, the back middle part of second solar energy electroplax, third solar energy electroplax, fourth solar energy electroplax, the 5th solar energy electroplax is provided with support A, support B, support C, support D respectively, it has simple structure, and is with low costs, and folding back solar energy electroplax area is little, and occupation space is little, and advantages such as cost of transportation have greatly been practiced thrift in convenient transportation.

title: Solar energy storage heat pump system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy storage heat pump system. The system comprises an air energy using system and a solar energy using system, wherein the air energy using system is composed of a compressor, a heating heat exchanger, a reservoir, a first throttling element and an air energy evaporator, the solar energy using system is composed of an energy storage tank, a circulating pump and a solar heat collection module, and a solar evaporator is further arranged in the energy storage tank; the solar evaporator is connected to the air energy using system through a pipeline, and a serial loop is formed by the solar energy evaporator and the air energy evaporation through a first defrosting branch and a second defrosting branch. According to the solar energy storage heat pump system, the air energy evaporator and the solar evaporator are serially utilized through the first defrosting branch and the second defrosting branch, so that a defrosting aim can be achieved; furthermore, the heat pump can supply heat in the process of defrosting, so that the heat pump is not needed to reversely work frequently; in addition, under the condition of lacking the solar energy, the heat pump system can regularly work by using the air energy evaporator and the auxiliary heater.

title: Solar electrodeless road lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar electrodeless street lamp, which comprises a solar panel, a charge current controller, an electric energy accumulator, an inversion converter and a lamp load, wherein, the solar panel is connected with the charge current controller, and is used for converting solar radiation into electric energy; the charge current controller is used for conveying and storing the electric energy of the solar panel into the electric energy accumulator, and isolating an industrial power supply and the electric energy stored in the electric energy accumulator in order to prevent the industrial power supply and the electric energy from being conveyed back to the solar panel; and the electric energy accumulator is used for storing the electric energy. The electric energy accumulator, the solar panel and the charge current controller form an electric transmission loop, and the inversion converter, the electric energy accumulator and the lamp load form another loop, wherein, the inversion converter is used for converting direct current of the solar panel or the electric energy accumulator into alternating current with standard voltage, and charging the lamp load. The utility model organically combines solar energy with the industrial power supply, fully utilizes the solar energy, and has the advantages of environmental protection and energy saving.

title: Solar energy refrigerator
abstract: A solar energy refrigerator comprises a bracket, a refrigerator machine body, a direct current compressor, an energy storage device and two solar cell panels. The solar cell panels, the energy storagedevice, the direct current compressor and the refrigerator machine body are electrically connected in sequence, electric energy obtained through photovoltaic conversion of collected solar energy is stored in the energy storage device by the solar cell panels, and electric energy required for operation of the direct current compressor is transmitted to the direct current compressor by the solar cell panels. The energy storage device uses a high-performance lithium ion battery, one of the two solar cell panels is mounted on the top of the refrigerator machine body, the other solar cell panel ismounted on the side face of the refrigerator machine body, the two solar cell panels are efficient monocrystalline silicon solar cell panels, therefore, the solar energy refrigerator has the advantages of being efficient in light conversion, high in energy storage density, small in size, high in cruising ability, easy to carry, high in weatherability and the like.

title: HEATING SYSTEM BY SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: PURPOSE: A heating system by solar energy is provided to improve efficiency of solar energy by installing a solar energy heating plate, a distribution pipe, a heat storage tank and a boiler. CONSTITUTION: A heating system by solar energy comprises a solar energy heating circuit, a room heating circuit and a heat storage circuit. The solar energy heating circuit heats the fluid, discharged from the supply distribution pipe(20), by using a solar energy heating plate(10). The solar energy heating circuit returns to a recollecting distribution pipe(21). The room heating circuit returns to the recollecting distribution pipe or the supply distribution pipe. An electric valve(22) is installed on the place where three strands of a pipe meet with the recollecting distribution pipe.

title: Solar energy curtain
abstract: The solar energy curtain in the utility model belongs to the field of daily use articles and relates to a solar energy curtain. The solar energy curtain in the utility model includes a blinds curtain body. The blinds curtain body includes a plurality of vertical blades equipped with solar cell panel strips which are parallel to the blades. A storage battery is disposed on the top of the blinds curtain body. The solar cell panel strips connect with the storage battery through guide lines. The solar energy curtain in the utility model has advantages of simple structure, convenient usage and no energy consumption. The solar energy curtain in the utility model can not only convert solar energy into electric energy to storage, but also perform the function of a blinds curtain.

title: DEVICES AND METHODS FOR INCREASING SOLAR HYDROGEN CONVERSION EFFICIENCY IN PHOTOVOLTAIC ELECTROLYSIS
abstract: Devices and methods for photovoltaic electrolysis are disclosed. A device comprises a photovoltaic cell element and an electrolysis compartment. The photovoltaic cell element is configured to convert a portion of solar energy into electrical energy and to pass another portion of the solar energy. The electrolysis compartment includes an aqueous electrolyte positioned to receive the other portion of the solar energy and electrodes electrically connected to receive the electrical energy produced by the photovoltaic cell element. A method comprises receiving solar energy with a photovoltaic cell element, converting a portion of the solar energy into electrical energy, passing another portion of the solar energy through the photovoltaic cell element, receiving with an aqueous electrolyte the other portion of the solar energy, transmitting the electrical energy generated by the photovoltaic cell element to a pair of electrodes, and electrolyzing the aqueous electrolyte with the pair of electrodes.

title: Method and system for simultaneously charging an energy storage device from multiple energy input devices
abstract: A system for simultaneously charging an energy storage device from multiple energy input devices includes energy input devices in the form of solar and non-solar modules and an energy storage device in the form of a rechargeable battery, which is part of an energy storage module. A first solar module is able to generate solar power and delivers this power to the energy storage module, while the non-solar module delivers, for example, electrochemically generated electricity to the energy storage module via the first solar module, which acts as a backplane. The system may also include additional solar modules that can be connected to the first solar module in collapsed or expanded states to adjust the amount of electricity generated from solar power.

title: Vehicle-mounted solar power generation, power supply and charging system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of vehicle-mounted solar power generation, power supply and charging, and particularly relates to a vehicle-mounted solar power generation, power supply and charging system. The method comprises the steps that a vehicle data collector collects operation attribute parameters of a vehicle; vehicle-related data are displayed on the vehicle data display screen, light energy is better absorbed by the vehicle-mounted solar panel through the solar energy adjusting module on the electric vehicle, the light energy is converted into electric energy through the light energy converter, and the electric energy is stored in the storage battery; the solar energy operation memory database records all data records of solar energy applied by the vehicle; according to solar energy, other important aspects of absorbing light energy by the solar energy are considered, more data are considered for charging of the electric vehicle, vehicle-mounted solar energy data are reserved, and potential risks caused by charging of the electric vehicle are eliminated.

title: Control system for use in a solar energy device and a solar tracking device
abstract: A control system for use in a solar energy device and a solar tracking device is provided. The solar energy device located at a first position has a solar energy panel and an actuating module. The solar tracking device is located at a second position. The control system comprises a climatic sensing device and a server. The climatic sensing device senses climatic status to generate a plurality of sensing signals. When receiving the sensing signals, the server electrically connected to the solar tracking device, the climatic sensing device, and the actuating module of the solar energy device generates a control signal according to the sensing signals. The control signal is transmitted to the solar tracking device or the actuating module of the solar energy device to enable the solar tracking device or the actuating module of the solar energy device.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR SIMULTANEOUSLY CHARGING AN ENERGY STORAGE DEVICE FROM MULTIPLE ENERGY INPUT DEVICES
abstract: A system for simultaneously charging an energy storage device from multiple energy input devices includes energy input devices in the form of solar and non-solar modules and an energy storage device in the form of a rechargeable battery, which is part of an energy storage module. A first solar module is able to generate solar power and delivers this power to the energy storage module, while the non-solar module delivers, for example, electrochemically generated electricity to the energy storage module via the first solar module, which acts as a backplane. The system may also include additional solar modules that can be connected to the first solar module in collapsed or expanded states to adjust the amount of electricity generated from solar power.

title: Solar energy and electric energy clock
abstract: The utility model discloses a clock, in particular to a solar energy and electric energy clock. The solar energy and electric energy comprises a clock body and an electric storage device, and is characterized in that the electric storage device is mounted in the clock body, a coiled lead is connected below the electric storage device, a solar panel is mounted at the tail end of the coiled lead, a swivel sucker is mounted at the rear part of the solar panel, and the clock body, the electric storage device and the coiled lead are integrally manufactured.

title: Hidden solar mobile power supply
abstract: The utility model relates to a hidden solar energy mobile power supply, comprising a power supply main body, a solar energy assembly and a rotating shaft assembly, the power supply main body comprises a power supply housing, the solar energy assembly comprises a solar energy installation housing and a plurality of solar energy charging members, and the plurality of solar energy charging members are respectively installed on the power supply housing and the solar energy installation housing. The rotating shaft assembly comprises a plurality of rotating shaft parts, the power supply shell and the solar energy mounting shell are rotatably and foldably mounted together through one corresponding rotating shaft part, each rotating shaft part comprises a rotating shaft upper part and a rotating shaft lower part, and the connecting side edges of the power supply shell and the solar energy mounting shell are respectively provided with an axis; the axis is clamped between the two ends of the rotating shaft upper part and the rotating shaft lower part. A plurality of solar panels are respectively arranged on the power supply main body and the solar energy mounting shell, and the solar energy assembly is rotatably arranged on the power supply main body through the rotating shaft piece, so that folding and hidden installation of the solar energy assembly is realized.

title: Energy power generation device with solar energy and hydrogen energy adjusted and utilized mutually
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy and hydrogen energy mutual adjustment and utilization energy power generation device which comprises a solar energy collection device, hydrogen energy powergeneration equipment is arranged on one side of the solar energy collection device, and an output line and an adapter line are arranged between the solar energy collection device and the hydrogen energy power generation equipment. title: Solar energy and piezoelectricity hybrid power generation floor
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy and piezoelectricity hybrid power generation floor. The solar energy and piezoelectricity hybrid power generation floor is composed of a solar power generation module, a supporting module, a piezoelectric power generation module and a protective device box. The solar power generation module, the supporting module and the piezoelectric power generation are sequentially arranged in the protective device box from top to bottom. The protective device box is composed of protective faces, an external connection port and an insertion groove. The solar power generation module converts solar energy radiated on the solar power generation module into electric energy, the supporting module is used for supporting the solar power generation module and transmitting treading kinetic energy acting on the solar power generation module to the piezoelectric power generation module, and then the piezoelectric power generation module converts the treading kinetic energy into electric energy. The electric energy generated by the solar power generation module and the piezoelectric power generation module is output through the external connection port. The solar power generation technology and the piezoelectric power generation technology are integrated, and the solar energy and piezoelectricity hybrid power generation floor can generate power by using both the solar energy and vibration energy.

title: Solar-energy-based hybrid energy warmer
abstract: The invention discloses a solar-energy-based hybrid energy warmer. The solar-energy-based hybrid energy warmer comprises a warmer, a solar system, an energy storage system, an energy complementary system and a hybrid energy control system, wherein the warmer comprises a furnace body, a panel, a circuit board and a heating component; a heating zone is arranged on the panel, is arranged corresponding to the heating component, and is located above the heating component; the heating component comprises a metal shell, ceramic heating fins and a ceramic heat storage body; the solar system is used for converting solar energy to electric energy to provide electric energy for the warmer; the energy storage system is used for storing electric energy and is connected with the solar system; the energy complementary system is used for providing electric energy for the warmer when the capacity of the energy storage system is insufficient; the hybrid energy control system is used for providing electricity for the warmer and the energy storage system utilizing the solar system when the solar system works normally, and providing electricity for the warmer utilizing the energy storage system when the solar system does not work normally; when the discharge capacity of the energy storage system is lower than a preset value, electricity is provided for the warmer by utilizing the energy complementary system; and when normal work of the solar system is recovered, the energy complementary system stops providing electricity for the warmer.

title: Solar energy thermal insulation bench
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy thermal insulation bench. The solar energy thermal insulation bench comprises a solar cell panel, a solar energy storage battery, an electric heating wire pad, a temperature sensor switch and a timing switch. The solar energy thermal insulation bench is characterized in that the solar cell panel is fixedly installed on a bench back, the solar energy storage battery is fixedly installed directly under the bench seat, and is connected with the solar cell panel through a wire, the electric heating wire pad is placed above the bench seat, and is connected with the solar energy storage battery through a wire, the temperature sensor switch is installed in the joint of the back and the seat, the timing switch is installed on the solar energy storage battery, all-day heating is not needed, and heating is aimed to specific dense population periods. The solar energy thermal insulation bench can be applied in outdoor places equipped with benches of parks, bus stations, squares and the like. The solar energy thermal insulation bench prevents people from catching cold when people rest outdoors aimed to autumn and winter. Solar energy is employed for heating and belongs to clean environmental protection energy, the environment is protected and convenience is provided for people life.

title: Solar energy rotation globe
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy rotation globe. According to the solar energy rotation globe, green energy resource characteristics of a thin film solar cell is utilized, the luminous energy is converted into the electric energy to drive drives the globe to produce a rotation effect.

title: Cooling system for photovoltaic water pump
abstract: The utility model relates to a cooling system for a photovoltaic water pump, which comprises a solar energy photovoltaic array, a solar energy battery cooling plate, a DC/DC converter, a charging and discharging controller, a DC/AC converter, an energy storage device, a photovoltaic water pump, a three-way valve, a water pipe and a water storage device. The solar energy battery cooling plate is fixed on the back surface of the solar energy photovoltaic array; the solar energy photovoltaic array is connected with the driving photovoltaic water pump through the DC/AC converter; water for the operation of the photovoltaic water pump are respectively stored in the water storage device through the three-way valve and the water pipe, and flows into the solar energy battery cooling plate to cool the solar energy photovoltaic array; cooling water after being cooled by the solar energy photovoltaic array reflows back to the water storage device; and the energy storage device is connected with the DC/AC converter through the charging and discharging controller. The utility model has the advantages of solving the heating problem of the solar energy photovoltaic array during the operation, ensuring the working stability and the service life of the solar energy photovoltaic array, and improving the output power of the solar energy photovoltaic array and the efficiency of the solar energy photovoltaic water pump system.

title: Solar energy and wind energy hybrid ship

The wind energy propelling system consists of a solar energy sail, a sail 90-degree pitching mechanical device, a sail 360-degree rotating device and a sail control system. The solar energy propelling and power supply system consists of a solar energy power generation system, an electric power management system, a lithium battery set and a ship electric power propelling system. In order to maximize the area of a solar energy plate, the ship for specially designing the ship type is mainly to obtain high solar power; and the ship can adopt such specially designed multi-body ships as a double-body ship and a three-body ship, or can be a single-body ship structure. The solar energy and wind energy hybrid ship uses such pollution-free, reproducible and purchase-free energy as wind energy and solar energy to replace fuel oil to be applied on the ship, and has an important significance on improvement of economical benefit, energy conservation, emission reduction and reduction of environmental pollution.

The mushroom chamber drying device coupled with the air heat source pump and solar energy heating has the advantages of stable running, convenience in adjusting and control, small environment pollution and less energy consumption.

title: Solar energy trap and turbine
abstract: A solar energy turbine includes solar energy trap (1110) having a chamber with an inlet port (12), such that solar energy (13) entering the chamber through the inlet port is absorbed and reflected within the chamber means until substantially all the solar energy is absorbed by the chamber. Preferably, the inlet port is arranged to cause photons of the solar energy entering the chamber to circulate substantially in a single direction within the chamber until absorbed, such that on re-passing the inlet port substantially no photons emerge from the inlet port. The solar energy turbine includes a heat exchanger (1150, 1160, 1170) for extracting energy from the solar energy trap to drive a turbine (1120).

title: Control system and method for use in a solar energy device and a solar tracking device

The control signal is transmitted to the solar tracking device or the actuating module of the solar energy device to enable the solar tracking device or the actuating module of the solar energy device.

title: SOLAR CELL GENERATOR
abstract: A solar cell generator is provided to acquire the maximum solar energy by adjusting an angle of a solar cell unit according to a position of the sun. A solar cell unit(10) includes a silicon semiconductor plate to acquire electrical energy from solar energy. A solar position tracking unit(12) rotates the solar cell unit(10) by a sensor according to a position of the sun so that the solar cell unit(10) absorbs the solar energy maximally. A solar energy conversion unit(14) converts the solar energy absorbed from the solar cell unit(10) into the electrical energy. A voltage conversion unit(16) converts a DC current of the electrical energy converted in the solar energy conversion unit(14) into an AC current. A current control unit protects an overcurrent of an AC current which is converted in the voltage conversion unit(16). A charging unit stores a remaining current charged/discharged in the current control unit. A floating unit(22) locates the solar cell unit(10) and the solar position tracking unit(12) on an upper part of a panel, and has a floating pipe on a lower part of the panel to float on water. A generation unit enables the floating unit(12) to be moved by the current. A fixing unit enables the floating unit to be fixed by the water flow.

title: Hot water energy stored and full duty solar thermal electric power generation system
abstract: A hot water energy stored solar thermal electric power generation system which can provide electricity in day, night, and no-sun days is described, which includes at least one solar energy concentration module group, transport pipes, a hot-water container, a thermal engine, an auxiliary heater, and a generator. The solar energy concentration module group includes at least one solar energy concentration module. The solar energy concentration module includes a solar energy collecting pipe and a sunlight reflector. The sunlight reflector concentrates sunlight on the solar energy collecting pipe to heat an energy collecting fluid. The energy collecting fluid flows through the solar energy collecting pipe for energy transportation. The transport pipes transports the energy collecting fluid which heated by the solar energy collecting pipe into the hot-water container. Water or its solution is contained in the hot-water container as the energy storage fluid. The hot-water container is connected to the thermal engine to supply the thermal engine with thermal energy. The auxiliary heater is connected to the thermal engine and is suitable to supply thermal energy to the thermal engine via burning oil or gas when the solar energy has been used out. The thermal engine is connected to the generator to drive the generator.

abstract: The utility model discloses a compound actively searching and following super powerful solar energy-heating collector which is to provide a solar energy heating collecting device which is not only to stably follow and collect the solar energy, but also to increase the collected power and to improve the collected heating temperature. The technical solution key point is that the heating collecting device containing the solar energy collecting component, the solar energy collecting and reflecting section, and the following mechanism. The heating collecting device is a compound solar energy heating collecting structure constructed by assembling the solar energy heating collecting tube and the solar energy heating collecting vacuum tube together, the solar energy collecting reflecting section installed in the lower is parabola curve plate shape obverse mirror solar energy reflecting plate, the actively searching and following mechanism is made by the combination of the transverse actively searching and following section and the longitudinal actively searching and following section, the sensor is a jump comparative light sensor an optic sensitive unit and very small deep hole unit. The utility model major purpose is to collect the solar energy in nigh temperature super powerful mode.

title: SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION AND RADIATIVE COOLING COMPOSITE SYSTEM
abstract: Provided are a solar energy utilization and radiative cooling composite system, comprising a radiative cooling system and a solar energy conversion and utilization system; the radiative cooling system comprises a radiative cooling apparatus and a radiative-cold energy collection and utilization system; the solar energy conversion and utilization system comprises a solar energy conversion apparatus and an energy utilization system; the solar energy conversion apparatus is located on the two sides of the radiative cooling apparatus; the two constitute a composite structure energy conversion apparatus; the radiative cooling apparatus converts heat energy into electromagnetic waves, radiating electromagnetic waves into space to achieve cooling, and simultaneously reflecting the solar energy irradiated on the surface to the solar energy conversion apparatus; the solar energy conversion apparatus receives direct sunlight, sunlight reflected by the radiative cooling apparatus, and radiated electromagnetic waves from the body of the radiative cooling apparatus, and converts same into electricity, thermal energy, or cold, thus achieving the overlapping utilization of solar energy and radiative cooling in the same area. The invention greatly improves the energy utilization rate and energy density per unit area.

title: Solar electric heater
abstract: A solar electric heater relates to a household appliance capable of being supplied power by solar cells and power grid energy and is composed of a solar cell, a power-variable heating body and a power controller. The power-variable heating body is composed of a plurality of electric-heating elements and can be used with power supplied by the solar cell or the power grid energy in switching mode and can be used with power supplied by both simultaneously, when the solar cell and the power grid energy are used simultaneously, the solar cell is prior to the power grid energy which replenishes insufficient power part of the solar cell. When using solar energy, the solar cell is directly used for supplying power, at this time heating power of the power-variable heating body is in direct ratio with output power of the solar cell, inversion grid combination is not required, energy storage of a storage battery is not needed, application cost of the solar cell is reduced, and the solar electric heater is an electricity-saving product using solar energy.

title: Intelligent solar street lamp based on thing networking
abstract: The utility model relates to an intelligent solar street lamp based on thing networking, construct including supporting mechanism, control mechanism, lighting mechanism and solar energy absorber, control mechanism sets up in the supporting mechanism top, lighting mechanism has two, and two lighting mechanism set up respectively in control mechanism's both sides, solar energy absorber constructs the setting in the control mechanism top. This intelligent solar street lamp based on thing networking adopts this kind of clean energy of solar energy as the source of electric energy, and not only environmental protection is energy -conserving moreover, through optical line sensors, PLC and actuating mechanism's cooperation, forms the solar energy transformation mechanism of one set of intellectuality, and can accompany solar east to rise the west and fall, maximum efficiency ground absorption solar energy, improvement solar energy absorption efficiency, firm energy supplies sufficiently.

title: Solar energy module and solar panel framework thereof
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy module and a solar panel framework thereof. The solar energy module comprises a plurality of solar energy units and a support frame, wherein the support frame is suitable for connecting the solar energy units and a support and fixing the solar energy units on the support; each solar energy unit comprises a solar panel and a plurality of fixed brackets, and the fixed brackets are suitable for surrounding the solar panel; each fixed bracket comprises a lateral plate, as well as a fixing plate and a mounting plate which are connected with the lateral plate, the fixing plate is suitable for fixing the fixed bracket on the support frame, and the mounting plate is suitable for fixing the solar panel; and a solar panel framework consisting of the support frame and the fixed brackets can fix the solar panels on the support. The solar panel framework provided by the utility model has lower manufacturing cost, and can firmly fix the solar panels on the support.

title: Gas meter with solar cell and solar charging system
abstract: The invention discloses a gas meter with a solar cell and a solar charging system. The gas meter with the solar cell comprises a basic gas meter and a control device arranged on the basic gas meter. The control device comprises a signal acquisition board, a control module, a radio frequency module and a counter and is characterized in that a solar cell is arranged ahead of the counter; the outside of the solar cell is provided with a lens; the solar charging system comprises a solar energy conversion unit, a first electric current unilateral control unit, an electric energy storage unit, an overcharging protection system, a spare power source and a second electric current unilateral control unit.
