The gas meter with the solar cell and the solar charging system have following beneficial effects: by converting solar energy into the electric energy storage unit through the solar energy conversion unit, solar energy is then utilized so that problems of a dry cell such as inconvenient replacement, energy consumption, and pollution are solved; an amorphous silicon solar panel has good performance of converting weak light; and solar energy can be utilized in weak light.

title: Solar energy tracking device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of new energy, especially to a solar energy tracking device suitable for a solar cell. The solar energy tracking device comprises a support, a pedestal, a photosensitive component, a solar cell panel, a first executive component and a second executive component. The photosensitive component is installed on the solar cell panel; the solar cell panel is arranged on the support through a driving shaft, and the driving shaft is controlled by the first executive component; the support is arranged on the pedestal through a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is driven by the second executive component; the first executive component controls the elevation angle movement of a solar energy device array; and the second executive component controls the azimuth angle movement of the solar energy device array. The solar energy tracking device has advantages that the solar cell panel continuously adjusts the azimuth angle and the elevation angle under the action of the solar energy tracking device, so that the solar cell panel can receive the vertical sunshine of the sun to the maximum and the full solar energy utilization efficiency is obtained.

title: Solar energy and air energy curing barn system with energy storage
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy and air energy curing barn system with energy storage. A curing bar is heated by solar energy and air energy, an energy storage oil tank is used for storing the surplus solar energy so as to continuously heat the curing barn by the stored solar energy at the non-sunshine duration, therefore the use ratio of the energy can be greatly improved, and more energy saving and environmental protection can be realized.

title: Cascade heat accumulating type solar energy and ground source heat pump composite heating system
abstract: The utility model discloses a cascade heat accumulating type solar energy and ground source heat pump composite heating system. According to the system, heat transfer fluid in the evacuated tube collector is heated through solar irradiation, heat collection and utilization of solar energy are achieved, and when the solar irradiation is strong, one part of high-temperature solar heat energy is directly used for heating, and the other part of high-temperature solar heat energy is used for accumulating heat for the high-temperature heat accumulator; when the solar irradiation is weak and the low-temperature solar heat energy cannot meet the heat accumulation requirement of the high-temperature heat accumulator, one part of the low-temperature solar heat energy is combined with the ground source heat pump for heating, and the other part of the low-temperature solar heat energy is used for accumulating heat for the low-temperature heat accumulator; when no solar irradiation exists at nightor in rainy days, two schemes of independent heating of the high-temperature heat accumulator or combined heating of the low-temperature heat accumulator and the ground source heat pump can be adopted; according to the utility model, solar energy and geothermal energy can be organically combined, the problem that low-irradiation solar energy is not fully utilized is solved by adopting a stepped heat storage design, the utilization efficiency of solar energy is improved, and the operation of the system is more stable.

title: DEVICES AND METHODS FOR INCREASING SOLAR HYDROGEN CONVERSION EFFICIENCY IN PHOTOVOLTAIC ELECTROLYSIS
abstract: Devices and methods for photovoltaic electrolysis are disclosed. A device comprises a photovoltaic cell element and an electrolysis compartment. The photovoltaic cell element is configured to convert a portion of solar energy into electrical energy and to pass another portion of the solar energy. The electrolysis compartment includes an aqueous electrolyte positioned to receive the other portion of the solar energy and electrodes electrically connected to receive the electrical energy produced by the photovoltaic cell element. A method comprises receiving solar energy with a photovoltaic cell element, converting a portion of the solar energy into electrical energy, passing another portion of the solar energy through the photovoltaic cell element, receiving with an aqueous electrolyte the other portion of the solar energy, transmitting the electrical energy generated by the photovoltaic cell element to a pair of electrodes, and electrolyzing the aqueous electrolyte with the pair of electrodes.

title: Traffic light structure with rotatable solar panel
abstract: The invention discloses a traffic light structure with a rotatable solar panel. The traffic light structure comprises a fixing bracket; and a telescopic assembly, a traffic light box assembly and a solar energy assembly which are arranged on the fixing bracket. The telescopic assembly comprises a height adjusting block, a telescopic block and a plurality of telescopic arms. The traffic light box assembly includes a support rod and a traffic light box fixed with the support rod. The solar energy assembly includes a solar panel bracket, a solar energy rotating plate, a solar panel frame and a solar panel. The solar panel bracket is fixed on the traffic light box. The solar energy rotating plate is rotatably arranged on the solar panel bracket. The solar panel frame is fixedly connected withthe solar energy rotating plate. The solar panel is arranged in the solar panel frame. Through the arrangement of the solar panel bracket, the solar energy rotating plate, the solar panel frame, and the solar panel, the traffic light structure in the invention can realize the rotation of the solar panel, improve the real-time follow-up of the sun, and receive the strongest light at any time, so that the absorbed solar energy can be increased and converted into a DC power supply for traffic lights.

title: Solar energy underfloor heating system that heat storage performance is good
abstract: The utility model belongs to solar energy the field of warming up, specifically be a solar energy underfloor heating system that heat storage performance is good, including solar panel, heat storage water tank and radiator, solar panel upper end middle part fixedly connected with vacuum heat -absorbing tube, and the right back side of solar panel lower extreme closely welding has the support frame, solar panel top rear side fixedly connected with thermal energy conversion ware, and solar panel left end front end is provided with the cooling and loopbacks the pipe, and cooling loopback pipe isconnected to on the solar panel through the trompil, solar panel left side middle part rear end is provided with the heat pipe, this solar energy underfloor heating system that heat storage performance is good, because warm up is used for the heating of indoor ground used solar energy, so as the user when warming up with using solar energy, the thermal energy conversion ware uses with the vacuum heat -absorbing tube cooperation, utilize the thermal energy conversion ware to convert the solar energy into and can use heat energy, the heating efficiency that can warm up with improving solar energy effectively, its heating quality has been improved simultaneously.

title: Methods for orientation and tilt identification of photovoltaic systems and solar irradiance sensors
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and systems for identifying PV system and solar irradiance sensor orientation and tilt based on energy production, energy received, simulated energy production, estimated energy received, production skew, and energy received skew. The present invention relates to systems and methods for detecting orientation and tilt of a PV system based on energy production and simulated energy production; for detecting the orientation and tilt of a solar irradiance sensor based on solar irradiance observation and simulated solar irradiance observation; for detecting orientation of a PV system based on energy production and energy production skew; and for detecting orientation of a solar irradiance sensor based on solar irradiance observation and solar irradiance observation skew.

title: Offshore supply platform with solar energy
abstract: The utility model relates to an offshore supply platform with solar energy, which comprises a solar energy platform, a working solar panel and a standby solar panel are fixed on the solar energy platform, two sides of the solar energy platform are connected with rotating devices, each rotating device comprises three direction rotating assemblies, and the three direction rotating assemblies are mutually connected through a transmission rod. The bottom of the rotating device is fixedly installed on a floating platform, and a buoyancy device is arranged in the floating platform. According to the offshore supply platform with the solar energy, offshore floating operation is achieved through the floating platform, energy supply of the offshore platform is achieved by obtaining solar energy through the solar platform, replacement of the standby solar panel and orientation change of the working solar panel are achieved through the rotating device, and the working efficiency of the solar device is improved; and long-term normal operation of the offshore supply platform is ensured.

title: Wave energy, wind energy and solar energy coupled power generation device
abstract: The utility model discloses a wave energy, wind energy and solar energy coupled power generation device, which belongs to the field of offshore power generation and comprises a fan, a rotating shaft, a protective cover, an upper seat, a power generator, a charging module, a connecting rod, a connecting bracket, a solar panel, a fixed plate, a glass cover, a nano friction layer and a lower seat. By means of the structural design, wind energy, solar energy and wave energy are coupled together, when no wind exists on the sea surface, the solar panel converts the solar energy into electric energy, the nanometer friction layer converts the wave energy into the electric energy, and when no sunlight exists on the sea surface, the fan converts the wind energy into the electric energy through the generator. The nanometer friction layer converts wave energy into electric energy, when the sea surface is calm and free of waves, the fan converts wind energy into electric energy through the power generator, the solar panel converts solar energy into electric energy, and the offshore power generation efficiency of the device is higher; and by utilizing the triangular solar panel, the device can collect and convert solar energy more comprehensively.

title: New energy rainproof energy-saving lamp
abstract: The new energy rainproof energy-saving lamp comprises a lamp pole, the left side and the right side of the top of the lamp pole are respectively connected with a rain baffle in a hinged mode, and first electric telescopic rods are further arranged on the two sides of the lamp pole. Wherein the solar panel on the sunny side enables the inclination angle to be perpendicular to the direct sunlight angle, the solar panel on the shady side enables the angle to be as close as horizontal as possible, the two solar panels are fully utilized for power conversion, the power is stored in the storage battery through the charging and discharging controller in the control box, and solar power generation is more environmentally friendly. The pollution to the environment is reduced; in rainy days, the solar panel is driven by the servo motor to turn over, the waterproof plate on the back face of the solar panel is made to face upwards, the gap between the solar panel and the rectangular groove is plugged through the plugging mechanism, and therefore the function of a rain baffle is achieved, and meanwhile the light receiving face of the solar panel is protected.

title: Limo power source control system based on solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a limo power source control system based on solar energy. The limo power source control system comprises a solar energy collection module, a solar power storage module, a solar heating module, a storage battery electric quantity acquiring module and a control module, the solar energy collection module is used for collecting solar energy, the solar power storage module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy to charge a limo storage battery, the solar heating module is used for converting solar energy into heat energy to heat a water heating tank of a limo, the storage battery electric quantity acquiring module is used for acquiring current electric quantity Y of the limo storage battery, the control module is connected with the solar power storage module, the solar heating module and the storage battery electric quantity acquiring module, the solar energy collection module is connected with the solar power storage module and the solar heating module, and the control module is used for acquiring current electric quantity Y of the limo storage battery through the storage battery electric quantity module, comparing the current electric quantity Y of the limo storage battery with preset electric quantity and controlling the solar power storage module and the solar heating module to act according to a comparison result.

title: Energy-saving solar greenhouse
abstract: The invention provides an energy-saving solar greenhouse comprising a water supply pipeline which is connected with a water supply pump, a node irrigation device, a humiture automatic control device,a solar assembly which can absorb solar energy and convert the solar energy into electric energy and thermal energy and a radiator in the greenhouse for heating; the water supply pipeline is connectedwith municipal water supply lines and water tanks of rainwater collecting devices; the solar assembly comprises a solar absorption plate, a thermal energy utilization device which is connected to thesolar absorption plate and is used for storing the solar energy as thermal energy and an electric energy utilization device which is connected to the solar absorption plate and is used for storing the solar energy as electric energy. According to the greenhouse, for different areas in the vegetable greenhouse, different node irrigation devices are arranged for irrigation with different flow according to different humidity of soil, therefore avoiding shortcomings of over-irrigation and under-irrigation in some areas.

title: High -efficient thermal -arrest solar energy conversion ware
abstract: In order to overcome the formidable problem of appearance in practical application, according to solar energy development, research and develop a high -efficient thermal -arrest solar energy conversion ware, the utility model discloses a solve technical scheme that its technical problem adopted and be utilize the solar energy directly convert into the hot -air can a novel invention, the tertium genus application schema of the developing sunlight energy. The purpose of invention can not only compensate the shortcoming of the current solar energy energy, still will develop the heliotechnics market potential, makes the solar energy scientific and technological level go forward to more advance direction to make the solar energy energy no longer rely on in photovoltaic board technical support, replaced traditional hi -Tech, promoted the maximize of solar energy energy commercial interest.

title: Solar energy lighting U disk with advertisement function
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of auxiliary devices for computers, in particular relates to a novel U disk which is capable of displaying advertisement, cartoon, famous drawing on a solar energy screen by solar energy. An A U disk with advertising function by solar energy comprises a U disk body fixed in the shell, a data interface connected with the U disk body, openings in similar shape and size with a solar screen arranged on the shell, a solar energy receiving plate on the sides of the solar energy screen connected with the soar energy screen by the conductor, the U disk body fixed at the back of solar energy screen. The utility model can provide a solar energy screen and some pictures, which has advertising function.

title: Solar energy power generation equipment with wind power generation equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy power generation equipment with wind power generation equipment, including base and solar energy mounting panel, the both sides symmetrical of base has the stand, and just aerogenerator is all installed on the top of two stands, and it has solar cell panel to inlay on the solar energy mounting panel, the last solar sensor that installs of solar cell panel, and the solar energy mounting panel is installed between two stands, installs a double -line section of thick bamboo on the base, and two stay cords of pulling out on the double -line section of thick bamboo are connected respectively at the both ends of solar energy mounting panel, still install battery and PLC controller on the base, the utility model discloses a solar energy power generationequipment converts wind -force into electric energy through aerogenerator, gives storage battery charging, and when being full of, control aerogenerator and solar cell panel carry out the complementary electricity generation of scene together, and the solar incident angle of solar sensor response, makes a double -line section of thick bamboo receive and release two stay cords, and pulling solar energy mounting panel rotates along with solar removal, improves solar cell panel's generated energy.

title: Wind power generation and solar power generation combining system adopting nanometer friction generators
abstract: The invention discloses a wind power generation and solar power generation combining system adopting nanometer friction generators. The system comprises a wind generator, a solar energy assembly and an energy storage device. The wind generator comprises at least one nanometer friction generator. The solar energy assembly is composed of a plurality of solar batteries. The solar batteries are connected in series or in parallel to form at least two output ends of the solar energy assembly. Each solar battery is a photoelectric conversion unit which is made of semiconductor material and is of a PN junction type structure. The energy storage device is connected with the output ends of the nanometer friction generators and the at least two output ends of the solar energy assembly, and is used for storing electric energy output by the nanometer friction generators and electric energy output by the solar energy assembly. The system provided by the invention can achieve dual collection and utilization of wind energy and solar energy. Meanwhile, the nanometer friction generators are miniaturized and thinned. Thus, the weight of the whole generation system is reduced, and the cost is significantly reduced.

title: Solar energy storage heating device
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy storage heating device. The solar energy storage heating device is characterized in that a solar energy heating device is adopted, the solar energy is used as a heating source, and the solar energy storage heating device comprises an energy storage device and a heat transferring medium storage tank; solar energy is used as the heating source, fused salt used as an energy storage matter in the energy storage device is heated; the fused salt is used as an energy storage source after absorbing heat, and the energy storage source is used as a heat source for supplying heat and heating a hot spring. According to the utility model, when the energy storage source isn't adequate, the solar energy is used for supplying heat for energy storage matters, and valley electricity energy storage is formed or an interactive self-adaptive self-balanced adjusting heating supplying method and system are formed between energy storage sources, so that the solar energy and the valley electricity energy are utilized comprehensively, the utilization efficiency is improved, and the structure is simple.

title: Solar energy field emergency power supply
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy field emergency power supply which comprises a solar cell film, a solar controller, a power supply management interface and a support structure, wherein the solar cell film is fixed on the support structure and is connected with the solar controller; the solar controller is communicated with the power supply management interface; and the power supply management interface is provided with a plurality of output ports connected with electric equipment. By collecting the optical energy and converting the optical energy into electric energy, the solar energy field emergency power supply can be used for providing the electric energy for the low-power electric equipment in the open air; the electric energy converted by the solar energy can be stored into an energy storage device, so that the basic electricity utilization of the field work equipment can be guaranteed when in rainy day or at night; the solar energy field emergency power supply has the function of charge control, improves the charging efficiency of the solar cell film and protects the energy storage device; and due to the flexible characteristic of solar cell material, the solar cell film can be curled and folded, the volume is saved, the weight is light, the shockproof performance is good, and the solar energy field emergency power supply is convenient for carrying and is especially suitable for the people who are engaged in field operation for a long time.

title: Movable solar energy collecting device
abstract: The utility model relates to a movable solar energy collecting device. The movable solar energy collecting device comprises a solar energy photovoltaic system, a hinged left support and a right support, wherein the solar energy photovoltaic system consists of a solar panel, a storage battery and a solar controller connected in sequence; a hinged left auxiliary support and a right auxiliary support are arranged on the inner sides of the left support and the right support; the solar panel is arranged on the left support and the right support; and the storage battery and the solar controller are arranged on the left auxiliary support and the right auxiliary support. According to the utility model, the solar panel is arranged on the left and the right supports; the storage battery and the solar controller are arranged on the left and the right auxiliary supports; the whole device can be freely moved to or mounted/dismounted at places as required, is particularly applicable in broad places which facilitate the free ambulation of livestock, such as prairies, grassland and the like; solar energy collecting devices can be placed on the backs of the livestock during pasturing, solar energy is collected by the solar panels, converted into electricity energy, and stored in storage batteries, and at night, the solar energy can be converted into electricity energy for electricity supplying, heating and the like.

title: Energy -conserving backwater device of solar energy
abstract: The utility model belongs to the energy -conserving backwater device of solar energy field especially relates to an energy -conserving backwater device of solar energy, energy -conserving backwater device of solar energy includes electric water heater and solar collector, links to each other running water house steward, cold water pipe, solar collector, electric water heater, hot -water line through the pipeline, the hot -water line passes through back water pipe connected with the solar collector water inlet, and the cold water pipe links to each other with solar collector's an outlet pipe and a cold water mixing valve, and the outlet pipe of a cold water mixing valve links to each other with hot -water line and the 2nd cold water mixing valve. The utility model discloses can provide one kind and have the return water function, can reduce the energy -conserving backwater device of solar energy of electric water heater power consumption simultaneously.

title: Solar energy and wind energy simultaneous power supply road lamp
abstract: The invention discloses a street lamp simultaneously powered by solar energy and wind energy, which comprises a wind driven generator, a solar panel, a lamp and an accumulator. The wind driven generator and the solar panel are connected with a controller through which different solar energy and wind energy voltages can be balanced, thereby enabling two power supplies respectively provided by solar energy and wind energy to merge, effectively improving energy utilization and saving energy.

title: AI solar energy smart storage cabinet has advantage of applying perovskite solar panels to replace conventional silicon solar panels
abstract: An AI solar energy smart storage cabinet is provided, wherein perovskite solar panels include solar panels made of calcium and titanium oxide (CaTiO3) and solar panels made of a perovskite material. The AI solar energy smart storage cabinet includes: an energy storage cabinet internally mounted with batteries to store electrical energy; and at least one perovskite solar panel attached to at least one surface of the energy storage cabinet; wherein it comprises a plurality of perovskite solar panels attached to a plurality of surfaces of the energy storage cabinet to absorb solar energy from various orientations. The AI solar energy smart storage cabinet also includes: at least one extension rack connected to the energy storage cabinet and outwardly extending from the energy storage cabinet, wherein at least one perovskite solar panel is mounted to one end of the extension rack to absorb light from various angles, thereby achieving the efficiency of converting solar energy of sun light into electrical energy. A moving device is mounted to the bottom of the energy storage cabinet so that the energy storage cabinet can be moved to different locations by means of the moving device. The moving device may be rollers or an autonomous mobile robot for example.

title: Solar energy concentrator and collector system and associated method
abstract: A power generating system comprises a solar concentrator defining an effectively concave reflective surface on a surface of the earth for concentrating incoming solar energy. A solar collector is disposed in an underground chamber provided with an access opening. The solar collector receives solar energy concentrated by the concentrator and converting the concentrated solar energy to another energy form, generally thermal energy, which is subsequently convertible to electrical power. Directional componentry is provided for directing concentrated solar energy from the concentrator along a predefined folded transmission path through the access opening to the collector.

title: Distributed solar collection and solar transit system combined power supply system and implementation method
abstract: A distributed solar collection and solar transit system combined power supply system comprises a solar transit system, a solar storage device, a solar grid device, a solar collection system, a solar gathering system, a photovoltaic controller and an inverter. The distributed solar collection system is used for storing the electric energy obtained through solar photovoltaic conversion, or the electric energy obtained through solar photothermal conversion or the electric energy obtained through wind electricity conversion in a storage battery of the solar collection system. The solar gathering system is used for transferring the electric energy in the storage battery of the collection system to a storage battery with a larger volume in the solar gathering system through the photovoltaic controller, the solar collection system is used for delivering the electric energy stored in the storage battery with the large volume to a solar electricity storage device of a solar transit system, the solar transit system is used for converting a direct current of the electric energy obtained by the solar storage device to an alternating current through the inverter, and then the alternating current is directly connected to a grid or is delivered to a load.

title: Automatic window of solar energy glass energy supply
abstract: The utility model discloses an automatic window of solar energy glass energy supply, including window frame, casement, traveling drive means, book curtain actuating mechanism, the casement includes the frame and inlay the solar energy glass who encloses in the frame, be equipped with the solar cell strip in the frame, the solar cell strip with solar energy glass connects, is used for utilizing theabsorptive light of solar energy glass turns into the electric energy and stores. It stores to carry out the electric energy in solar energy glass can collect the incident light and convey the solarcell strip, the casement comes automatic drive through actuating mechanism and opens and shuts to utilize in the solar cell strip electric energy to supply power, make this electric control open and shut the window and need not connect indoor other powers, reached fine energy saving effect.

title: Solar-energy foam-making machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar-energy foam-making machine. Solar-energy resources are fully and reasonably utilized, and a joyful atmosphere is offered to an activity on a square. The solar-energy foam-making machine is characterized in that solar cell panels 1 are arranged on the upper side and the periphery of a body support, an energy storage 2 and a switch 3 are arranged at the bottom of the body support, the simple foam-making machine 4 is arranged inside the body support, the switch 3 controls the foam-making machine to be started or closed, and the energy storage 2 can automatically store solar energy and can be used when it rains or at nights. The solar-energy foam-making machine has the advantages that the solar-energy resources are fully utilized, enjoyment is added to the activity on the square, energy can be automatically stored, the solar-energy foam-making machine can be operated at any time, and the solar-energy foam-making machine is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title: Spherical lighting and light-gathering multiplication solar energy hot water generation device
abstract: The utility model discloses a spherical lighting and light-gathering multiplication solar energy hot water generation device, which comprises a rectangular casing, a water tank, a cold water pipe, a hot water pipe, a plane transparent cover plate and a solar energy light-gathering receiving mechanism. The solar energy light-gathering receiving mechanism comprises a rotary paraboloid reflective mirror and a luminous energy receiver. The opening of the rotary paraboloid reflective mirror of the solar energy light-gathering receiving mechanism just faces the plane transparent cover plate. The luminous energy receiver of the solar energy light-gathering receiving mechanism is arranged on the focus of the rotary paraboloid reflective mirror of the solar energy light-gathering receiving mechanism. The device receives the solar energy by the reflection focusing effect of the rotary paraboloid, thereby greatly increasing the receiving efficiency of the solar energy. Meanwhile, the collecting and receiving of the solar energy can be realized in strong and weak light environments.

title: Solar water heater with focusing arrangement
abstract: The utility model provides a solar water heater with focusing arrangement, includes solar water heater, two parts of solar energy focusing arrangement, last holding water box, the support of being equipped with of solar water heater, be equipped with higher support on the solar energy focusing arrangement, solar energy focusing arrangement shelves around solar water heater's top to use and does not shelter from the sunlight to the shining as the prerequisite of solar water heater, its gathering be solar water heater sunlight all around, solar energy focusing arrangement (multiunit) makes it to improve one to several times endothermic efficiency on assembling solar water heater with all directions's sunlight, is favorable to utilizing fully solar energy.

title: Natural gas and solar energy combined double-heat-pump central hot water system
abstract: The utility model discloses a natural gas and solar energy combined double-heat-pump central water heating system which comprises a heat preservation water tank, a natural gas water heater and a solar energy hot water tank, the upper end of the solar energy hot water tank is communicated with a solar energy water adding pipe, and a solar energy automatic valve is arranged on the solar energy water adding pipe. One side of the solar hot water tank communicates with a first solar water outlet pipe and a second solar water outlet pipe, a first solar pump is arranged on the first solar water outlet pipe, and a second solar valve is arranged on the second solar water outlet pipe. The other side of the solar hot water tank communicates with a first solar auxiliary pipe and a second solar auxiliary pipe, third water level switches are arranged in the first solar auxiliary pipe and fixedly connected through a third limiting rod, and a third water level floating ball is movably connected to the third limiting rod in an inserted mode. Water is heated by half combining solar energy, so that consumed natural gas is saved.

title: Power unit for solar charging
abstract: The invention discloses a power unit for solar charging, and relates to the field of solar cell charging. The power unit comprises a solar cell for converting light energy into electric energy; and anenergy storage battery used for storing the electric energy output by the solar cell. The solar cell is directly connected with the energy storage battery. The limitation of a solar cell conversion module on charging is eliminated, the solar cell directly charges the energy storage cell, the electric quantity loss is reduced, and the heating value is reduced, so that the cost is effectively reduced, the charging efficiency of the power unit is improved, and the conversion utilization rate of solar energy is further improved.

title: New energy automobile charging device
abstract: The utility model discloses a charging device for a new energy automobile. The charging device comprises an automobile braking energy recovery module used for converting heat energy generated in the braking process into electric energy; the solar power generation module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the storage battery is used for charging and storing energy according to the electric energy generated by the automobile braking energy recovery module and the solar power generation module; the solar power generation module comprises a transparent solar cell film and/orat least one solar cell panel, and the solar cell panel covers a front engine hood, a roof and/or a trunk lid of the automobile. Wherein the solar cell film covers window glass of an automobile; thesolar cell panel and the solar cell film are both connected with the storage battery. According to the utility model, the automobile brake energy recovery module and the solar power generation moduleare respectively arranged, so that the new energy automobile is charged in the walking process, and the integrated multifunctional charging is also realized.

title: Solar strong effective rotary ring light gathering apparatus
abstract: The present invention provides a solar strong-effect rotary ring light focusing device. A group of solar energy collectors and a rotary ring light collecting lens are provided in the casing. The rotary ring light collect lens which is fixed on an adjustable bracket is provided above the solar energy collectors. The adjustable bracket adjusts the rotary ring light collecting lens to the solar light source. The rotary ring light collecting lens focuses the solar energy to the solar energy collector and effectively shortens the distance between the light collecting lens and the solar energy collector for sending out several times of former electrical energy or heat energy by the solar generator or heat collector.

title: Automobile allowing conversion of solar energy into electric energy
abstract: The invention discloses an automobile allowing conversion of solar energy into electric energy. The automobile comprises a vehicle and a solar energy conversion device and is characterized in that the solar energy conversion device is disposed on the vehicle roof; the solar energy conversion device comprises a solar cell panel, an energy converter and a power supply device; an output end of the solar cell panel is connected to an input end of the energy converter; an output end of the energy converter is connected to an input end of the power supply device; an output end of the power supply device is connected to an energy consumption device of the vehicle; the solar cell panel is disposed on the vehicle roof; and the energy converter and the power supply device are disposed in the vehicle. The automobile disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the solar energy is collected and converted into the electric energy, so that the automobile can be powered; consumption of limited natural resources such as gasoline and diesel oil in the automobile can be reduced; and environments can be protected.

title: Utility pole with solar modules and wireless device and method of retrofitting existing utility pole
abstract: A utility pole includes one or more solar modules configured to collect solar energy and convert the solar energy to electromagnetic energy and a wireless device configured to receive the electromagnetic energy from the one or more solar modules and to transmit the electromagnetic energy therefrom.

title: METHODS FOR ORIENTATION AND TILT IDENTIFICATION OF PHOTOVOLTAIC SYSTEMS AND SOLAR IRRADIANCE SENSORS
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and systems for identifying PV system and solar irradiance sensor orientation and tilt based on energy production, energy received, simulated energy production, estimated energy received, production skew, and energy received skew. The present invention relates to systems and methods for detecting orientation and tilt of a PV system based on energy production and simulated energy production; for detecting the orientation and tilt of a solar irradiance sensor based on solar irradiance observation and simulated solar irradiance observation; for detecting orientation of a PV system based on energy production and energy production skew; and for detecting orientation of a solar irradiance sensor based on solar irradiance observation and solar irradiance observation skew.

title: Solar car lamp system and car
abstract: The invention provides a solar car lamp system and a car, the solar car lamp system comprises a car lamp functional lamp panel, a solar visible ring, an electric energy collecting device and a storage battery, the electric energy collecting device is electrically connected with the solar visible ring, the storage battery is electrically connected with the electric energy collecting device, and the storage battery is electrically connected with the car lamp functional lamp panel; the solar visible ring is arranged in a non-light area of the functional lamp panel of the automobile lamp; or the solar visible ring is switched between the visible area and the invisible area of the functional lamp panel of the automobile lamp. A decoration ring structure of the car lamp is changed into a solar energy visible ring structure, the solar energy visible ring structure can be a solar energy decoration ring or a decoration plate, solar energy is collected and converted into electric energy, the solar energy visible ring capable of changing positions is adopted, and therefore the appearance and functions of the whole car lamp are kept unchanged. And meanwhile, the electric energy collected by the solar energy can realize self-sufficiency of the automobile lamp, so that the appearance and the function of the whole lamp are maintained, and the self-sufficiency of the electric energy of the automobile lamp is met.

title: ELECTRIC VEHICLE FAST CHARGING STATION WITH SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM AND IT'S METHOD
abstract: A high power EV fast charging station with solar energy system (EVFCS-SES) having a HV DC bus, several EVFCS-SES cells connecting in parallel and with their universal battery interfaces, and a storage battery system provides the following functions: solar energy generation; solar energy generation plus a direct storage battery charging; high power EV fast charging with either solar energy or storage battery or AC grid power. These functions enable EVFCS-SES system to charge any EV battery with solar energy in minutes, convert solar energy to AC grid power, and supply electricity to building loads at same time. In addition, it stores unused solar energy into storage battery for supplementing solar energy in cloudy days or at night. Combining EV fast charging system and solar energy generation system into one system achieves a low cost, high efficient and high power EV fast charging station with solar energy generation system. Furthermore, this system takes full advantage of solar energy and eliminates or reduces AC grid power usage effectively. As a result, it makes both EV fast charger and solar energy generation system more desirable and economical.

title: Outdoor shading device with renewable power system
abstract: An outdoor shading device includes a supporting frame, a shading awning supported by the supporting frame to define a shading area underneath the shading awning, and a solar power system. The solar power system includes a solar collecting unit having a solar collecting surface overlapped on the shading awning for solar energy collection, and a power storage supported at the supporting frame to electrically connect to the solar collecting unit, wherein when the shading awning is orientated for providing shade from the sun, the solar collecting surface of the solar collecting unit is aligned with the direction of the sun to maximize the solar energy collection, such that after the solar energy is collected, the solar collecting unit converts the solar energy into electrical energy and stored in the power storage.

title: ENERGY-SAVING ENTERTAINMENT DEVICE FOR PARK
abstract: An energy-saving entertainment device for a park, the energy-saving entertainment device comprising a solar panel (10) for collecting solar energy and converting the solar energy into electrical energy; a panel controller (20) for controlling an operating state of the solar panel (10); a solar energy storage battery (30) for storing electrical energy after conversion; a converter (40) for controlling an operating state of the solar energy storage battery (30); a timer (50) for setting a music playing time; and a music module (60) for playing music according to a predetermined time. By using solar radiation to store electrical energy, not only can the electrical energy be supplied to a lighting device (90), but also the energy that is inexhaustible in nature can be used for people to enjoy music and have fun.

title: Solar energy and wind energy cooperated power supply lamp and lanterns
abstract: The invention discloses a street lamp simultaneously powered by solar energy and wind energy, which comprises a wind driven generator, a solar panel, a lamp and an accumulator. The wind driven generator and the solar panel are connected with a controller through which different solar energy and wind energy voltages can be balanced, thereby enabling two power supplies respectively provided by solar energy and wind energy to merge, effectively improving energy utilization and saving energy.

title: Device improving heat energy utilization rate of solar energy thermoelectricity converter
abstract: The invention discloses a device improving the heat energy utilization rate of a solar energy thermoelectricity converter, and solves the problems that the solar energy heat energy utilization rate is low; the device comprises a solar energy thermoelectricity converter body and a mobile support dolly; a support seat is provided with a vertical support barrel; a support rod is arranged in the support barrel through a bearing; the top of the support rod is connected with the backside of the solar energy thermoelectricity converter body through a first hinge seat; the mobile support dolly is provided with a telescopic device; the telescopic end of the telescopic device is connected with the back side portion of the solar energy thermoelectricity converter body through a second hinge seat. The device can improve the solar energy thermoelectricity converter heat energy utilization rate; the support seat, the solar energy thermoelectricity converter body, the mobile support dolly, the first hinge seat, the second hinge seat and the telescopic device are matched so as to easily adjust the direction of the solar energy thermoelectricity converter body, so the solar energy thermoelectricity converter can be always vertical to the sun light irradiation direction, thus improving the solar energy heat energy utilization rate.

title: Solar energy trap and turbine
abstract: A solar energy turbine includes solar energy trap (1110) having a chamber with an inlet port (12), such that solar energy (13) entering the chamber through the inlet port is absorbed and reflected within the chamber means until substantially all the solar energy is absorbed by the chamber. Preferably, the inlet port is arranged to cause photons of the solar energy entering the chamber to circulate substantially in a single direction within the chamber until absorbed, such that on re-passing the inlet port substantially no photons emerge from the inlet port. The solar energy turbine includes a heat exchanger (1150, 1160, 1170) for extracting energy from the solar energy trap to drive a turbine (1120).

title: Solar energy storage apparatus
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy storage apparatus. The solar energy storage apparatus includes an energy storage housing, an energy storage battery which is arranged in the energy storage housing for electrically connecting a solar power generation device, a heat radiation assembly which is arranged on the surface of the energy storage battery, and an elevating mechanism which is fixedly arranged in the energy storage housing for fixing the energy storage housing on a guide rod and driving the energy storage housing to move along the axis of the guide rod, wherein the energy storage battery is electrically connected to the solar power generation device for storing the electric energy generated from the solar power generation device for charging an external device; the heat radiationassembly is arranged on the surface of the energy storage battery to accelerate heat transmission so as to timely output the heat generated from the energy storage battery out of the solar energy storage apparatus; and the elevating mechanism can drive the energy storage housing to move along the axis of the guide rod. Therefore, the solar energy storage apparatus can solve the problem that the user is not convenient to use the solar energy storage apparatus as the position of the solar energy storage apparatus is not adjustable.

title: Solar energy outdoor portable food heating, disinfecting and sterilizing machine
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy outdoor portable food heating, disinfecting and sterilizing machine. The solar energy outdoor portable food heating, disinfecting and sterilizing machine mainly comprises one or more solar energy silicon crystal plates, wherein telescopic brackets are arranged under the solar energy silicon crystal plates; a solar energy charging controller is connected to a position under the solar energy silicon crystal plates, and an inverter and an accumulator are connected to the solar energy charging controller; a heating, disinfecting and sterilizing machine is connected to the inverter, and the accumulator is connected to the inverter; a rain-proof cloth is arranged between the telescopic brackets; a food cabinet is arranged at the outer part of the heating, disinfecting and sterilizing machine under the solar energy silicon crystal plates; an illuminating lamp is arranged under the solar energy silicon crystal plates, and is connected with the inverter; the length of each solar energy silicon crystal plate is 2m, and the width of each solar energy silicon crystal plate is 1-1.2m; and the length of each telescopic bracket is 2-2.5m. The solar energy outdoor portable food heating, disinfecting and sterilizing machine disclosed by the invention has the advantages of being convenient to carry, reasonable in structure, clean, environmentally friendly, energy-saving, safe and reliable, a fire can be avoided, and camping requirements of outdoor activities can be met.

title: Solar energy extractor fan
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy extractor fan. The solar energy extractor fan is characterized by comprising a solar panel, a control panel, an extractor fan and a storage battery. The solar panel is connected with the control panel. The control panel is connected with the storage battery and the extractor fan. The solar energy extractor fan utilizes solar energy to generate electricity and also stores spare electric energy in case of other use.The solar energy extractor fan is simple in operation, and high in safety, reduces production cost to some extent and has a good practical value.

title: Cross-seasonal storage type solar air conditioning system
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of solar energy utilization, and particularly discloses a cross-seasonal storage type solar air conditioning system which comprises a solar heating device, a high-temperature energy storage device, a steam power generation device, a refrigeration device, an air conditioning device and a PID control unit, and the solar heating device comprises a solar heating tank, a high-temperature energy storage heat supply pipe and a high-temperature energy storage return pipe. A liquid medium is arranged in the solar heating tank; the high-temperature energy storage device comprises a high-temperature energy storage tank for storing a high-temperature liquid medium; the high-temperature energy storage tank is communicated with the solar heating tank through a high-temperature energy storage heat supply pipe and a high-temperature energy storage return pipe; the steam power generation device is connected with the solar heating tank; the refrigerating device is used for providing a cold source for the air-conditioning device; the air conditioning device is connected with the high-temperature energy storage device and the refrigerating device. Through the design, solar energy is efficiently collected through the solar heating device and converted into heat energy, cross-seasonal energy storage is achieved through the high-temperature energy storage device, and the problem of seasonal limitation of solar energy is effectively solved.

title: Spiral solar structure
abstract: The invention provides a spiral solar structure, and relates to the technical field of solar energy. The spiral solar energy structure comprises a mounting rack and a solar energy conversion component, wherein the solar energy conversion component is installed on the mounting rack and spirally extends along the length direction of the mounting rack. According to the spiral solar structure, the sunlight collecting area can be increased, the lighting degree is improved, the utilization efficiency of solar radiation energy is improved, and the occupied space is reduced.

title: Solar lamp arm is adjusted LED and is trailed street lamp
abstract: The utility model provides a solar lamp arm is adjusted LED and is trailed street lamp, includes solar lamp pillar, pillar disassembly?body, arm control adjusting device, the fixed clamp of arm, solar panel support frame, solar panel support frame regulation and control device, solar panel support frame clamp, electrical energy?storage device and solar lamp pillar, solar lamp pillar fixed mounting is on the solar street lamp base, the arm passes through arm fixing clip hoop fixed mounting on the solar lamp pillar, and the below of arm is equipped with the solar lamp body, the top of the fixed clamp of arm is equipped with the electrical energy?storage device. The utility model discloses a solar lamp arm is adjusted LED and is trailed street lamp converts light energy into electrical energy?storage to the electrical energy?storage device in through solar panel, through the electrical energy?storage device to solar lamp body power supply illumination, and be provided with light energy tracking sensors on the solar panel, catch sunshine in real time, improved the efficiency of light energy utilization, this solar lamp arm is adjusted LED and is trailed street lamp is rational in infrastructure, and is energy -concerving and environment -protective.

title: Test system and method used for solar energy module
abstract: The invention discloses a test system and method used for a solar energy module. The test system comprises a horizontal adjustment mechanism which is used for placing the solar energy module and adjusting the gradient of the solar energy module; a light source device which is used for projecting parallel rays on the solar energy module; and a processor which is electrically connected with the solar energy module and is used for measuring output powers of the solar energy module. The horizontal adjustment mechanism is adjusted for a plurality of times so as to enable the processor to measure a plurality of output powers of the solar energy module and enable the processor to find the maximum value of the output powers.

title: Solar energy brick
abstract: The utility model relates to a building decorated material which provides a solar energy brick. The solar energy brick can convert the solar energy into the electrical energy. The solar energy brick solves the problem of being low in utilization rate of the solar energy and high in cost of the prior art. The solar energy brick comprises a porcelain base layer and a solar energy battery plate. Grooves which place the solar energy battery plate are arranged on the upper surface of the porcelain base layer. The solar energy battery plate is embedded in the grooves on the upper surface of the porcelain base layer. Side edges of the porcelain base layer are respectively provided with wire grooves which are communicated with the grooves. The solar energy battery plate is connected with a plurality of wire plugs through the wire. The plurality of wire plugs are respectively correspondingly arranged inside the wire grooves. Free end of the wire plugs are further provided with wire sockets coordinately connected with the free end of the wire plugs. Heat insulation layers are arranged on the lower surface of the porcelain base layer.

title: Solar energy component and solar energy terminal
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy component and solar energy terminal to richen the color of solar energy component product, improve the matching in color nature of solar energy component andbuilding. Solar energy component includes: relative set up and through the frame connect the vacuole formation structure transparent front bezel and backplate, in the cavity structure inner wall extension's of frame warm limit parting bead edgewise to and, setting up in between the dorsal part of transparent front bezel and the warm limit parting bead or set up in the front side of backplate andthe solar cell chip between the parting bead of warm limit, solar cell chip includes that the edge keeps away from substrate, cell layer and the printing opacity colour encapsulated layer that the backplate direction set gradually.

title: Effective solar energy photoelectric conversion device
abstract: The utility model relates to an effective solar energy photoelectric conversion device which is characterized in that the effective solar energy photoelectric conversion device comprises a spherical hood, a cylindrical base, a sunlight collector, solar energy photoelectric conversion devices, a bracket and a solar energy conversion output cable; the spherical hood is a nonopaque sphere spanned on the cylindrical base; the collector, the solar energy photoelectric conversion devices and the bracket are all arranged in the spherical hood; the solar energy photoelectric conversion device is arranged behind each optical lens and consists of a photovoltaic cell, a radiator and an output cable. The solar energy photoelectric conversion output cable is formed by the output cables of a plurality of solar energy photoelectric conversion devices, and is connected with an electric apparatus; and the rest electricity is stored by a storage battery. The effective solar energy photoelectric conversion device has the advantages of simple structure, small size, high photoelectric conversion efficiency, energy saving and environment protection as well as convenient installation. The utility model is an ideal solar energy photoelectric conversion device.

title: Based on energy-conserving street lamp device of solar energy
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar energy is used and a based on energy-conserving street lamp device of solar energy is disclosed, including the energy-conserving street lamp body of solar energy, the energy-conserving street lamp body of solar energy includes base and lamp pole, it is articulated with the lamp pole that the base passes through the rivet, inside battery and the monitored control system of being equipped with of lamp pole, the lamp pole top is equipped with the lamp pole, lamp pole one end is equipped with the LED lamps and lanterns, be equipped with the support on the lamp pole, the support top is equipped with solar cell panel, solar cell panel and support fixed connection, the last heating panel that is equipped with of solar cell panel, be equipped with single crystal silicon solar cell group between heating panel and the solar cell panel. The utility model discloses a single crystal silicon solar cell group is the electric energy to solar energy transformation, is stored by the battery to for the LED lamps and lanterns provide the electric energy, make its luminous illumination, the electric quantity condition of battery can be known to monitored control system's device, is favorable to the normal work of the energy-conserving street lamp of solar energy.

title: Energy storage type solar cell module
abstract: The utility model discloses an energy storage type solar cell module, and relates to the field of solar cells. The energy storage type solar cell module comprises an energy storage cell protection frame and a solar energy storage cell main body, the two sides of the energy storage cell protection frame are fixedly connected with fixed mounting plates, and the interior of the energy storage cell protection frame is fixedly connected with a clamping rail. According to the energy storage type solar cell module, the solar energy storage cell main body is protected through the arranged energy storage cell protection frame, so that the energy storage cell protection frame and the energy storage cabinet are fixed, and the solar energy storage cell main body and the energy storage cell protection frame are clamped through the arrangement of the clamping rail, the supporting fixing column, the sleeve and the locking mechanism; the connection is stable after the clamping position is fixed, and when the solar energy storage battery main body needs to be maintained, the solar energy storage battery main body is convenient to disassemble and assemble, so that the maintenance is convenient.

title: Solar-energy water-heating electricity-generating device concentrating and collecting light through rotating parabolic surface
abstract: A Solar-energy water-heating electricity-generating device concentrating and collecting light through rotating parabolic surface comprises a rectangular box body, a water box, a cold water tube, a hot water tube, a transparent planar cover plate, and solar-energy light concentration and reception mechanisms. Every solar-energy light concentration and reception mechanism comprises a rotating-paraboloid reflector and an optical-energy receiver; and the optical-energy receiver of every solar-energy light concentration and reception mechanism comprises a rotating-paraboloid heat-conducting hollow body and a rotating-paraboloid solar-energy battery board. The device receives solar energy by virtue of the light reflection and concentration functions of the rotating paraboloid, thereby greatly improving the receiving efficiency of solar energy and collecting and receiving solar energy under the environments of hard light and soft light.

title: Solar energy refrigerator
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy refrigerator which is provided with a refrigerator body, a front wall plate, a side wall plate, a top wall plate and the back wall plate of which are respectively provided with a solar energy photovoltaic panel; the solar energy photovoltaic panel arranged on the back wall plate at least comprises two groups of solar energy photovoltaic panel sets; each solar energy photovoltaic panel set comprises a first solar energy photovoltaic panel and a second solar energy photovoltaic panel arranged to be folded with or parallel to the first solar energy photovoltaic panel; the solar energy refrigerator further comprises a photovoltaic control device, a storage battery and a switch control piece, wherein an input end of the photovoltaic control device is electrically connected with the solar energy photovoltaic panels, and an output end thereof is electrically connected with an input end of the storage battery; an output end of the storage battery is electrically connected with a power input end of the solar energy refrigerator by the switch control piece; and the photovoltaic control device and the storage battery are arranged at the lower part of the refrigerator body. Compared with the prior art, the utility model enlarges the light absorption area, and effectively improves the photoelectric conversion efficiency of solar energy, thus not only saving the energy and being environment-friendly, but also being simple in structure and convenient to use.

title: Solar apparatus for supplying electricity and illuminating system having the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar apparatus for supplying electricity and an illuminating system having the same. The apparatus includes a generating electricity module, a controlling module and a storing energy module. The controlling module connects to the generating electricity module and storing energy module respectively, which is configured for controlling the generating electricity module to convert a solar energy to an electrical energy and storing the electrical energy in the storing energy module. The generating electricity module includes a solar battery panel and a solar converging module. The solar converging module includes at least a lens module. The solar converging module is opposite to the solar battery panel, and is configured for converging solar radiation onto the solar battery panel.

title: Solar energy heating hat
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy heating hat which comprises a solar battery panel (1), a semiconductor heating sheet (2) and a hat body. The solar energy heating hat is characterized in that the solar battery panel (1) is a thin-film solar battery panel, the solar battery panel (1) is attached outside the hat body, and the semiconductor heating sheet (2) is installed on the inner side of the hat body. The solar energy heating hat has the advantages of converting solar energy into heat energy inside the hat and providing warmth for the head portion of a user.

title: Solar energy window utensil
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a solar energy window utensil, solar energy window utensil can include: the window form, the window form includes a plurality of cavity holes, crisscross the inlaying of cavity hole has transparent basic unit and solar cell panel layer, transparent basic unit includes the clear glass layer, the solar cell panel layer includes film solar cell panel layer, it is the electric energy that the solar cell panel layer is used for solar energy transformation, transparent basic unit is used for making external light to pass through solar energy window utensil improves room light luminance, according to the embodiment of the quadruple waterproof safety device, when solar energy window utensil can be the electric energy with solar energy conversion, do nothide the light in the house, room light luminance improves, do not influence the generating efficiency.

title: Solar windmill
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy utilization, and relates to a windmill, in particular to a solar windmill. The solar windmill solves the defect in the prior art that the windmill utilizes wind energy only. The solar windmill includes a hollow support rod, a central spindle is arranged at the upper end of the support rod, a plurality of blades are arranged on the central spindle, and silicon plates capable of receiving solar energy are arranged on surfaces of the blades and are connected with a storage battery arranged in the support rod through leads. Compared with the prior art, the solar windmill has the advantages as follows: the silicon plates capable of receiving solar energy are arranged on the surfaces of the blades, therefore, the windmill can receive wind energy and solar energy at the same time and store wind energy and solar energy, maximize utilization of natural resources, and enhance environment-friendly effect.

title: Active solar energy tracing method and device
abstract: The invention discloses an active solar energy tracing method comprising the following steps: manually adjusting the initial posture of a solar energy device with an illuminated face to ensure that the illuminated face is vertical to an solar incident ray; obtaining current time; by taking the initial posture of the solar energy device and the current time as the references, obtaining device data according to the current time, and adjusting the direction angle and the altitude angle of the solar energy device at fixed time to realize active solar energy tracing. The invention also discloses a device used for the above solar energy tracing method, comprising a solar energy device with an illuminated face, a posture adjusting device of the solar energy device, a current time acquiring device, a controller and a press key system connected with the controller. The tracing method and the device of the invention have favourable precision and stability.

title: Outdoor shading device with renewable power system
abstract: An outdoor shading device includes a supporting frame, a shading awning supported by the supporting frame to define a shading area underneath the shading awning, and a solar power system. The solar power system includes a solar collecting unit having a solar collecting surface overlapped on the shading awning for solar energy collection, and a power storage supported at the supporting frame to electrically connect to the solar collecting unit, wherein when the shading awning is orientated for providing shade from the sun, the solar collecting surface of the solar collecting unit is aligned with the direction of the sun to maximize the solar energy collection, such that after the solar energy is collected, the solar collecting unit converts the solar energy into electrical energy and stored in the power storage.

title: Solar energy collector
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy collector comprising solar energy absorbing material within chamber having a transparent wall, solar energy being transmitted through the transparent wall, and efficiently absorbed by the absorbing material, for transfer to a heat transfer fluid. The solar energy absorbing material, of generally foraminous nature, absorbs and transmits the solar energy with improved efficiency.

title: SOLAR ENERGY CONVERTER, METHOD OF PRODUCTION AND SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION SYSTEM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve solar collecting performance in a solar energy converter comprising the unit structure of solar cell modules and a solar collecting plate. SOLUTION: The solar energy converter is provided with solar cell modules 4 between a transparent plate 2 and a solar collecting plate 3 provided with heat transferring medium piping 31. In this case, a part of the solar collecting plate 3 is arranged with the solar cell modules 4 and comprises a power generating and solar collecting part 40, and the other part of the solar collecting plate 3 is an exclusive solar collecting part 30.

title: DEVICES AND METHODS FOR INCREASING SOLAR HYDROGEN CONVERSION EFFICIENCY IN PHOTOVOLTAIC ELECTROLYSIS
abstract: Devices and methods for photovoltaic electrolysis are disclosed. A device comprises a photovoltaic cell element and an electrolysis compartment. The photovoltaic cell element is configured to convert a portion of solar energy into electrical energy and to pass another portion of the solar energy. The electrolysis compartment includes an aqueous electrolyte positioned to receive the other portion of the solar energy and electrodes electrically connected to receive the electrical energy produced by the photovoltaic cell element. A method comprises receiving solar energy with a photovoltaic cell element, converting a portion of the solar energy into electrical energy, passing another portion of the solar energy through the photovoltaic cell element, receiving with an aqueous electrolyte the other portion of the solar energy, transmitting the electrical energy generated by the photovoltaic cell element to a pair of electrodes, and electrolyzing the aqueous electrolyte with the pair of electrodes.

title: Organic display device
abstract: The invention provides an organic display device, comprising an organic solar module and an ultraviolet organic light-emitting module, wherein the organic solar module is used for acquiring solar energy and converting the acquired solar energy into electrical energy; and the ultraviolet organic light-emitting module is used for driving itself to emit ultraviolet rays by using the electrical energy generated by the organic solar module. According to the organic display device, the ultraviolet organic light-emitting module and the organic solar module are combined, so that the solar energy can be sufficiently utilized and the ultraviolet display can be realized by using solar energy.

title: Fixed point array solar cooker
abstract: The utility model relates to focusing utilization of solar energy, in particular to a fixed point array solar cooker which is capable of collecting solar energy by point-focusing solar lenses and applying. The fixed point array solar cooker comprises at least one or a group of point focusing solar lenses, at least one solar cooker unit and a tracking control device, wherein the solar lenses are arranged on solar lens supports, the solar cooker units are arranged in point focusing areas of the solar lenses and arranged above or below the solar lenses, focal length of the solar lenses tracking solar energy is changed and always kept in the point areas of the solar cooker units. The tracking control device controls the solar lenses to focus sunlight onto at least one solar cooker unit when the sunlight changes, and the solar cooker units move asynchronously with the solar lenses during tracking solar energy and are kept relatively still with the ground, and accordingly, tracking focusing utilization of the solar energy is realized.

title: Solar energy auxiliary heat pump drying system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy auxiliary heat pump drying system. The solar energy auxiliary heat pump drying system comprises a drying chamber, a heat pump, a solar solution regenerator, an internal-heat and heat-insulation type packed tower and an insulation type packed tower. The heat pump drying system can sufficiently use solar energy in all the seasons of a year, the solar energy is used under the situation of abundant solar energy for carrying out heating and regenerating on the dehumidified diluted solution, the heat pump is used with the help of the solar energy for carrying out dehumidification and heating on air when the solar energy is insufficient, and it is ensured that the system can operate efficiently and stably. According to the solar energy auxiliary heat pump drying system, the solution dehumidification mode is adopted, the solution is in direct contact with the air, heat-exchange temperature difference is small, irreversible loss is low, and the problem that energy consumption is large for a traditional condensation dehumidification mode is solved; meanwhile, the solution regeneration heat and the heat of some heated air derive from the solar energy, and the energy can be used for free, so that the solar energy auxiliary pump drying system is significant in energy-saving effect during the operation in the whole year.

title: Intelligent solar energy line light
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent solar energy line light belonging to the field of solar energy photoelectric technology. The intelligent solar energy line light consists of a solar battery assembly, an intelligent charging and discharging controller, an energy-storing storage battery, an inverter, a power controller and an LED line light, wherein the solar battery assembly is arranged on the roof or ground where solar rays can be received; the intelligent charging and discharging controller with a light control switch function is respectively connected with the solar battery assembly, the energy-storing storage battery and the inverter; and the LED line light is connected with the inverter through the power controller. The solar battery assembly charges the energy-storing storage battery through the intelligent charging and discharging controller; the electric energy of the energy-storing storage battery is output to the inverter through the intelligent charging and dischargingcontroller; the electric energy is output to the power controller after being inverted into alternating current, and the power controller controls the LED line light to work. The intelligent solar energy line light does not need commercial power, but the electricity is completely supplied to the night lamp by the solar energy. The intelligent solar energy line light has the advantages of long service life, energy resource saving, environmental protection, low expense and the like.

title: SOLAR GENERATING SYSTEM USING REFLECTING APPARATUS AND SOLAR GENERATING METHOD USING THE SAME
abstract: PURPOSE: A solar energy generating system using a reflecting device and a solar energy generating method using the same are provided to efficiently produce a power by performing solar energy generation of a center reflection type. CONSTITUTION: A solar energy generating system(200) using a reflecting device includes a solar energy reflecting device and a solar cell module panel. The solar energy reflecting device(100) reflects a light of the sun while controlling a reflecting angle according to incidence quantity of the light of the sun. A plurality of solar cell module panels(210) absorbs the light of the sun reflected through the reflecting device, and produces a power.

title: Energy storage robot and energy storage system
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides an energy storage robot and an energy storage system, the energy storage robot comprises a base, a battery is arranged in the base, a moving device is arranged at the bottom of the base, and the moving device is used for driving the base to move relative to the ground; the support is detachably connected with the base, a plurality of solar panels are arranged on the support, and the solar panels are electrically connected with the battery; the sensors are arranged on the base and/or the support, and the sensors are used for determining the moving range and/or environment information of the base; wherein part of the solar panels are arranged on the side, facing the base, of the support, part of the solar panels are arranged on the side, away from the base, of the support, and the light receiving area of the solar panels in the first state is smaller than the light receiving area of the solar panels in the second state. According to the technical scheme, the solar panels are arranged on the top side and the bottom side of the support, the scene that the energy storage robot absorbs solar energy can be widened, and the application range of the product is widened.

title: Classroom solar energy energy-saving system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of an energy-saving system and particularly relates to a classroom solar energy energy-saving system. The classroom solar energy energy-saving system comprises a micro processor and a solar energy cell panel, wherein the solar energy cell panel is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy stored in a storage cell, the storage cell is used for supplying power for electrical equipment in a classroom, the storage cell is connected in parallel with a common power source of the electrical equipment, the storagecell is connected with an electric quantity control unit, the electric quantity control unit comprises an electric quantity detection device and a power-off device, the power-off device is connected with a microprocessor, and the microprocessor is connected with the common power source. The classroom solar energy energy-saving system is advantaged in that the solar energy is effectively utilized,resources are saved, a standby power source is further provided for the electrical equipment of the classroom, and safety of the electricity environment is guaranteed.

title: Power supply device of substation bird dispeller
