abstract: The utility model relates to a power supply device of a substation bird dispeller, comprising a solar panel, a solar controller, a lead-acid storage battery and an energy converting device, wherein the solar panel is electrically connected with the lead-acid storage battery through the energy converting device; the solar controller is in signal connection with the solar panel, the lead-acid storage battery and the energy converting device; the solar panel converts solar radiation energy into electric energy through the energy converting device; and the electric energy is sent to the lead-acid storage battery and stored therein under the control of the solar controller, and released as required; and in this way, long-term stable power supply to the bird dispeller is realized.

title: SOLAR ENERGY BOILER AND HYDROGEN ENERGY DEVELOPMENTAL SYSTEM
abstract: PURPOSE: A solar energy boiler and a hydrogen energy power generator are provided to maximize economic value by being operated by sunlight and water for 24 hours. CONSTITUTION: A solar energy boiler and a hydrogen energy power generator heats water, since solar energy is used for a boiler in the daytime. The energy produced in the solar heat collecting plate is used in the solar heat boiler. The energy is stored, water is electrolyzed, electricity is generated by a hydrogen energy device, and the electricity is stored in the battery.

title: Solar energy waste processor
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy waste processor. The solar energy waste processor comprises an incineration box. The right side of the incineration box is provided with a steam storage tank and an incineration waste treatment box. The steam storage tank is connected with a steam preparation box of the incineration box through a high-pressure pipeline. The left side of the steam preparationbox is provided with an L-shaped solar energy device. The upper end surface of the L-shaped solar energy device is provided with photovoltaic plates, and the inner of the bottom end of the L-shaped solar energy device is provided with energy storage batteries connected with the photovoltaic plates in a linking mode. A controller is arranged in the steam preparation box. The solar energy waste processor is conductive to the storage and the one-way input of stream and the screening treatment of incineration waste by arranging the steam storage tank, a one-way input port and the incineration waste treatment box. By using the L-shaped solar energy device to supply power, the photovoltaic plates convert solar energy into electric energy to be stored in the energy storage batteries, and the energy storage batteries supply power for the solar energy waste processor through the controller. Moreover, the solar energy waste processor has the advantages that operating cost is low, coordination between power supply and demand is good, and the solar energy waste processor is convenient to operate and the like.

title: SOLAR ENERGY TRAP AND TURBINE
abstract: A solar energy turbine includes solar energy trap (1110) having a chamber with an inlet port (12), such that solar energy (13) entering the chamber through the inlet port is absorbed and reflected within the chamber means until substantially all the solar energy is absorbed by the chamber. Preferably, the inlet port is arranged to cause photons of the solar energy entering the chamber to circulate substantially in a single direction within the chamber until absorbed, such that on re-passing the inlet port substantially no photons emerge from the inlet port. The solar energy turbine includes a heat exchanger (1150, 1160, 1170) for extracting energy from the solar energy trap to drive a turbine (1120).

title: Novel solar water heater
abstract: The utility model provides a novel solar water heater includes solar energy collection pipe, water tank, be equipped with sealed the pad between solar energy collection pipe and the water tank, the intraductal heat pipe that is equipped with of solar energy collection, two ends of heat pipe seal, and heat pipe one end penetrates solar energy collection pipe lower extreme on the solar energy collection pipe, and the other end passes sealed the pad and establishes in the water tank, is equipped with the supersaturated solution sodium acetate in the heat pipe, and the volume that supersaturated solution sodium acetate volume is in the heat pipe is 70% -85%. The utility model has the advantages of, can save solar energy, utilize the water of storage solar energy in to the solar energy water tank to carry out secondary heating.

title: Building roof component for assembling solar energy converting elements
abstract: The invention relates to a building roof component for assembling solar energy converting elements, which aims to resolve the problem that a building roof is separated from solar energy converting elements in the prior art. By the aid of the component, the building roof can be combined with the solar energy converting elements. The component not only can be provided with photoelectric solar energy converting elements, but also can be provided with photo-thermal solar energy converting elements. Even more, after a building is put into service, the photoelectric solar energy converting elements and the photo-thermal solar energy converting elements can be optionally replaced, and a roof structure is not affected. The component is a key component for realizing building materializing of the solar energy converting elements, and really realizes that solar equipment is mounted on the building in a low-cost and large-scale manner.

title: Solar energy display device
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy display device, comprising a display panel, a back support frame, a positioning component, a solar energy module and an adhesive tape, wherein the display panel is arranged on a first surface of the back support frame; the solar energy module is arranged on a second surface of the back support frame; the positioning component is arranged on the second surface of the back support frame and used for fixing the solar energy module and the display panel; and the adhesive tape is used for adhering the display panel to the solar energy module. The solar energy display device not only can realize the accurate installation positioning of the solar energy module by using the positioning component but also can avoid glasses from bending and breaking caused by thinning the thickness of the solar energy module and prevent a solar-cell panel from falling off from an enclosure.

title: Electric bicycle with high cruising ability
abstract: The utility model relates to an electric bicycle with strong cruising ability, which comprises a bicycle frame, and wheels, a saddle and a handlebar which are arranged on the bicycle frame, and further comprises a lithium battery pack accommodated in the bicycle frame; the bicycle basket is connected with the bicycle frame and located at the front end of the handlebar; the solar power generation assembly comprises a solar energy receiving panel, a solar energy conversion unit and a lifting unit, one end of the solar energy receiving panel is hinged to the front end of the bicycle basket, the other end of the solar energy receiving panel is connected with the lifting unit, the lifting unit is vertically installed on the inner wall of the bicycle basket, and the lithium battery is electrically connected with the solar energy receiving panel through the solar energy conversion unit; and the solar energy receiving panel is arranged on a bicycle frame. According to the utility model, the solar energy receiving plate is adopted to absorb sunlight, and the solar energy is converted into electric energy through the solar energy conversion unit, so that the converted electric energy can be stored on the lithium battery pack, the structure is simple, the electric quantity loss of the lithium battery pack is effectively improved, and the endurance mileage is improved.

title: Solar intelligent automobile
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar intelligent automobile. The solar intelligent automobile comprises a solar automobile lamp lighting system composed of a solar power generation system and an automobile lamp circuit control system. The solar power generation system is composed of a solar battery pack, a solar controller and solar batteries; the solar battery pack is connected with an input end of the solar controller, the output ends of the solar controller are connected with an intelligent automobile lamp circuit controller of the solar battery circuit control system respectively, the solar battery pack distributes the obtained energy to the solar automobile lamp lighting system and the solar batteries through the solar controller, and the surplus energy is stored in the solar batteries under the condition of maintaining the normal operation of the solar automobile lamp lighting system. The solar intelligent automobile is simple in structure, energy saving and environmental friendly, has the solar power generation system, can efficiently use solar energy resources, and reduces the energy waste.

title: Wireless control concentrated solar energy illumination device
abstract: The utility model discloses a wireless control concentrated solar energy illumination device, which comprises a main controller of a solar energy photovoltaic electric source and over one slave controller of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source. The slave controllers of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source are connected with the main controller of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source by a wireless mode, wherein the main controller of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source is composed of a charge and discharge control circuit and a wireless sending circuit, and the charge and discharge control circuit is respectively connected with a solar energy battery, an accumulator, loads and the wireless sending circuit; the slave controller of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source is composed of the other charge and discharge control circuit and a wireless receiving circuit., and the other charge and discharge control circuit is respectively connected with the other solar energy battery, the other accumulator, the other loads and the wireless sending circuit. The utility model adopts a set of main controllers of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source and one or the multiple slave controllers of the solar energy photovoltaic electric source to constitute a wireless control concentrated solar energy illumination system which can realize synchronous start and synchronous close.

title: Intelligent modularized solar energy unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent modularized solar energy unmanned aerial vehicle, the intelligent modularized solar energy unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an airframe module, a power system module and an intelligent solar energy wing module, the solar energy airframe module is a main body bearing part of the unmanned aerial vehicle, an empennage, the intelligent solar energy wing module and the power system module are installed on the solar energy airframe module, the airframe module controls the operation and transformation of the intelligent solar energy wing module and the power system module; the intelligent solar energy wing module is a core part of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a plurality of core parts are integrated on the intelligent solar energy wing module to provide enough electric energy for the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the power system module is installed on the intelligent solar energy wing module to provide the flying power for the unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle is split into the airframe body, the power system module and the intelligent solar energy wing module, the physical parameter of the plane is changed through the free combination of the airframe body, the power system module and the intelligent solar energy wing module and the flexible configuration of various modules of the plane, the unmanned aerial vehicle is suitablefor different loads and flight tasks, the airplane span can be combined to meters or dozens of meters, and the single module is also suitable for transportation and manufacturing.

title: SOLAR ENERGY STORING DEVICE
abstract: PURPOSE:To realize a high-efficiency use of solar energy by a method wherein a solar battery, a superconductive coil consecutively storing the excess out of the electrical energy to be stored in the solar battery, and a switch capable of automated switching are provided. CONSTITUTION:During the daytime and when solar rays are available, the light incident on a solar battery 1 is converted into electricity by the solar battery 1. The electricity is stored in the solar battery 1 or supplied to a controller 4. Excess electrical energy not absorbed by the solar battery 1 is fed into a superconductive coil 2 for storage as a permanent current. When solar optical energy is not available for night or cloud, or when there is a shortage of energy stored in the solar battery 1, a switch 3 is operated, for the use of electrical energy stored in the superconductive coil 2. The electrical energy from the superconductive coil 2 is fed to the controller 4 for its activation.

title: Mobile lattice array solar focusing building energy supply system
abstract: The utility model relates to solar energy utilization, in particular to a mobile lattice array solar focusing building energy supply system which adopts point focusing solar mirrors for solar acquisition. The mobile lattice array solar focusing building energy supply system comprises at least one point focusing solar mirror or a group of point focusing solar mirrors, at least one solar photothermal conversion device and a tracking control device. The solar mirrors are arranged on a solar mirror support, and the solar photothermal conversion devices are arranged on a solar photothermal conversion device support and positioned in a focus point area of the solar mirrors and above or below the solar mirrors. The tracking control device controls the solar mirrors to focus sunlight onto at least one solar photothermal conversion device during change of the sunlight, the solar photothermal conversion devices move when the solar mirrors track solar energy, and each one or each group of the solar mirrors selects the solar photothermal conversion device which can achieve maximum solar energy utilization rate for focusing, so that tracking, focusing and utilizing of solar energy can be realized.

title: Solar energy and building integrated hot air power generation, ventilation and heating system
abstract: A solar energy and building integrated hot air power generation, ventilation and heating system comprises a house body. The house body comprises a foundation, walls, doors, windows and a solar hot air power generation, ventilation and heating system body. The solar hot air power generation, ventilation and heating system body comprises a solar energy ground collector, a solar energy outer wall collector, a solar energy roof collector, a solar hot air power generator, a solar heating device, a solar ventilating device and a solar hot air water heating device. The solar hot air power generation, ventilation and heating system has the advantages that the features of solar energy is effectively used, solar energy hot air is used for heating domestic hot water, ventilating, cooling, power generating and heating, solar energy air collectors are integrated with a building, the system is low in cost, safe, reliable, good in stability and capable of comprehensively utilizing solar energy all the year round, and the domestic hot water supply, winter heating, summer power generation, ventilation and cooling of the single building in northern areas can be achieved.

title: Umbrella with small solar electric power generating and storing device
abstract: The utility model relates to an umbrella with a small solar energy generating and electric storing device, which has an umbrella, a solar energy photovoltaic solar panel, a battery and a power output, wherein, the solar energy photovoltaic solar panel is connected with the battery through a lead, and the battery and the power output are connected by use of a lead. The utility model is characterized in that the solar energy photovoltaic solar panel is arranged on the umbrella surface. Apart from being convenient for carrying, when the umbrella is open for shielding the sun, the utility model not only can generate and store electricity by use of the solar energy, but also can regulate the position according to the radiation angle of the sun, thereby using the solar energy more effectively.

title: Installment coordinates the solar light tracking equipment to adjust the solar energy board
abstract: This new installment coordinates the solar light tracking equipment to adjust the solar energy board, causes the solar energy board and the solar light can maintain at the near vertical condition. Meanwhile the long side aided design may change plane mirror of the angle of bank in the solar energy board, will be vertical outside the solar board the light, after passing through the plane specular reflection the vertical component, may be vertical the light uses again outside the solar board, so as to promotion solar energy board photoelectricity switching energy.

title: Street lamp
abstract: The utility model discloses a street lamp, which comprises a lamp bulb, a solar panel installed at the top end of the street lamp, a solar energy converter installed under the ground in the vicinity of the street lamp, and a solar energy transmitter that is installed inside a hollow cavity of a lamp post and is connected with the solar panel and the solar energy converter. The street lamp can convert the collected solar energy to electric energy and store the electric energy for street lamp lighting, thereby remarkably saving electricity.
